math-e1-geo1.title: Sunayen siffofi da kusurwoyinsu
math-e1-geo1.concept: **Alwatika** tana da gefuna 3, **siffa mai kusurwa huɗu** kuma tana da gefuna 4. **Da’ira** zagaye take kuma ba ta da kusurwa.

math-e1-geo2.title: Sanin siffofi masu girma uku
math-e1-geo2.concept: Siffar akwati ita ce **akwatin mai kusurwa huɗu**, siffar dogon abu mai zagaye ita ce **silinda**, siffar ƙwallo kuma ita ce **ƙwallo**.
math-e1-geo2.example: Akwatin mai kusurwa huɗu · silinda · ƙwallo

math-e1-l1.title: Ƙirga lambobi
math-e1-l1.concept: Za ka iya gano adadin abubuwa ta hanyar nuna su ɗaya bayan ɗaya yayin ƙirgawa. Idan sun haura 10, ya fi sauƙi a haɗa su rukuni-rukuni na 5 ko 10 sannan a ƙirga.

math-e1-l2.title: Ƙari da ragi
math-e1-l2.concept: **Ƙari (+)** yana haɗa lambobi biyu, yayin da **ragi (-)** ke cire adadin da ya yi daidai da ƙaramin lamba daga babban lamba.

math-e1-l3.title: Kwatanta girman lambobi
math-e1-l3.concept: A cikin lambobi biyu, ana nuna babbar lamba da **>**, ƙaramar lamba kuma da **<**. Buɗaɗɗen bakin alamar yana fuskantar babbar lambar.

math-e1-l4.title: Siffofi iri-iri
math-e1-l4.concept: **Alwatika** tana da gefuna 3, **siffa mai kusurwa huɗu** kuma tana da gefuna 4. **Da’ira** zagaye take kuma ba ta da kusurwa.

math-e1-l5.title: Tsawo da agogo
math-e1-l5.concept: Ana auna tsawo da **cm**. Ƙaramin hannun agogo yana nuna “awa”, dogon hannun kuma yana nuna “minti”.

math-e2-dat1.title: Rarrabawa da nuna bayanai a jadawali da zane
math-e2-dat1.concept: Idan aka rarraba bayanai bisa ƙa’ida, aka ƙirga su, sannan aka nuna su a **jadawali** ko **jadawalin zane**, za a iya kwatanta su da kallo ɗaya.
math-e2-dat1.example: Mutane 3 a A, 5 a B, 2 a C → jimilla mutane 10

math-e2-geo1.title: Alwatika da siffofi masu kusurwa huɗu
math-e2-geo1.concept: **Alwatika** tana da gefuna madaidaici 3 da kusurwoyi 3, **siffa mai kusurwa huɗu** kuma tana da gefuna madaidaici 4 da kusurwoyi 4. Ko da siffofin sun bambanta, adadin gefuna da kusurwoyi iri ɗaya ne.
math-e2-geo1.example: Siffa mai kusurwa huɗu: gefuna 4, kusurwoyi 4

math-e2-geo2.title: Tsawo da lokaci
math-e2-geo2.concept: Idan ka daidaita abu da alamar 0 a kan ma’aunin tsawo, alamar da ke ɗayan ƙarshen tana nuna tsawonsa. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. Idan ka ninka lambar da dogon hannun agogo ya nuna da 5, za ka sami mintuna.

math-e2-l1.title: Matsayin lambobi
math-e2-l1.concept: A cikin lamba mai lambobi biyu, lambar hagu tana matsayin **goma**, ta dama kuma tana matsayin **ɗaya**. Idan aka tara goma guda 10, ana samun 100.

math-e2-l2.title: Ƙari da ragi na lambobi masu lambobi biyu
math-e2-l2.concept: Yi lissafi a lambobin wuri ɗaya tare, sannan a lambobin goma tare. Idan jimillar ta wuce 10, ka ɗaga ɗaya zuwa wuri na gaba; idan ba za ka iya yin ragi ba, ka aro daga wuri na gaba.

math-e2-l3.title: Gabatarwa ga ninkawa
math-e2-l3.concept: Ana iya rubuta taƙaitaccen tsarin tara lamba ɗaya sau da yawa da **ninkawa (×)**.

math-e2-l4.title: Tsawo da lokaci
math-e2-l4.concept: **1m = 100cm**. A agogo, mintuna 5 suna wucewa duk lokacin da dogon hannu ya wuce lamba ɗaya.

math-e2-l5.title: Gano tsari
math-e2-l5.concept: Idan ka gano **tsarin** da lambobi ke ƙaruwa ko raguwa, za ka iya sanin lamba ta gaba.

math-e3-ari1.title: Ƙari da ragi na lambobi masu lambobi uku
math-e3-ari1.concept: Yi lissafi daga matsayin ɗaya zuwa gaba. Idan jimilla ta wuce 10, **ɗaga** zuwa matsayin da ke sama; idan ba za ka iya yin ragi ba, **aro** daga matsayin da ke sama.

math-e3-geo1.title: Kusurwoyi da kusurwar dama
math-e3-geo1.concept: Siffar da haskoki biyu da suka fara daga batu guda suka ƙunsa ita ce **kusurwa**. Kusurwar **90^\circ** ita ce **kusurwar dama**; wadda ta fi ƙanƙanta ita ce **acute**, wadda ta fi girma kuma ita ce **obtuse**.

math-e3-geo2.title: Radius da diameter na da'ira
math-e3-geo2.concept: Tsawon daga tsakiyar da'ira zuwa batu a kan kewayenta shi ne **radius**; layin da ya ratsa tsakiya shi ne **diameter**. Diameter ya ninka radius sau 2.

math-e3-l1.title: Ninkawa da rabawa
math-e3-l1.concept: Ninkawa ita ce haɗa lamba iri ɗaya sau da yawa; **rabawa** kuma ita ce raba daidai. Idan ka san jadawalin ninkawa, rabawa ma tana zama mai sauƙi.

math-e3-l2.title: Sanin fractions
math-e3-l2.concept: Ana amfani da **fraction** don nuna wani yanki daga abubuwan da aka raba gaba ɗaya daidai. Lambar ƙasa ita ce **denominator**, ta sama kuma ita ce **numerator**.

math-e3-l3.title: Tsawo, girma da nauyi
math-e3-l3.concept: **1km = 1000m**, **1L = 1000mL**, **1kg = 1000g**. Idan kana canja naúra, ninka da 1000.

math-e3-l4.title: Da'ira da kusurwoyi
math-e3-l4.concept: **Kusurwar dama** tana da 90°. A cikin da'ira, **diameter** ya ninka **radius** sau 2.

math-e3-l5.title: Tables da graphs
math-e3-l5.concept: Idan aka tsara sakamakon bincike a table, zai yi sauƙi a gano mafi yawa, mafi ƙanƙanta da jimilla.

math-e4-dat1.title: Karanta line graph
math-e4-dat1.concept: **Line graph** yana nuna yadda ƙima ke canjawa da lokaci ta amfani da maki da layuka. Idan layin ya tashi, ƙimar ta ƙaru; idan ya sauka, ta ragu.

math-e4-geo1.title: Girman kusurwoyin siffofi
math-e4-geo1.concept: Jimillar kusurwoyi 3 na triangle ita ce $180^\circ$; jimillar kusurwoyi 4 na quadrilateral kuma ita ce $360^\circ$.

math-e4-geo2.title: Quadrilaterals da polygons
math-e4-geo2.concept: Idan gefe biyu masu fuskantar juna suna parallel, sifar ita ce **trapezoid**; idan nau'i biyu duka suna parallel, ita ce **parallelogram**; idan gefuna 4 duka daidai ne, ita ce **rhombus**. Layin da ke haɗa vertices da ba maƙwabta ba shi ne **diagonal**.

math-e4-l1.title: Manyan lambobi
math-e4-l1.concept: Ana karantawa da rubuta manyan lambobi bisa rukunin dubu goma (10000). Digit a kowane matsayi yana nuna ƙimarsa ta **place value**.

math-e4-l2.title: Ninkawa da rabawa da manyan lambobi
math-e4-l2.concept: Raba lambar da ake ninkawa zuwa sassa, ninka kowane sashe sannan ka haɗa. A rabawa, kimanta quotient ɗin don tabbatarwa.

math-e4-l3.title: Ƙara da rage fractions da decimals
math-e4-l3.concept: Ga fractions masu denominator iri ɗaya, ƙara ko rage **numerators**. Ga decimals, daidaita matsayinsu na decimal point kafin lissafi.

math-e4-l4.title: Kusurwoyi da siffofi
math-e4-l4.concept: Jimillar kusurwoyi 3 na triangle ita ce **180°**, kuma ta quadrilateral ita ce **360°**.

math-e4-l5.title: Bar graph da average
math-e4-l5.concept: Karanta bayanan don nemo jimilla da bambanci. **Average** shi ne jimillar duk ƙimomi da aka raba da adadinsu.

math-e5-dat1.title: Neman average
math-e5-dat1.concept: **Average** shi ne jimillar duk bayanai da aka raba da adadin bayanan.

math-e5-dat2.title: Yiwuwar faruwa
math-e5-dat2.concept: Ana nuna **yiwuwar** wani abu ya faru da lamba daga 0 (ba zai faru ba) zuwa 1 (tabbatacce). Yiwuwar = adadin sakamakon da ake so ÷ adadin duk sakamako.
math-e5-dat2.example: Kwallaye A guda 3, B guda 2 → yiwuwar A ita ce $\frac{3}{5}=0.6$

math-e5-geo1.title: Kewaye da faɗin fili
math-e5-geo1.concept: Ɗan-ɗaki: faɗi=tsawo×faɗi, alwatika: tushe×tsawo÷2, siffar layi ɗaya-ɗaya mai gefuna masu kama: tushe×tsawo, trapezium: (gefen sama+gefen ƙasa)×tsawo÷2, rhombus: diagonal×diagonal÷2.

math-e5-geo2.title: Daidaituwar siffofi da siminti
math-e5-geo2.concept: Siffofi biyu masu kamanni da girma iri ɗaya waɗanda za su iya rufewa juna ana kiransu **masu daidaito**. Siffar da sassan ta suke rufewa juna gaba ɗaya idan aka lanƙwasa ta a kan layi madaidaiciya, **siffar simintin layi** ce; wannan layin kuwa **gatarin siminti** ne.

math-e5-l1.title: Haɗawa da cire gutsattsarin da ke da mabambantan masu ƙasa
math-e5-l1.concept: Idan masu ƙasan sun bambanta, sai a fara **daidaita masu ƙasa**. Yin amfani da ƙaramin ninkuwar gama-gari na masu ƙasan biyu a matsayin mai ƙasa ɗaya ya fi sauƙi.

math-e5-l2.title: Ninkar ɗanƙi
math-e5-l2.concept: Cire maki na goma a ninka kamar cikakkun lambobi, sannan a mayar da maki na goma bisa yawan wuraren da ke bayan maki na goma a cikin lambobin da aka ninka.

math-e5-l3.title: Masu rabawa da ninkuwa
math-e5-l3.concept: **Mai rabawa** lamba ce da ke raba wata lamba ba tare da saura ba, **ninkuwa** kuma ita ce lambar bayan an ninka ta da 1, 2, 3... .

math-e5-l4.title: Faɗin fili da ƙarar abu
math-e5-l4.concept: Ɗan-ɗaki yana da **tsawo × faɗi**, alwatika tana da **tushe × tsawo ÷ 2**, ƙarar akwatin murabba'i kuma ita ce **tsawo × faɗi × tsawo**.

math-e5-l5.title: Rabo da adadin rabo
math-e5-l5.concept: **Adadin rabo** shi ne ƙimar da ake samu idan aka raba adadin da ake kwatantawa da adadin tushe. Idan aka ninka adadin rabo da 100, ana samun **kashi bisa ɗari (%)**.

math-e6-ari1.title: Haɗaɗɗen lissafin cikakkun lambobi
math-e6-ari1.concept: Idan haɗawa, cirewa, ninkawa da rabawa sun gauraya, sai a fara da **abin da ke cikin baka**, sai **ninkawa da rabawa**, a ƙarshe **haɗawa da cirewa**, ana lissafawa daga hagu zuwa dama.

math-e6-ari2.title: Ɗagawa, watsarwa da zagayawa
math-e6-ari2.concept: A **ɗagawa**, ana ɗaga duk lambobin da ke ƙasan matsayin da ake nema. A **watsarwa**, ana watsar da su duka. A **zagaye**, idan lambar matsayin da ke ƙasa kai tsaye ta kai 5 ko fiye, a ɗaga; idan ta kai 4 ko ƙasa, a watsar.
math-e6-ari2.example: 3472 idan an mayar da shi zuwa ɗaruruwa: ɗagawa 3500, watsarwa 3400, zagaye 3500

math-e6-dat1.title: Jadawalin sanduna da jadawalin da'ira
math-e6-dat1.concept: **Jadawalin sanduna** da **jadawalin da'ira** suna ɗaukar duka a matsayin 100% kuma suna nuna adadin rabo na kowane ɓangare. Yawan wani ɓangare=duka×adadin rabo.

math-e6-geo1.title: Kewayen da'ira da faɗin da'ira
math-e6-geo1.concept: Kewaye (kewayen da'ira)=diamita×π, faɗin da'ira=radius×radius×π. π kusan $3.14$ ne.

math-e6-geo2.title: Akwatin murabba'i da kubu
math-e6-geo2.concept: Ƙara=tsawo×faɗi×tsawo, faɗin dukkan fuskoki=(jimillar faɗin fuskoki uku)×2. Akwatin murabba'i yana da fuska 6, gefuna 12, da kusurwoyi 8.

math-e6-l1.title: Ninkawa da rabawa da gutsattsari da ɗanƙi
math-e6-l1.concept: A ninkar gutsattsari, a ninka masu sama da juna, masu ƙasa kuma da juna. A rabon gutsattsari, a ninka da **akasin gutsattsarin**.

math-e6-l2.title: Daidaiton rabo da rabon gwargwado
math-e6-l2.concept: A daidaiton rabo, **ninkuwar lambobin ciki = ninkuwar lambobin waje**. Idan an raba jimilla bisa rabo, wannan shi ne **rabo gwargwado**.

math-e6-l3.title: Kashi bisa ɗari
math-e6-l3.concept: **Kashi bisa ɗari (%)** shi ne adadin rabo idan aka ɗauki adadin tushe a matsayin 100. Idan aka ninka ɗanƙi da 100, ana samun %.

math-e6-l4.title: Da'ira da siffofi masu girma uku
math-e6-l4.concept: Kewaye da'ira ita ce **diamita × 3.14**, faɗin da'ira kuma **radius × radius × 3.14**.

math-e6-l5.title: Matsakaici da tsara bayanai
math-e6-l5.concept: **Mean** shi ne jimilla ÷ adadi; **median** ita ce lambar tsakiya; **mode** ita ce lambar da ta fi bayyana.

math-el-ai1.title: Text da image data
math-el-ai1.concept: Ana nuna document da frequency vector na kalmomi, image kuma da matrix na pixel values. Idan dot product na vectors ya fi girma, documents ɗin sun fi kama da juna.

math-el-ai2.title: Prediction da ingantawa
math-el-ai2.concept: Ana inganta prediction ta hanyar slope na trend line, mean na squared errors (loss), da gradient descent $x_{sabo}=x-\eta f'(x)$.

math-el-cul1.title: Lissafi a fasaha da rayuwar yau da kullum
math-el-cul1.concept: Golden ratio kusan 1.618 ne, sautin da yake octave ɗaya sama yana da frequency sau 2, yawan tsarin Braille mai dige 6 shi ne $2^6-1=63$, kuma rinjayen majority yana nufin fiye da rabin jimillar.

math-el-cul2.title: Lissafi a al'umma da muhalli
math-el-cul2.concept: A yi nazarin matsalolin al'umma da muhalli ta amfani da mean na data da growth rate. Growth rate=(adadin ƙaruwa)÷(adadin farko)×100.

math-el-econ1.title: Interest, exchange rate, da tax
math-el-econ1.concept: Simple interest=principal×rate×duration; compound interest=principal×(1+rate)^duration. Exchange rate ita ce darajar foreign currency unit 1, tax kuma farashi×rate.
math-el-econ1.example: 10000 won, compound interest na shekara 10% tsawon shekaru 2 → 12100 won

math-el-econ2.title: Demand, supply, da optimization
math-el-econ2.concept: Equilibrium shi ne wurin da demand da supply curves suka haɗu. Ana nemo maximum na revenue R=pq da elasticity ta amfani da functions da derivatives.

math-el-job1.title: Sauya units da ratios
math-el-job1.concept: 1 m=100 cm, 1 kg=1000 g, awa 1=60 mintuna. Farashin bayan discount=farashi×(1−discount rate); idan aka haɗa abubuwa bisa ratio a:b, A zai zama $\frac{a}{a+b}$ na jimilla.

math-el-job2.title: Faɗi, yawan zaɓuɓɓuka, da ƙaruwa
math-el-job2.concept: Yi amfani da area domin nemo yawan material da ake buƙata; multiplication rule domin yawan pairs da za a iya samu; (adadin ƙaruwa)÷(adadin farko)×100 domin nemo growth rate.

math-el-res1.title: Hanyoyin bincike
math-el-res1.concept: Hanyoyin binciken aikin lissafi sun haɗa da binciken wallafe-wallafe, nazarin misalai, gwajin lissafi, da bincike na haɓakawa.
math-el-res1.example: Jefa dice da kanka domin gano pattern → gwajin lissafi

math-el-res2.title: Matakan bincike da ɗa'ar bincike
math-el-res2.concept: Bincike yana bi ta matakai: zaɓen topic → shiri → aiwatarwa → gabatarwa → bita. Bayyana sources da guje wa ƙirƙirar sakamako su ne ɗa'ar bincike.
math-el-res2.example: Bayan an zaɓi topic, mataki na gaba shi ne shirin bincike

math-el-sta1.title: Matsalolin statistics da sample
math-el-sta1.concept: Standard deviation ita ce square root na variance (mean na squared deviations). Ana zaɓar samples ta random sampling, stratified sampling, cluster sampling, systematic sampling, da sauransu.

math-el-sta2.title: Estimation da gwajin hypothesis
math-el-sta2.concept: Margin of error na 95% confidence interval ita ce $1.96\times\frac{σ}{\sqrt{n} }$. Idan absolute value na test statistic $z=\frac{\bar{x}-\mu}{σ/\sqrt{n} }$ ya fi 1.96, ana ƙin null hypothesis a significance level 5%.

math-h1-fnc1.title: Composite da inverse functions
math-h1-fnc1.concept: Ana ƙididdige composite function $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$ daga inner function zuwa waje. Idan $f(x)=y$, inverse function ɗin ita ce $f^{-1}(y)=x$.

math-h1-geo1.title: Siffofi a kan coordinate plane
math-h1-geo1.concept: Nisan points biyu shi ne $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$; midpoint shi ne mean na coordinates, slope kuma $\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.

math-h1-geo2.title: Equation na da'ira
math-h1-geo2.concept: Equation na da'ira mai center $(a, b)$ da radius $r$ ita ce $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$. Nisa tsakanin batu $(x_0,y_0)$ da layi $ax+by+c=0$ ita ce $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$.

math-h1-l1.title: Raba polynomials da remainder theorem
math-h1-l1.concept: Remainder na raba $P(x)$ da $x-a$ shi ne $P(a)$; idan $P(a)=0$, to $x-a$ factor ne.

math-h1-l2.title: Complex numbers da tantance quadratic equations
math-h1-l2.concept: $i^2=-1$. Idan discriminant $D=b^2-4ac<0$, equation ɗin tana da imaginary roots. Imaginary roots na quadratic equation mai real coefficients suna zuwa a matsayin conjugate complex-number pairs.

math-h1-l3.title: Quadratic inequalities
math-h1-l3.concept: Ana nemo mafita ta wurin da graf na quadratic function yake dangane da axis na $x$. $(x-a)(x-b)<0$ yana nufin tsakanin roots biyu; $>0$ yana nufin wajen roots biyun.

math-h1-l4.title: Permutations da combinations
math-h1-l4.concept: Idan jeri yana da muhimmanci, yi amfani da permutation $_nP_r$; idan jeri ba shi da muhimmanci, yi amfani da combination $_nC_r$. Don 'aƙalla guda ɗaya', cire complementary event daga duka.

math-h1-l5.title: Equations na layi da da'ira
math-h1-l5.concept: Nisa tsakanin batu da layi ita ce $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$; equation na circle shi ne $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$; tangent yana perpendicular da radius.
math-h1-l5.example: Slope na tangent a batu $(3,\ 4)$ na circle $x^2+y^2=25$ shi ne $=-\frac34$

math-h1-mat1.title: Ma'anar matrices da ayyukansu
math-h1-mat1.concept: **Matrix** tsari ne mai siffar rectangle na lambobi. A ƙari, ragi, da ninkawa da real number, ana lissafa entries masu matsayi iri ɗaya. Entry na (i, j) a cikin product $AB$ ana samunsa ta hanyar ninka entries na row i na $A$ da column j na $B$ ɗaya bayan ɗaya sannan a haɗa.

math-h1-pol1.title: Factoring da cubic da quartic equations
math-h1-pol1.concept: Ana warware cubic da quartic equations ta hanyar factoring da **synthetic division** ko substitution, sannan a nemo ƙimar da ke sa kowane factor ya zama 0. Ga quadratic factor, a duba ko yana da real roots ta amfani da discriminant.

math-h1-set1.title: Sets da propositions
math-h1-set1.concept: $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$, kuma set mai elements n yana da subsets $2^n$. Contrapositive na proposition 'if p then q' yana da truth value iri ɗaya da proposition ɗin asali, amma converse ɗinsa ba lallai ya yi daidai ba.

math-h2-geo1.title: Triangles da trigonometric functions
math-h2-geo1.concept: Sine rule ita ce $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$, cosine rule ita ce $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$, kuma faɗin triangle shi ne $\frac12ab\sin C$.

math-h2-geo2.title: Radian measure da sectors
math-h2-geo2.concept: $180^\circ=\pi$ radians. Ga sector mai radius $r$ da central angle $\theta$ (radians), tsawon arc ɗin shi ne $r\theta$, faɗin kuma $\frac12r^2\theta$.

math-h2-l1.title: Exponents da logarithms
math-h2-l1.concept: $\log_a b=x \iff a^x=b$. Jimillar logarithms tana daidai da logarithm na ninkin arguments; bambancin su kuma logarithm na rabon arguments ne. Ana wakiltar exponential growth da $a\cdot r^t$.

math-h2-l2.title: Trigonometric functions
math-h2-l2.concept: $\pi$ radians $=180^\circ$. Alamomin $\sin,\ \cos,\ \tan$ suna bambanta a kowane quadrant. Ga $y=a\sin bx+c$, maximum value ita ce $|a|+c$, period kuma $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$.

math-h2-l4.title: Limits da continuity na functions
math-h2-l4.concept: Idan an sami sigar $\frac00$, a factorize sannan a rage common factors; idan $x\to\infty$, a raba da highest-degree term. Idan function continuous ne, left-hand limit, right-hand limit da ƙimar function duk ɗaya suke.

math-h2-l5.title: Differentiation da yadda ake amfani da ita
math-h2-l5.concept: $(x^n)'=nx^{n-1}$. $f'(a)$ shi ne slope na tangent, kuma alamar $f'$ tana nuna ko function yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa da kuma local extrema. Velocity shi ne derivative na position.

math-h2-seq1.title: Jimillar sequence da alamar ∑
math-h2-seq1.concept: $\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k$ na nufin $a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n$. $\sum k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum c=cn$, kuma $\sum(a_k+b_k)=\sum a_k+\sum b_k$.

math-h3-cal1.title: Differentiation na functions iri-iri
math-h3-cal1.concept: Composite function: (derivative na outer function)×(derivative na inner function); quotient derivative ita ce $\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2}$. $(e^x)'=e^x$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$, $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$.

math-h3-cnt1.title: Permutations da combinations tare da repetition da binomial theorem
math-h3-cnt1.concept: Adadin **permutations tare da repetition** shi ne (adadin zaɓuɓɓuka) da aka ninka sau (adadin gurabe). Ga permutation mai abubuwa iri ɗaya, a raba factorial na jimillar abubuwa da factorials na abubuwan iri ɗaya. **Combinations tare da repetition** su ne $_nH_r={}_{n+r-1}C_r$. Coefficient na $x^k$ a cikin $(x+1)^n$ shi ne $_nC_k$.
math-h3-cnt1.example: Adadin hanyoyin jera aabbc shi ne $5!\div(2!\times2!)=30$

math-h3-geo1.title: Conic sections
math-h3-geo1.concept: Focus na parabola $y^2=4px$ shi ne $(p,0)$. Ga ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$, $c^2=a^2-b^2$; ga hyperbola, $c^2=a^2+b^2$.

math-h3-geo2.title: Plane vectors
math-h3-geo2.concept: Magnitude na vector $(x,y)$ ita ce $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$; inner product ita ce $x_1x_2+y_1y_2$, kuma idan vectors biyu suna tsaye da juna, inner product ɗinsu $0$ ne.

math-h3-l1.title: Indefinite da definite integrals
math-h3-l1.concept: $\int x^n dx=\frac{x^{n+1} }{n+1}+C$, $\int_a^b f(x)dx=F(b)-F(a)$. Idan aka musanya iyakokin sama da ƙasa, alamar amsa tana juyawa; ana kuma iya raba interval.

math-h3-l2.title: Amfanin definite integrals
math-h3-l2.concept: Domin nemo area, a integrate $|f(x)|$. A ware ɓangaren da graph yake ƙasa da x-axis, sannan a integrate (saman)−(ƙasa) domin area tsakanin curves biyu. Integral na velocity yana ba da nisan da aka yi.

math-h3-l3.title: Geometric series
math-h3-l3.concept: Idan $|r|<1$, series $\sum ar^{n-1}=\frac{a}{1-r}$ tana converge; idan $|r|\ge 1$, tana diverge. Ana amfani da ita wajen recurring decimals da motsin da ke maimaituwa.

math-h3-l4.title: Conditional probability da independent events
math-h3-l4.concept: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$. Idan events masu zaman kansu ne, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$; kuma binomial probability ga independent trials ita ce $_nC_k\,p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$.

math-h3-l5.title: Binomial da normal distributions
math-h3-l5.concept: Matsakaicin $B(n,p)$ shi ne $np$, variance ɗinsa kuma $np(1-p)$. Ana standardize normal distribution da $Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$, kuma tana daidaita game da matsakaici.

math-h3-pro1.title: Addition rule na probability da complementary events
math-h3-pro1.concept: $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Probability na complementary event ita ce $P(A^c)=1-P(A)$.

math-l1.title: Nemo ƙimar expression
math-l1.concept: Sanya lamba a madadin variable shi ake kira **substitution**. Sakamakon lissafin bayan substitution shi ne **ƙimar expression**. Idan za a saka negative number, yi amfani da brackets domin rage kuskure.

math-l2.title: Ka’idojin equations
math-l2.concept: Equation kamar **sikeli** ne. Idan aka ƙara ko cire lamba iri ɗaya a ɓangarorin biyu, ko aka ninka (da lambar da ba sifili ba) ko aka raba da ita, sikeli zai ci gaba da daidaita.
math-l2.example: Idan aka cire $5$ daga ɓangarorin biyu na $x+5=9$, ana samun $x=4$.

math-l3.title: Warware linear equations
math-l3.concept: Matsar da dukkan terms masu ɗauke da $x$ gefe ɗaya, lambobi kuma gefe na dabam ta hanyar **transposition**. Idan an matsar da term, alamar sa tana canzawa. A ƙarshe, a raba da coefficient na $x$.

math-l4.title: Warware matsala ta amfani da equation
math-l4.concept: A warware word problem ta wannan hanya: **a ɗauki abin da ake nema a matsayin $x$** → a mayar da jimla zuwa equation → a warware → a tabbatar amsar ta cika sharuɗɗan.
math-l4.example: Idan aka ƙara $2$ ga ninkin wani lamba da $3$, ana samun $14$ → $3x+2=14$ → $x=4$

math-m1-crd1.title: Coordinate plane
math-m1-crd1.concept: Ana nuna wurin maki da (x-coordinate, y-coordinate). Alamomin coordinates suna ƙayyade quadrant na 1 zuwa 4; reflection game da x-axis yana sauya alamar y-coordinate.

math-m1-fac1.title: Prime factorization, greatest common divisor da least common multiple
math-m1-fac1.concept: Bayyana integer mai kyau a matsayin ninkar prime numbers shi ne **prime factorization**. Mafi girman common divisor shi ne **greatest common divisor**, mafi ƙaramin common multiple kuma shi ne **least common multiple**.

math-m1-geo1.title: Ka’idojin kusurwoyi da polygons
math-m1-geo1.concept: Vertically opposite angles daidai suke; a layukan parallel, corresponding angles da alternate angles daidai suke. Jimillar interior angles na polygon mai gefe $n$ ita ce $180^\circ\times(n-2)$.

math-m1-geo2.title: Ma’aunin arc, sector da solid shapes
math-m1-geo2.concept: Tsawon arc $=2\pi r\times\frac{a}{360}$, faɗin sector $=\pi r^2\times\frac{a}{360}$, volume na sphere $=\frac43\pi r^3$, volume na cone kuma $=\frac13\pi r^2h$.

math-m1-neg1.title: Ayyukan lissafi da integers da rational numbers
math-m1-neg1.concept: Idan aka tara lambobi biyu masu alama iri ɗaya, a tara absolute values; idan alamominsu dabam ne, a cire ƙaramar absolute value daga babbar sannan a saka alamar lambar mafi girma. A multiplication da division, alamomi iri ɗaya suna ba da +, dabam kuma −.

math-m1-prp1.title: Direct da inverse proportion
math-m1-prp1.concept: **Direct proportion** yana da sigar y=ax; **inverse proportion** kuma $y=\frac{a}{x}$. A direct proportion, y÷x yana nan daram; a inverse proportion, x×y yana nan daram.
math-m1-prp1.example: Direct proportion mai y=6 idan x=2: y=3x

math-m1-sta1.title: Ƙimar wakilci da yawan faruwa na dangi
math-m1-sta1.concept: **Median** ita ce ƙimar da ke tsakiyar bayanai idan an jera su bisa girma; **mode** ita ce ƙimar da ta fi fitowa. **Yawan faruwa na dangi**=(yawan faruwa)÷(jimillar yawan faruwa).

math-m2-geo1.title: Halayen alwatika da murabba'i mai kusurwoyi huɗu
math-m2-geo1.concept: Kusurwoyin tushe biyu na alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai suna da girma ɗaya. A sifar layuka biyu-biyu masu goyon baya juna, jimillar kusurwoyi biyu maƙwabta ita ce $180^\circ$, kuma sashen da ya haɗa tsakiyar ɓangarori biyu na alwatika yana da tsawon $\frac12$ na ɓangaren da ya rage.

math-m2-geo2.title: Siffofi masu kamanni da ƙa'idar Pythagoras
math-m2-geo2.concept: A siffofi masu kamanni, rabon gefuna masu dacewa iri ɗaya ne, kuma rabon faɗi murabba'in rabon kamanni ne. A alwatika mai kusurwar dama, $a^2+b^2=c^2$.

math-m2-l1.title: Dokokin exponent da polynomial
math-m2-l1.concept: Idan tushe iri ɗaya ne, a ninka ƙarfi ta hanyar tara exponents; exponent na ƙarfi da aka ɗaga zuwa wani ƙarfi ana ninka su. A polynomial, a tattara kalmomin da ke da alama iri ɗaya kafin lissafi.

math-m2-l2.title: Tsarin ma'aunai layi biyu
math-m2-l2.concept: A kawar da alama ɗaya daga ma'aunai biyu domin nemo mafita. Zaɓi hanyar ƙari/cirewa ko maye gurbi bisa ga yanayin.

math-m2-l3.title: Rashin daidaito na layi
math-m2-l3.concept: A warware kamar halayen ma'auni, amma idan aka ninka ko raba da lamba mara kyau, alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito tana juyawa.

math-m2-l4.title: Aikin layi da jadawalinsa
math-m2-l4.concept: A cikin $y=ax+b$, $a$ shi ne gangare, $b$ kuma tsallaken $y$. Layuka masu daidaita suna da gangare iri ɗaya.

math-m2-l5.title: Adadin hanyoyi da yiwuwa
math-m2-l5.concept: Yiwuwar faruwa=(yawan hanyoyin da abin zai faru)÷(jimillar hanyoyi). Ga abubuwa masu zaman kansu da ke faruwa a lokaci guda, a ninka yiwuwarsu; ga 'aƙalla', a yi amfani da abin da ba zai faru ba.

math-m2-lfn1.title: Aikin layi da ma'aunin layi
math-m2-lfn1.concept: A cikin aikin layi y=ax+b, a shi ne gangare, b kuma tsallaken y. Makin haɗuwar jadawalai biyun ita ce mafitar tsarin ma'aunai.
math-m2-lfn1.example: Tsallaken x na y=2x−6 shi ne 3

math-m2-rec1.title: Decimal mai maimaitawa
math-m2-rec1.concept: Decimal mai lambobi iri ɗaya da ke ci gaba da maimaituwa bayan ɗigon decimal ana kiransa **decimal mai maimaitawa**, ɓangaren da ke maimaituwa kuma **jerin maimaitawa**. Idan ma'aunin kasan kaso mafi sauƙi yana da 2 da 5 kawai a matsayin masu ninkawa, decimal ɗin yana ƙarewa.

math-m3-geo1.title: Trigonometry na kusurwa
math-m3-geo1.concept: A cikin alwatika mai kusurwar dama, $\sin A$ shi ne (tsayin tsaye)÷(gefen mafi tsawo), $\cos A$ shi ne (tushe)÷(gefen mafi tsawo), $\tan A$ shi ne (tsayin tsaye)÷(tushe).

math-m3-geo2.title: Halayen da'ira
math-m3-geo2.concept: Kusurwar da'ira da ta yi daidai da baka ɗaya rabin kusurwar tsakiya ce. Tangent yana tsaye da radius, kuma jimillar kusurwoyin daura da juna na murabba'i mai kusurwoyi huɗu da aka zana a ciki da'ira ita ce $180^\circ$.

math-m3-l1.title: Tushen murabba'i da lambobin gaske
math-m3-l1.concept: $\sqrt{a}$ ita ce lamba marar kyau ba, wadda idan aka ɗaga ta zuwa murabba'i za a samu $a$. A fitar da cikakkun murabba'ai daga cikin alamar tushen, sannan a daidaita denominator mai tushen murabba'i.

math-m3-l2.title: Tsarin ninkawa da warwarewa zuwa masu ninkawa
math-m3-l2.concept: $(a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2$, $(a+b)(a-b)=a^2-b^2$. Warwarewa zuwa masu ninkawa ita ce amfani da tsarin ninkawa ta baya.

math-m3-l3.title: Ma'aunin digiri na biyu
math-m3-l3.concept: Yi amfani da warwarewa zuwa masu ninkawa domin samun siffar $AB=0$. Discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$ yana nuna yawan tushen, kuma za a iya amfani da dangantakar tushen da coefficients.

math-m3-l4.title: Aikin digiri na biyu da jadawalinsa
math-m3-l4.concept: Kololuwar $y=a(x-p)^2+q$ ita ce $(p,\ q)$, alamar $a$ tana ƙayyade ko parabola tana buɗe sama ko ƙasa. Idan aka mayar da ita cikakken murabba'i, za a iya nemo kololuwa.

math-m3-l5.title: Rabo trigonometri
math-m3-l5.concept: A cikin alwatika mai kusurwar dama, $\sin A=\frac{\text{gefen kishiya} }{\text{gefen mafi tsawo} }$, $\cos A=\frac{\text{gefen maƙwabtaka} }{\text{gefen mafi tsawo} }$, $\tan A=\frac{\text{gefen kishiya} }{\text{gefen maƙwabtaka} }$.

math-m3-sta1.title: Bambanci da karkacewar ma'auni
math-m3-sta1.concept: **Bambanci**=(ƙimar bayanai)−(matsakaici) ne. **Karkacewar ma'auni** ita ce matsakaicin murabba'in bambance-bambance, kuma **karkacewar ma'auni ta yau da kullum** ita ce tushen murabba'i mai kyau na karkacewar ma'auni. Yayin da ƙimarta ke ƙaruwa, bayanai suna ƙara watsewa daga matsakaici.

hints: Ka yi factorization domin rubuta lissafin a matsayin samfurin (linear factors). Hakanan za ka iya fara nemo tushe ta synthetic division.
Ƙimar x da ke sa kowace factor ta zama 0 ita ce tushen lissafin.

m-h1-pol1-2.prompt: Menene jimillar dukkan tushen gaske na lissafin $x^3-x^2-4x+4=0$?
m-h1-pol1-2.explanation: Tunda $(x-1)(x-2)(x+2)=0$, tushen gaske su ne $1,\ 2,\ -2$, kuma jimillarsu 1 ce.
hints: Ka yi factorization domin rubuta lissafin a matsayin samfurin (linear factors). Hakanan za ka iya fara nemo tushe ta synthetic division.
Ƙimar x da ke sa kowace factor ta zama 0 ita ce tushen lissafin.

m-h1-pol1-3.prompt: Tushen gaske daban-daban nawa ne lissafin $x^4-5x^2+4=0$ yake da su?
m-h1-pol1-3.explanation: Tunda $(x^2-1)(x^2-4)=0$, tushen gaske daban-daban su ne $\pm1,\ \pm2$, jimilla huɗu ne.
hints: Ka yi factorization domin rubuta lissafin a matsayin samfurin (linear factors) ko (quadratic factors).
Yi amfani da discriminant domin tantance ko quadratic $x^2+ax+b$ yana da tushen gaske.

m-h1-pol1-4.prompt: Lissafi $x^3-8=0$ yana da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam guda nawa?
m-h1-pol1-4.explanation: Tunda $(x-2)(x^2+2x+4)=0,\ D<0$, tushen ainihi dabam-dabam guda ɗaya ne, wato $2$.
hints: Fasa shi zuwa ninkuwar (lissafi na digiri na farko) ko (lissafi na digiri na biyu).
Yi amfani da diskriminant domin bincika ko lissafin digiri na biyu $x^2+ax+b$ yana da tushen ainihi.

m-h1-pol1-c.prompt: Menene tushen ainihi mafi girma na lissafi $x^4-10x^2+9=0$?
m-h1-pol1-c.explanation: Tunda $(x^2-1)(x^2-9)=0$, tushen ainihi su ne $\pm1,\ \pm3$, kuma mafi girma shi ne 3.
hints: Fasa shi zuwa ninkuwar lissafin digiri na farko. Hakanan za ka iya fara gano tushe ɗaya ta hanyar rarrabawa ta gajeriyar hanya.
Ƙimar x da ke sa kowanne ɓangaren ninkawa ya zama 0 ita ce tushen lissafin.

m-h1-pol1-v1.prompt: Menene jimillar duk tushen ainihi na lissafi $x^3-6x^2+11x-6=0$?
m-h1-pol1-v1.explanation: Tunda $(x-1)(x-2)(x-3)=0$, tushen ainihi su ne $1,\ 2,\ 3$, jimillarsu kuma 6 ce.

m-h1-pol1-v2.prompt: Lissafi $x^3+x=0$ yana da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam guda nawa?
m-h1-pol1-v2.explanation: Tunda $x(x^2+1)=0,\ D<0$, tushen ainihi dabam-dabam guda ɗaya ne, wato $0$.

m-h1-poly-5.prompt: Ragowar $P(x)$ idan aka raba da $x-1$ ita ce 3, idan aka raba da $x+2$ kuma ita ce -3. Idan ragowar $P(x)$ idan aka raba da $(x-1)(x+2)$ aka rubuta $ax+b$, menene ƙimar $a+b$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)

ai_bayesSpam.prompt: Daga cikin emails da aka karɓa, ${s}\%$ spam ne. ${p}\%$ na spam emails suna ɗauke da wata kalma, haka nan ${q}\%$ na emails da ba spam ba suna ɗauke da kalmar. hints: A ce akwai emails $100$ (ko $10000$) domin ƙirga yawan kowace irin email.
(Adadin spam mai ɗauke da kalmar) ÷ (jimillar emails mai ɗauke da kalmar).
ai_bayesSpam.explanation: A cikin emails $10000$, spam ${s2}$ ne, kuma ${a}$ daga cikinsu suna ɗauke da kalmar; daga cikin emails marasa spam ${h2}$, ${b}$ suna ɗauke da kalmar. Saboda haka yiwuwar ita ce $\frac{{a}}{{a}+{b}}$, kuma idan aka rage zuwa fraction mafi sauƙi ita ce ${fr}.$

ai_convolve.prompt: Ana matsar da filter $K={ker}$ mataki-mataki a kan image $I={img}$. A kowane wuri, ana ninka values ɗin da suka haɗu sannan a tara. Menene jimillar dukkan entries na matrix (feature map) da aka samu? Kada a ƙididdige wuraren da filter ya fita daga image, ko a cika su da zero. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Sanya filter a saman hagu na image; samfurin jimillar products na entries da suka yi daidai shi ne entry na farko na feature map.
Matsar da filter mataki ɗaya zuwa dama sannan ƙasa, kana maimaita wannan lissafin.
ai_convolve.explanation: Feature map ɗin ita ce ${out}$, kuma jimillar dukkan entries ita ce ${ans}.$

ai_cosine.prompt: A cikin documents A da B, frequency vector ɗin da ke nuna yawan kowace kalma cikin dictionary a jere shi ne $\vec{a}={va}$ da $\vec{b}={vb}$. Menene cosine similarity na documents ɗin biyu, $\dfrac{\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|}$? (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo dot product $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}$ ta ninka components daidai, sannan ka tara.
Magnitude na vectors biyu, $|\vec{a}|$ da $|\vec{b}|$, ana samun su ta hanyar ɗaukar square root na jimillar squares na components. Dukkansu natural numbers ne.

ai_flipTranspose.prompt: An nuna hasken pixel na image mai girma $3\times4$ da matrix $A={mat}$. Bari matrix $B$ ya zama hoton da aka juya hagu da dama ta hanyar juya tsarin values na kowane row na $A$. Bari $C$ ya zama transpose na $B$. Menene entry na row {i}, column {j} na $C$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Da farko rubuta kowane row na $A$ a baya domin gina $B$.
Transpose yana musanya rows da columns, saboda haka $C$ matrix ne mai girma $4\times3$.
ai_flipTranspose.explanation: Tunda $B={bm}$, $C={cm}$, entry na row {i}, column {j} ita ce ${ans}.$

ai_gradMse.prompt: Ana amfani da model $\hat{y}=wx$ domin yin prediction ga points {pts}. Loss function ita ce $L(w)=\dfrac{1}{n}\sum(wx_i-y_i)^2$ ($n$ shi ne yawan points). Idan aka yi amfani da gradient descent sau ɗaya a $w_0={w0}$ tare da learning rate $\eta={eta}$, menene ƙimar $w_1=w_0-\eta L'(w_0)$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: $L'(w)=\dfrac{2}{n}\sum x_i(wx_i-y_i)$.
Sanya $w=w_0$ domin fara nemo gradient $L'(w_0)$.

ai_gradStep.prompt: Idan loss function ita ce $L(w)={lw}$, ana son rage darajarta da gradient descent. Idan $w_{n+1}=w_n-\eta L'(w_n)$, learning rate $\eta={eta}$, kuma farkon ƙima $w_0={w0}$, menene ƙimar $w_{{t}}$ bayan updates {t}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo $L'(w)$.
Yi lissafin $w_1$, $w_2$, ... daga $w_0$ ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

ai_jaccard.prompt: An saka lambobi 1 zuwa 12 a gaban kalmomin ƙamus. Saitin lambobin kalmomin da suka bayyana a takarda A shi ne $A=\{{sa}\}$, na takarda B kuma $B=\{{sb}\}$. Menene ƙimar Jaccard similarity na takardun biyu $\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A\cup B)}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: $A\cap B$ shi ne saitin lambobin kalmomin da suka bayyana a takardun biyu.
$n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$.
ai_jaccard.explanation: Tunda $n(A\cap B)={ni}$, $n(A\cup B)={nu}$, rabon shi ne $\frac{{ni}}{{nu}}$; idan aka sauƙaƙa shi, zai zama ${fr}$.

ai_jaccardRev.prompt: Akwai kalmomi mabambanta ${na}$ a takarda A da ${nb}$ a takarda B. Idan saitunan kalmomin takardun su ne $A$, $B$, kuma Jaccard similarity $\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A\cup B)}$ ita ce $\dfrac{{jp}}{{jq}}$, kalmomi mabambanta nawa ne suka bayyana a takardun duka? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Idan yawan kalmomin da suke gama-gari shi ne $x$, to $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-x$.
Warware ma'aunin $\dfrac{x}{{na}+{nb}-x}=\dfrac{{jp}}{{jq}}$ game da $x$.

ai_mseLoss.prompt: Ga maki {pts}, menene ƙimar matsakaicin kuskuren murabba'i (MSE) na samfurin layi $\hat{y}={model}$: $\dfrac{1}{n}\sum(y_i-\hat{y}_i)^2$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo kuskure $y_i-\hat{y}_i$ a kowane maki.
Ɗaga kurakuran zuwa murabba'i, tara su, sannan raba da adadin maki $n={np}$.
ai_mseLoss.explanation: Kurakuran su ne ${res}$, jimillar murabba'insu kuma ${sq}$, saboda haka MSE ita ce $\frac{{tot}}{{np}}={ans}$.

ai_pixelBright.prompt: An wakilci hasken pixels na hoton baki da fari (0~255) ta matrix $A={mat}$. Domin ƙara haske, ana canja hasken kowane pixel $p$ zuwa $\min(255,\ {a}p+{b})$. (Ƙimomin da suka wuce 255 za su zama 255.) Menene jimillar dukkan sassan matrix ɗin hoton da aka canja? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Da farko lissafta ${a}p+{b}$ ga kowane sashe $p$, sannan mayar da shi 255 idan ya fi 255.
Rubuta sabon matrix gaba ɗaya, sannan tara dukkan sassansa.
ai_pixelBright.explanation: Sabon matrix shi ne $B={res}$, jimillar dukkan sassansa kuma ita ce ${ans}$.

hints: Nemo matsakaicin $x$, $\bar{x}$, da matsakaicin $y$, $\bar{y}$. Layin trend yana bi ta maki $(\bar{x},\bar{y})$.
Gangare $a=\dfrac{\sum(x_i-\bar{x})(y_i-\bar{y})}{\sum(x_i-\bar{x})^2}$.
ai_trendPredict.explanation: Tunda $\bar{x}={mx}$, $\bar{y}={my}$, $\sum(x_i-\bar{x})(y_i-\bar{y})={sxy}$, $\sum(x_i-\bar{x})^2={sxx}$, gangaren shi ne $a={sl}$. Daga $y-{my}={sl}(x-{mx})$, idan $x={x0}$, to $y={ans}$.

alg_arithFirstExceeds.prompt: Ga jerin lissafi mai kalmar farko ${a}$ da bambancin ${d}$, a ce jimillar kalmomi daga ta farko zuwa ta n-th ita ce $S_n$. Idan $S_n>{N}$, menene mafi ƙarancin ƙimar lambar natural $n$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Rubuta $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$ a matsayin polynomial digiri na biyu na $n$.
Warware rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu, ko gwada $n=1,2,3,\dots$ a jere har sai ka sami na farko da ya wuce iyakar.
alg_arithFirstExceeds.explanation: $S_n=\frac{n(2\times{ab}+(n-1)\times{d})}{2}$. Ga $n=1,2,\dots,{m1}$, $S_n$ duka bai wuce ${N}$ ba (mafi girma shi ne ${s1}$), amma $S_{{ans}}={s2}>{N}$, saboda haka $n$ da ake nema shi ne ${ans}$.

alg_arithGeoMix.prompt: Lambobi 3 $x$, $y$, $z$ suna samar da arithmetic sequence mai common difference positive a wannan jeri, kuma $x+y+z={S}$. A wannan lokacin, lambobi $x$, $y$, $z+{k}$ suna samar da geometric sequence a wannan jeri. Menene common difference? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan common difference ɗin shi ne $d$, to $x=y-d$, $z=y+d$, kuma $3y=S$.
Sanya su a cikin sharadin geometric sequence $y^{2}=x(z+k)$ don kafa quadratic equation game da $d$.
alg_arithGeoMix.explanation: $y=\frac{{S}}{3}={y}$, $x={y}-d$, kuma $z={y}+d$. Saboda haka, ${y}^{2}=({y}-d)({y}+d+{k})$, wato $d^{2}+{k}d-{yk}=0$. Tunda common difference positive ne, $d={ans}$.

alg_arithSumMax.prompt: A cikin arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, idan $a_{{p}}={u}$ da $a_{{q}}={v}$, menene mafi girman darajar jimillar $S_n$ daga term na farko zuwa na $n$? ($n$ natural number ne) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Duba alamar common difference. Jimilla tana ƙaruwa yayin da terms ɗin suke positive.
Nemo term na farko da common difference, sannan ka lissafa jimilla har zuwa term ɗin da ke gaban na farko da bai wuce 0 ba.
alg_arithSumMax.explanation: Term na farko shi ne ${a1}$, common difference kuma ${d}$. Saboda haka $a_n>0$ idan $n\le{nm}$, kuma $a_{{nm1}}\le0$. Don haka mafi girman jimilla ita ce $S_{{nm}}=\frac{{nm}(2\times{a1}+({nm}-1)\times({d}))}{2}={ans}$.

alg_arithTwoTerms.prompt: A cikin arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, idan $a_{{p}}={u}$ da $a_{{q}}={v}$, menene darajar $a_{{r}}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Yi amfani da $a_q-a_p=(q-p)d$ don nemo common difference $d$.
$a_r=a_p+(r-p)d$.
alg_arithTwoTerms.explanation: Common difference ita ce $d=\frac{{v}-{ub}}{{q}-{p}}={d}$. Saboda haka $a_{{r}}={u}+({r}-{p})\times{db}={ans}$.

alg_arithTwoTermsQ.prompt: A cikin arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, idan $a_{{p}}={u}$ da $a_{{q}}={v}$, menene darajar $a_{{r}}$? (Za ka iya rubuta shi a matsayin decimal ko fraction kamar 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da $a_q-a_p=(q-p)d$ don nemo common difference $d$.
$a_r=a_p+(r-p)d$.
alg_arithTwoTermsQ.explanation: Common difference ita ce $d=\frac{{v}-{ub}}{{q}-{p}}={d}$. Saboda haka $a_{{r}}={u}+({r}-{p})\times{db}={ans}$.

alg_circumradius.prompt: A cikin triangle ABC, $\overline{B C}={side}$ kuma ${cond}$ ne. Menene radius na circumcircle na triangle ABC? (Rubuta shi a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi. Idan integer ne, rubuta integer ɗin. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da sine rule $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$ ($a=\overline{B C}$).
Idan an bayar da cosine value, da farko nemo $\sin A$ ta amfani da cewa $\sin A>0$.
alg_circumradius.explanation: Tunda ${work}$, radius na circumcircle ita ce ${Rt}$.

alg_collatz.prompt: An ayyana sequence $\{a_n\}$ inda $a_1={s}$. Idan $a_n$ even ne, $a_{n+1}=\frac{a_{n}}{2}$; idan $a_n$ odd ne, $a_{n+1}={odd}$. Menene mafi ƙarancin natural number $n$ da zai sa $a_n=1$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nemo terms ɗin daga $a_1$ a jere, kana amfani da expression ɗin da ya dace da even ko odd.
Ƙirga index ɗin term na farko da ya zama $1$.
alg_collatz.explanation: Idan aka lissafa terms ɗin a jere, ana samun ${work}$; saboda haka term na farko da ya zama $1$ shi ne na ${ans}$.

alg_cosLawSide.prompt: A cikin triangle ABC, idan $\overline{B C}={a}$, $\overline{C A}={b}$, kuma ${cond}$, menene tsawon $\overline{A B}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Yi amfani da cosine rule $c^{2}=a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab\cos C$.
$\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos120^\circ=-\frac{1}{2}$, kuma tsawon yana positive.

alg_coterminal.prompt: Daga cikin kusurwoyin da suka yi daidai da kusurwar girma ${theta}$, kusurwar da take aƙalla $0^\circ$ amma ƙasa da $360^\circ$ digiri nawa ce? (Rubuta lamba a digiri kawai)
hints: Kusurwoyi masu jagora iri ɗaya suna bambanta da $360^\circ\times n$ (ko $2n\pi$).
Idan an bayar da kusurwar a radian, fara mayar da ita zuwa digiri ($\pi=180^\circ$).
alg_coterminal.explanation: Tunda ${work}$, kusurwar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}^\circ$.

alg_digitsPow.prompt: Idan ${given}$, nemo adadin lambobin da ke cikin ${N}$. (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Idan lamba cikakkiya mai kyau $M$ tana da lambobi $k$, to $k-1\le\log M<k$.
Lissafta common logarithm na ${N}$ ta amfani da ƙimar da aka bayar.
alg_digitsPow.explanation: $\log({N})={lg}$, ɓangaren lamba cikakkiya shi ne ${ip}$, saboda haka lamba mai lambobi ${ans}$ ce.

alg_expEquation.prompt: Menene jimillar duk tushen gaske na ma'aunin ${eq}$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Idan aka sanya sassan da ke da exponent iri ɗaya su zama $t$, za a samu ma'aunin digiri na biyu inda $t>0$.
Nemo ƙimar $t$, sannan mayar da kowanne zuwa ƙimar $x$.
alg_expEquation.explanation: Tunda ${work}$, jimillar tushen gaske ita ce ${ans}$.

alg_expFuncParams.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)=a\cdot b^{x}$ ($a\ne0$, $b>0$, $b\ne1$), idan $f({p})={u}$, $f({q})={v}$, menene ƙimar $f({r})$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo $b$ daga $\frac{f(q)}{f(p)}=b^{q-p}$.
Tunda $b>0$, akwai ƙima ɗaya tak ta $b$; sannan nemo $a$.

alg_expFuncParamsQ.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)=a\cdot b^{x}$ ($a\ne0$, $b>0$, $b\ne1$), idan $f({p})={u}$, $f({q})={v}$, menene ƙimar $f({r})$? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo $b$ daga $\frac{f(q)}{f(p)}=b^{q-p}$.
Tunda $b>0$, akwai ƙima ɗaya tak ta $b$; sannan nemo $a$.

alg_expInequality.prompt: Lambobin cikakku $x$ nawa ne daga cikin mafitar rashin daidaito ${ineq}$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Mayar da tushe su zama iri ɗaya, sannan kwatanta exponents. Idan tushe ya fi $1$, alkiblar rashin daidaiton ba ta canzawa.
Warware rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu game da exponent, sannan ƙirga mafitar lambobin cikakku.
alg_expInequality.explanation: Idan aka rubuta duka a matsayin ƙarfi mai tushe ${b}$, rashin daidaiton ga exponent shi ne ${work}$, kuma tushen wannan polynomial na digiri na biyu su ne ${rts}$. Lambobin cikakku $x$ da suka cika shi su ne ${xs}$, jimillarsu ${ans}$.

alg_expMaxMin.prompt: Idan iyakar $x$ ita ce ${s}\le x\le {t}$, menene mafi girman ƙimar aikin ${f}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta na exponent $g(x)$ (ta kololuwar aikin digiri na biyu da iyakokin tazara biyu).
Idan tushe ya fi $1$, ƙimar exponent mafi girma ce ke ba da ƙimar aikin mafi girma; idan tushe bai kai $1$ ba, ƙaramin exponent ne ke ba da mafi girma.

alg_expShiftA.prompt: Idan wani maki a kan jadawalin aikin ${f}$ shi ne $({p}, {q})$, menene ƙimar $a$ mai kyau ($a\ne1$)? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Saka coordinates ɗin maki cikin ma'auni don a bar ƙarfi ɗaya na $a$.
Tunda $a>0$ kuma exponent ɗin ba 0 ba ne, akwai ƙima ɗaya tak ta $a$.

alg_expSum.prompt: Ga lambar gaske $x$, idan ${given}$, menene ƙimar ${ask}$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Sanya $t=$ (kalmar farko da aka bayar); kalma ta biyu za ta zama $\frac{1}{t}$.
Ɗaga sharadin da aka bayar zuwa murabba'i ko cube domin danganta shi da abin da ake nema.
alg_expSum.explanation: Idan aka sanya kalmar farko ta sharadin ta zama $t$ sannan aka yi amfani da ƙa'idar ninkawa, za a samu ${work}$.

alg_geoSumRatio.prompt: A ce jimillar geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ daga term na farko zuwa term na n ita ce $S_n$. Idan $S_{{n1}}={u}$ da $S_{{n2}}={v}$, menene ƙimar $S_{{n3}}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Kamar yadda $S_{2m}=S_m+r^{m}S_m$, jimillar ɓangaren gaba ita ce jimillar farkon da aka ninka da $r^{m}$.
Da farko nemo ƙimar $r^{{n1}}$; ba sai an nemo $r$ shi kaɗai ba.

alg_geoTwoTerms.prompt: A cikin geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ mai common ratio mai kyau, idan $a_{{p}}={u}$ da $a_{{q}}={v}$, menene ƙimar $a_{{r}}$? (Rubuta lamba a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: (term na baya)÷(term na farko) = common ratio $r$ da aka ɗaga zuwa (bambancin lambobin term).
Sharadin cewa common ratio mai kyau ne yana ƙayyade ƙimar $r$ guda ɗaya.

alg_geoTwoTermsQ.prompt: A cikin geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ mai common ratio mai kyau, idan $a_{{p}}={u}$ da $a_{{q}}={v}$, menene ƙimar $a_{{r}}$? (Rubuta lamba a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: (term na baya)÷(term na farko) = common ratio $r$ da aka ɗaga zuwa (bambancin lambobin term).
Sharadin cewa common ratio mai kyau ne yana ƙayyade ƙimar $r$ guda ɗaya.

alg_growthYears.prompt: Ana saka kuɗi a banki bisa compound interest na shekara ${rate}\%$, kuma ana ƙara interest zuwa principal a kowace shekara. Nemo bayan shekaru nawa, a matsayin integer, jimillar principal da interest za ta kai aƙalla sau ${k}$ na principal a karo na farko. An bayar da common logarithm ${given}$. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Bayan shekaru $n$, jimillar principal da interest = principal × $(1+\frac{r}{100})^{n}$.
Idan aka ɗauki common logarithm ga bangarorin biyu, $n\log(1+\frac{r}{100})\ge\log k$.
alg_growthYears.explanation: Idan aka ɗauki common logarithm ga bangarorin biyu na $({one})^{n}\ge {k}$, ana samun $n\ge\frac{{lk}}{{l1}}={q}$; saboda haka mafi ƙaramin positive integer $n$ shi ne ${ans}.$

alg_inverseGraph.prompt: Point ɗaya a kan jadawalin inverse function na ${f}$ shi ne $({p}, {q})$. Menene positive value $a$ ($a\ne1$)? (Rubuta lamba a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Idan jadawalin inverse function ya wuce ta point $(p, q)$, jadawalin original function yana wucewa ta point $(q, p)$.
Sanya wannan point cikin original function domin samo equation na $a$.
alg_inverseGraph.explanation: Tunda point a jadawalin inverse function shi ne $({p},{q})$, point a jadawalin original function shi ne $({q},{p})$. ${work}.$

alg_inversePoints.prompt: A kan jadawalin inverse function na $f(x)=a^{x}+b$ ($a>1$, $b$ integer ne), points biyu su ne $({p1}, {q1})$ da $({p2}, {q2})$. Menene ƙimar $a+b$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan jadawalin inverse function ya wuce ta point $(p, q)$, jadawalin $f$ yana wucewa ta $(q, p)$.
Sanya points biyu a cikin $f$ domin kafa equations biyu, sannan ka cire equation ɗaya daga ɗayan don kawar da $b$ ka samu equation na $a$. Zaɓi mafita da ke da $a>1$.
alg_inversePoints.explanation: Points biyu a jadawalin $f$ su ne $({q1},{p1})$, $({q2},{p2})$. ${work},$ saboda haka $a+b={ans}$.

hints: Yi amfani da change-of-base formula $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$ domin logarithms maƙwabta su soke juna.
Rage dukan samfur zuwa logarithm guda, sannan ka rubuta argument a matsayin power.

alg_logChainQ.prompt: Nemo ƙimar nan: ${expr}$ (Rubuta lamba a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da change-of-base formula $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$ domin logarithms maƙwabta su soke juna.
Rage dukan samfur zuwa logarithm guda, sannan ka rubuta argument a matsayin power.

alg_logDomain.prompt: Lambobi cikakku nawa ne $x$ da ke cikin yankin aikin ${f}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Mai ƙididdigewa na logarithm dole ya zama mai kyau, yayin da abin da ke cikin tushen murabba'i dole ne ya kai $0$ ko ya fi haka.
Warware rashin daidaito domin nemo kewayon $x$, sannan ka ƙirga lambobi cikakku da ke cikinsa.

alg_logEquation.prompt: Menene ƙimar ainihin tushen $x$ na lissafi ${eq}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko bincika sharadin mai ƙididdigewa ${dom}$.
Haɗa jimillar logarithm zuwa logarithm guda, sannan ka kafa lissafin digiri na biyu na mai ƙididdigewa.
alg_logEquation.explanation: Daga sharadin mai ƙididdigewa, ana samun ${dom}$. Tunda ${work}$, daga cikin waɗannan mafita, wanda ya cika sharadin mai ƙididdigewa shi ne $x={ans}$.

alg_logExpress.prompt: Idan $\log_{2}3=a$ da $\log_{2}5=b$, rubuta $\log_{2}{N}$ a matsayin $xa+yb+z$ (inda $x, y, z$ kasrori ne). Menene ƙimar $x+y+z$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Manyan ɓangarorin mai ƙididdigewa ${N}$ su ne 2, 3 da 5 kawai. Gwada bayyana shi a matsayin ƙarfin lambobi.
Yi amfani da $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$ da $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, sannan ka lura cewa $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logExpressQ.prompt: Idan $\log_{2}3=a$ da $\log_{2}5=b$, rubuta $\log_{2}{N}$ a matsayin $xa+yb+z$ (inda $x, y, z$ kasrori ne). Menene ƙimar $x+y+z$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Manyan ɓangarorin mai ƙididdigewa ${N}$ su ne 2, 3 da 5 kawai. Gwada bayyana shi a matsayin ƙarfin lambobi.
Yi amfani da $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$ da $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, sannan ka lura cewa $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logInequality.prompt: A cikin mafitar rashin daidaito ${ineq}$, lambobi cikakku nawa ne $x$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko bincika sharadin mai ƙididdigewa (mai ƙididdigewa dole ya zama mai kyau).
Idan tushe ya ƙasa da $1$, alamar rashin daidaiton tana juya lokacin da aka cire logarithm.

alg_obtuseCount.prompt: Lambobi nawa ne na halitta $x$ da ke sa a samu alwatika mai kusurwa fiye da dama, wanda tsawon gefunansa su ne ${a}$, ${b}$, da $x$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Domin a samu alwatika, tsawon mafi dogon gefe dole ya gaza jimillar sauran gefuna biyun.

Domin kusurwa ta fi dama, murabba'in mafi dogon gefe dole ya fi jimillar murabba'in sauran gefuna biyun. Raba batun zuwa lokacin da $x$ shi ne mafi dogon gefe da lokacin da gefen tsawon ${b}$ ya fi tsawo.
alg_obtuseCount.explanation: Tunda ${work}$, akwai lambobi na halitta ${ans}$ na $x$.

alg_rationalExp.prompt: Nemo ƙimar da ke biye: ${expr}$ (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Gwada bayyana tushe a matsayin ƙarfin wata lamba.
Yi amfani da dokar ƙarfin $(c^{q})^{\frac{p}{q}}=c^{p}$ da $(a^{m})^{n}=a^{m\times n}$; mayar da ƙarfin mara kyau ta hanyar $a^{-n}=\frac{1}{a^{n}}$.

alg_realRootCount.prompt: Ga lamba cikakkiya $n$ da ta kai aƙalla $2$, a kira adadin ainihin ƙimomin $x$ da suka cika $x^{n}=A$ da $f(n)$. Idan $A={rad}$, menene ƙimar $f(2)+f(3)+\cdots+f({N})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Yi tunani dabam ga lokacin da $n$ ma'aurata ne da lokacin da yake mara ma'aurata.
Dangane da alamar $A$, ga ma'auratan $n$, $f(n)=2$ ko $0$; ga marasa ma'aurata kuwa $f(n)=1$.
alg_realRootCount.explanation: Idan $A$ mai kyau ne, ga ma'auratan $n$, $f(n)=2$, ga marasa ma'aurata kuma $f(n)=1$. Idan $A$ mara kyau ne, ga ma'auratan $n$, $f(n)=0$, ga marasa ma'aurata kuma $f(n)=1$. Ƙirga adadin $n$ ma'aurata da marasa ma'aurata domin samun ${work}$.

alg_recAffine.prompt: Idan aka ayyana jerin lambobi $\{a_n\}$ da $a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), menene ƙimar $a_{{k}}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nemo ƙimomin $a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
Rubuta lambar ajali da ƙimarsa a jadawali, sannan ka yi amfani da ƙa'idar mataki-mataki har ka kai $a_{{k}}$. Idan ka sami kasr, sauƙaƙa shi.

alg_recAffineQ.prompt: Idan aka ayyana jerin lambobi $\{a_n\}$ da $a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), menene ƙimar $a_{{k}}$? (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko kasr kamar 3/4)
hints: Nemo ƙimomin $a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
Rubuta lambar ajali da ƙimarsa a jadawali, sannan ka yi amfani da ƙa'idar mataki-mataki har ka kai $a_{{k}}$. Idan ka sami kasr, sauƙaƙa shi.

alg_recParam.prompt: Idan aka ayyana jerin lambobi $\{a_n\}$ da $a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}=pa_n+{q}$ ($n\ge1$, $p$ mai kyau ne), kuma $a_3={t}$, menene ƙimar $p$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Bayyana $a_2$ da $a_3$ ta amfani da $p$.
$a_3$ zai zama lissafin digiri na biyu mai ɗauke da $p$. Zaɓi tushen mai kyau.

alg_rootEval.prompt: Nemo ƙimar da ke biye: ${expr}$ (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Bayyana lambar da ke cikin tushen murabba'i a matsayin ƙarfin wata lamba.
Yi amfani da ƙa'idar da ta dace daga $\sqrt[n]{a}\sqrt[n]{b}=\sqrt[n]{a\times b}$, $\frac{\sqrt[n]{a}}{\sqrt[n]{b}}=\sqrt[n]{\frac{a}{b}}$, ko $\sqrt[m]{\sqrt[n]{a}}=\sqrt[mn]{a}$.

alg_sectorForward.prompt: Idan radius na fanka yana da tsawon ${r}$ cm kuma kusurwar tsakiyarsa ${th}$ ce, kuma tsawon baka shi ne $a\pi$ cm da faɗi shi ne $b\pi$ cm$^{2}$, menene ƙimar $a+b$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Idan aka mayar da kusurwar tsakiya zuwa radian, tsawon baka $l=r\theta$, faɗi kuma $S=\frac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta$.
Da farko nemo sau nawa $\theta$ ya ƙunshi $\pi$.

alg_sectorPerimArea.prompt: Akwai fanka biyu masu kewayen ${P}$ cm da faɗin ${S}$ cm$^{2}$ (kusurwar tsakiya ta gaza $2\pi$). Menene radius na fanka mai radius mafi girma, a cm? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan radius shi ne $r$ kuma tsawon baka shi ne $l$, kewaye shi ne $2r+l$, faɗi kuma $\frac{1}{2}rl$.
Idan aka kawar da $l$, ana samun lissafin digiri na biyu mai ɗauke da $r$.
alg_sectorPerimArea.explanation: Daga $2r+l={P}$ da $\frac{1}{2}rl={S}$, idan aka kawar da $l$, ana samun ${work}$; saboda haka radius mafi girma shi ne ${ans}$ cm.

alg_seqIntTerms.prompt: Idan ƙa'idar ajali na gaba ɗaya ta jerin lambobi $\{a_n\}$ ita ce $a_n=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$, ajali nawa ne lambobi cikakku? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Raba mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa domin samun siffar $a_n=k+\frac{c}{n+r}$ ($k$ lamba cikakkiya ce, $c$ akai-akai ne).
Ƙirga masu rabin akai-akai waɗanda za su iya zama mai ƙididdigewa $n+r$ (ga lamba ta halitta $n$, $n+r\ge{r1}$).
alg_seqIntTerms.explanation: Tunda ${work}$, ajali ${ans}$ ne duka suke lambobi cikakku.

alg_seriesPattern.prompt: Nemo ƙimar jimillar da ke biye: ${expr}$ (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nemo ƙa'idar, sannan bayyana ajali na gaba ɗaya $a_k$ ta amfani da $k$.
Lissafta ta amfani da ƙa'idodi na $\sum k$, $\sum k^{2}$ da sauransu (idan alamun suna sauyawa, haɗa ajali biyu-biyu).

alg_sigmaSquare.prompt: Ga jerin lambobi biyu $\{a_n\}$ da $\{b_n\}$, idan $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_k^{2}={A}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_kb_k={B}$, kuma $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}b_k^{2}={C}$, menene darajar $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}({comb})^{2}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Faɗaɗa ta hanyar ɗaga abin da ke cikin baka zuwa murabba’i.
Yi amfani da ka’idar layi ta $\sum$ ($\sum(pa_k+qb_k)=p\sum a_k+q\sum b_k$) don bayyana shi ta hanyar jimloli ukun da aka bayar.

alg_sigmaSubseq.prompt: Idan kalmar gaba ɗaya ta jerin $\{a_n\}$ ita ce $a_n={an}$, menene darajar $\sum_{k=1}^{{m}}a_{{idx}}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: A cikin $a_n$, abin da za a saka a wurin $n$ shi ne ${idx}$. Saka shi domin a samu furuci dangane da $k$.
Yi amfani da $\sum k=\frac{m(m+1)}{2}$, $\sum k^{2}=\frac{m(m+1)(2m+1)}{6}$, da $\sum c=cm$.

alg_sigmaTelescope.prompt: Nemo darajar jimlar da ke biye: ${expr}$ (Rubuta ta a matsayin kasr mai sauƙaƙe. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta cikakkiyar lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Gwada raba kowace kalma zuwa kasrori masu sauƙi. Misali: $\frac{1}{k(k+1)}=\frac{1}{k}-\frac{1}{k+1}$.
Idan aka tara su, kalmomin da ke tsakiyar jere za su soke juna a jere; na farko kaɗan da na ƙarshe kaɗan ne kawai za su rage.

alg_sumToTerm.prompt: Idan jimillar daga kalma ta farko zuwa kalma ta $n$ ta jerin $\{a_n\}$ ita ce $S_n={expr}$, menene darajar $a_{1}+a_{{k}}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: $a_1=S_1$, kuma idan $n\ge2$, $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.
Kada ka ɗauka cewa saka $n=1$ cikin furucin $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$ zai ba da $S_1$.

alg_survey.prompt: Nisan da ke tsakanin wurare A da B shi ne ${d} m. Idan aka duba daga wani wuri C, $\angle CAB=\alpha$, $\angle CBA=\beta$, kuma $\sin\alpha={sa}$, $\sin\beta={sb}$ ($\alpha$, $\beta$ ƙananan kusurwoyi ne). Nawa ne nisan daga A zuwa C, a m? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)$
hints: Tun da $\angle C=180^\circ-\alpha-\beta$, $\sin C=\sin(\alpha+\beta)$.

Daga $\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta$, nemo cosine ta amfani da $\cos=\sqrt{1-\sin^{2}}$. Sannan yi amfani da dokar sine $\frac{\overline{A C}}{\sin\beta}=\frac{\overline{A B}}{\sin C}$.
alg_survey.explanation: Tun da ${work}$, nisan daga A zuwa C shi ne ${ans} m.$

alg_trigGraphParam.prompt: Idan mafi girman darajar aikin $y=a{fn}\,bx+c$ ($a>0$, $b>0$) ita ce ${M}$, mafi ƙanƙanta ita ce ${m}$, kuma zagayowar sa ita ce ${per}$, menene samfurin ƙananan lambobi uku $abc$? (Rubuta shi a matsayin kasr mai sauƙaƙe. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta cikakkiyar lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Mafi girman daraja ita ce $a+c$, mafi ƙanƙanta kuma ita ce $-a+c$.
Yi amfani da cewa tsawon zagayowar shi ne $\frac{2\pi}{b}$ domin nemo $b$.

alg_trigIdentity.prompt: Ga ainihin lamba $\theta$, idan ${given}$, menene darajar ${E}? (Rubuta shi a matsayin kasr mai sauƙaƙe. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta cikakkiyar lambar. Misali: 3/4)$
hints: $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$. Idan aka ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu na daidaiton da aka bayar zuwa murabba’i, $\sin\theta\cos\theta$ zai bayyana.

Ɗaga daidaiton da aka bayar zuwa murabba’i don nemo darajar $\sin\theta\cos\theta$. Idan furucin da ake nema wani furuci ne na murabba’i, yi amfani da wannan hanyar wajen bayyana shi ta hanyar $\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

alg_trigPeriod.prompt: Idan mafi ƙarancin period mai kyau na aikin ${f}$ shi ne $k\pi$, menene ƙimar $k$? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Period na $y=\sin bx$, $y=\cos bx$ shi ne $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$, na $y=\tan bx$ kuma $\frac{\pi}{|b|}$.
Idan akwai ƙimar absolute, ɓangaren jadawalin da ke ƙasa yana ninkewa sama, don haka period ya zama rabinsa. Mayar da murabba'in zuwa $\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos2x}{2}$, $\cos^{2}x=\frac{1+\cos2x}{2}$.

alg_trigPoint.prompt: A ce girman kusurwa ita ce $\theta$, inda initial ray ɗinsa yake kan hanyar axis $x$ mai kyau kuma maki ɗaya a kan terminal ray shi ne P$({xp}, {yp})$. Menene ƙimar ${E}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo tazara daga origin O zuwa maki P: $r=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$ (idan coordinates na P su ne $(x, y)$).
$\sin\theta=\frac{y}{r}$, $\cos\theta=\frac{x}{r}$, $\tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}$.

alg_trigRootCount.prompt: A cikin $0\le\theta<2\pi$, menene yawan tushen gaske mabambanta na ma'aunin ${eq}$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Sanya $k\theta=\phi$; to tazarar $\phi$ ita ce $0\le\phi<2k\pi$.
Ƙirga adadin inda jadawalin $y=\sin\phi$ da makamantansa ke haɗuwa da layin $y=$ (constant), a kowane period.

alg_trigSpecial.prompt: Nemo ƙimar mai zuwa: ${expr}$ (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko kaso kamar 3/4)
hints: Mayar da kusurwar zuwa kusurwar da ke tsakanin $0^\circ$ da $360^\circ$ (kusurwar da initial/terminal rays ɗinta suka yi daidai).
Yi amfani da $\sin30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\tan45^\circ=1$ da alamomin trigonometry a kowane quadrant.

bm_absIneq.prompt: Daga cikin mafitar rashin daidaito ${ineq}$, lambobin cikakku $x$ nawa ne suka cika $-{N}\le x\le {N}$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Da farko tantance ko ƙimar absolute tana ƙasa ko sama da wani adadi.
Idan ƙasa ce, mayar da ita zuwa $-c<A<c$; idan sama ce, mayar da ita zuwa $A<-c$ ko $A>c$. Nemo tazarar x, sannan ƙirga lambobin cikakku a cikin iyakar da aka bayar.
bm_absIneq.explanation: Idan aka warware ƙimar absolute, mafitar ${ineq}$ ita ce ${sol}$. Daga ciki, lambobin cikakku daga ${N} ƙasa zuwa ${N} sama su ne ${ans}$.

bm_circleLine.prompt: Da'ira: ${circ}$, layi: ${line}$; lambobin cikakku $m$ nawa ne suke sa su haɗu a maki biyu mabambanta? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Saka ma'aunin layin cikin ma'aunin da'ira, za a samu ma'aunin digiri na biyu a kan $x$.
Domin su haɗu a maki biyu mabambanta, ma'aunin digiri na biyu dole ne ya sami tushen gaske biyu mabambanta. Daga discriminant $D>0$, nemo tazarar $m$, sannan ƙirga lambobin cikakku.
bm_circleLine.explanation: Idan aka saka ma'aunin layin cikin ma'aunin da'ira, za a samu ${sub}=0$. Idan discriminant shi ne $D$, to $\frac{D}{4}={d4}$, don haka daga $D>0$ za a samu ${cond}$. Tunda ${chk}$, lambobin cikakku $m$ daga -${hi}$ zuwa ${hi}$ ne, jimillarsu ${ans}$.

bm_compUnknown.prompt: Ga ayyuka biyu $f(x)={f}$ da $g$, idan aikin haɗe-haɗe $(g\circ f)(x)={h}$ ne, menene ƙimar $g({k})$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Domin nemo ƙimar $g({k})$, nemo $x$ da zai sa $f(x)={k}$.
Saka wannan $x$ cikin aikin haɗe-haɗe $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$.
bm_compUnknown.explanation: Daga $f(x)={k}$ ana samun $x={x0}$. Tunda $(g\circ f)({x0})=g(f({x0}))=g({k})$, ƙimar lokacin $x={x0}$ daga ma'aunin $g({k})={h}$ ita ce ${ans}$.

bm_countDigits.prompt: Akwai katuna guda ${n}$, kowacce tana da lamba dabam-dabam, kuma lambobin da ke jikin katunan su ne ${ds}$. Katuna nawa ne za a iya zaɓa a jera su a layi domin a samar da lambobi na halitta masu lambobi uku waɗanda suke ma'aurata? (Ba za a iya sanya 0 a farkon lamba ba. Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Lambar wuri na ɗaya daga dama dole ta zama ma'aurata. Da farko zaɓi lambar wurin na ɗaya daga dama, sannan ka cike sauran wuraren.

Raba su zuwa yanayi biyu: idan lambar wuri na ɗaya daga dama ita ce 0 da kuma idan lambar ce ma'aurata wadda ba 0 ba, sannan ka ƙirga yawan jeren lambobi. Idan lamba ma'aurata wadda ba 0 ba ta zo a wurin na ɗaya daga dama, ba za a iya sanya 0 a farkon lamba ba.
bm_countDigits.explanation: Idan lambar wuri na ɗaya daga dama ita ce 0: za a zaɓi sauran wurare biyu daga katuna ${n1}$ da suka rage a jera su, don haka akwai ${zex}$. Idan lambar wuri na ɗaya daga dama lamba ma'aurata ce wadda ba 0 ba: za a zaɓi wannan wurin daga katunan lambobi ma'aurata ${nz}$ da ba 0 ba; za a zaɓi wurin farko daga cikin katuna ${n2}$ da suka rage, ban da 0; sannan za a zaɓi wurin tsakiya daga cikin katuna ${n2}$ da suka rage, don haka akwai ${oex}$. Bisa ƙa'idar haɗawa, ${z}+{o}={ans}$.

bm_discK.prompt: A cikin ƙimomin lamba k waɗanda ke sa jadawalin aikin ƙwadratiki $y={f}$ ya haɗu da aksin $x$ a wurare biyu dabam-dabam, nawa ne suke cika $-{N}\le k\le {N}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Jadawalin ya haɗu da aksin $x$ a wurare biyu dabam-dabam yana nufin cewa ma'aunin ƙwadratiki $y=0$ yana da tushen lamba ta ainihi biyu dabam-dabam.
Nemo zangon $k$ da ke sa diskriminant $D$ ya fi 0, sannan ka ƙirga cikakkun lambobin da ke cikin zangon da aka bayar.
bm_discK.explanation: Domin samun tushen lamba ta ainihi biyu dabam-dabam, diskriminant $D={D}$ dole ya cika ${D}>0$, saboda haka ${cond}$. Cikakkun lambobin $k$ da suka cika wannan sharadi a cikin $-{N}\le k\le {N}$ su ne ${ans}$.

bm_funcCount.prompt: Saiti $X$ ya ƙunshi dukkan lambobin halitta da ba su wuce ${m}$ ba, sannan saiti $Y$ ya ƙunshi dukkan lambobin halitta da ba su wuce ${n}$ ba. Daga cikin ayyuka $f$ daga $X$ zuwa $Y$ waɗanda ke cika $f(1)=1$, nawa ne ba ayyukan ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Idan $f(1)=1$, ana iya zaɓar darajar aikin ga kowanne ɗayan sauran abubuwa da yardar rai daga abubuwan da ke cikin $Y$.
Yi lissafi ta hanyar: (dukkan ayyukan da suka cika sharadin) $-$ (ayyukan ɗaya-da-ɗaya a cikinsu). A cikin aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya, darajojin abubuwa dabam-dabam duk sun bambanta.
bm_funcCount.explanation: Ga ayyukan da ke da $f(1)=1$, kowanne daga cikin sauran abubuwa ${m1}$ na iya ɗaukar kowace daga cikin darajoji ${n}$, don haka akwai ${tot}$. Daga cikinsu, ayyukan ɗaya-da-ɗaya su ne ${inj}$, domin sauran abubuwan dole su sami darajoji dabam-dabam waɗanda ba 1 ba. Saboda haka ${tot}-${inj}=${ans}$.

bm_ineqSystem.prompt: Daga cikin hanyoyin da suka zama gama-gari ga rashin daidaiton layi na farko ${i1}$ da ${i2}$, x nawa ne cikakkun lambobi? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Warware kowanne rashin daidaito daban-daban domin fara nemo zangon $x$.
Nuna ɓangaren da zangunan biyu suka yi tarayya a kai a kan layin lambobi, sannan ka ƙirga cikakkun lambobin da ke cikinsa. Idan an ninka ko an raba da lamba mara kyau, juya alamar rashin daidaito.
bm_ineqSystem.explanation: Idan an warware rashin daidaito na farko, ana samun ${s1}$; na biyu kuma ana samun ${s2}$. Cikakkun lambobin da ke cikin zangon gama-gari su ne ${ints}$, don haka jimillarsu ${ans}$ ne.

bm_lineParPerp.prompt: Akwai layi $L:{L}$ kuma daidaitattun ma'aunan batu $\mathrm{P}$ su ne $({x0},{y0})$. Idan y-intercept na layin da ya bi ta batu $\mathrm{P}$ kuma ya yi layi ɗaya da $L$ shi ne $s$, sannan y-intercept na layin da ya bi ta batu $\mathrm{P}$ kuma ya yi tsaye da $L$ shi ne $t$, menene ƙimar $s+t$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Gangaren layi mai siffar $ax+by+c=0$ ita ce $-\frac{a}{b}$, kuma ninkar gangaren layuka biyu masu tsaye da juna ita ce $-1$.
Layin da yake layi ɗaya yana da ma'aunan $x$ da $y$ iri ɗaya, yayin da layin da yake tsaye yake da siffar $bx-ay=k$ ($k$ tsayayye ne). Sanya ma'aunan batu P domin nemo $k$.
bm_lineParPerp.explanation: Layin da yake layi ɗaya shi ne ${par}$, kuma idan an sanya $x=0$, ana samun $s={s}$. Layin da yake tsaye shi ne ${perp}$, kuma idan an sanya $x=0$, ana samun $t={t}$. Saboda haka $s+t={ans}$.

bm_matUnknown.prompt: Ga matiriksi $A={A}$, $B={B}$, da $C={C}$, idan ${ex}=C$ ya cika, menene ƙimar jimillar lambobin ainihi $x$ da $y$, wato $x+y$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Domin matiriksi biyu su zama daidai, abubuwan da suke a wuri ɗaya dole su zama daidai.
Yi amfani da abin da ke ɗauke da $x$ wajen kafa ma'aunin layi na farko, sannan ka nemo $x$; ka nemo $y$ ta wannan hanya.
bm_matUnknown.explanation: Idan aka kwatanta abin da ke ɗauke da $x$, ana samun ${eqx}$, saboda haka $x={xv}$. Idan aka kwatanta abin da ke ɗauke da $y$, ana samun ${eqy}$, saboda haka $y={yv}$. Don haka $x+y={ans}$.

bm_polyExpand.prompt: Idan aka tsara faɗaɗɗen sakamakon ${expr}$ bisa saukowa na ikon $x$, menene jimillar coefficient na $x^2$ da constant term? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Faɗaɗa kowace ninkawa dabam, sannan ka haɗa terms masu kama da juna.
Yin amfani da tsarin ninkawa $(ax+b)^2=a^2x^2+2abx+b^2$ yana sauƙaƙa. Kada ka manta da alamar da coefficient da ke a gaba.
bm_polyExpand.explanation: Tunda $({e1}){op}({e2})$, bayan tsarawa za a samu ${total}$. Coefficient na $x^2$ shi ne ${c2}$, constant term kuma ${c0}$; saboda haka jimillar ita ce ${ans}$.

bm_polyFactor.prompt: Faɗaɗɗen polynomial na digiri na biyu ${Pex}$ yana da sakamakon factoring $(ax+b)(cx+d)$. $a$, $b$, $c$, da $d$ integers ne, kuma $a>0$, $c>0$, $a\le c$; idan $a=c$, to $b\le d$. Nawa ne $a+b+c+d$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ka yi tunanin nau'i-nau'in integers da za su iya samar da constant term $bd$ da coefficient na $x^2$, wato $ac$.
Zaɓi candidate guda, ka faɗaɗa, sannan ka tabbatar ko coefficient na $x$ da aka samu ya yi daidai da $ad+bc$.
bm_polyFactor.explanation: Tunda ana factor ${Pex}=({f1})({f2})$, $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$, $d={d}$ ne, saboda haka $a+b+c+d={ans}$.

bm_propRange.prompt: Game da sharuɗɗa biyu $p:{pc}$ da $q: m\le x\le {n}$ na real number $x$, menene mafi girman integer $m$ da zai sa proposition $p\to q$ ta zama gaskiya? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan proposition $p\to q$ gaskiya ce, truth set na $p$ yana cikin truth set na $q$.
Da farko nemo iyakar $x$ da ke gamsar da $p$, sannan ka tabbatar ƙarshen hagu na wannan iyakar bai gaza $m$ ba.
bm_propRange.explanation: Truth set na $p$ ita ce $\{x\mid {lo}{rl}x{rl}{hi}\}$. Domin ta kasance cikin truth set na $q$, wato $\{x\mid m\le x\le {n}\}$, dole ne $m\le {lo}$ da ${hi}\le {n}$. Saboda haka mafi girman integer $m$ shi ne ${ans}$.

bm_quadRange.prompt: Ga quadratic function $f(x)={f}$, idan maximum value na $f(x)$ a kan ${s}\le x\le {t}$ ita ce $M$ kuma minimum value ita ce $m$, menene $M+m$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Sake rubuta ta a siffar $f(x)=a(x-p)^2+q$ don nemo vertex.
Tunda x-coordinate na vertex yana cikin interval ɗin da aka bayar, ka kwatanta value na function a vertex da kuma a ƙarshen interval biyu.
bm_quadRange.explanation: Tunda $f(x)={vf}$, vertex ɗin shi ne $({h},{k})$ kuma yana cikin interval ɗin. Values na function a ƙarshen interval su ne $f({s})={fs}$ da $f({t})={ft}$; saboda haka maximum $M={M}$, minimum $m={m}$, kuma $M+m={ans}$.

bm_quadRoots.prompt: Idan real roots biyu mabambanta na equation ${eq}$ game da $x$ su ne $\alpha$ da $\beta$, a jere daga ƙarami zuwa babba, menene darajar $\beta-2\alpha$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Matsar da dukkan terms na gefen dama zuwa gefen hagu don samun siffar (quadratic polynomial)$=0$.
Factor ɗin polynomial ɗin don nemo roots biyu, sannan ka sanya ƙaramin root a wurin $\alpha$ da babba a wurin $\beta$.
bm_quadRoots.explanation: Bayan tsarawa, ana samun ${std}=0$, kuma factoring yana ba da ${fac}=0$; saboda haka $\alpha={al}$ da $\beta={be}$. Saboda haka $\beta-2\alpha={ans}$.

bm_setOps.prompt: Universal set $U$ shi ne set na duk natural numbers da ba su wuce ${n}$ ba. Subsets biyu na $U$ su ne $A$, set na duk divisors na ${a}$, da $B$, set na duk multiples na ${b}$. Menene jimillar duk elements na set $A\cap B^{c}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Rubuta $A$ da $B$ ta hanyar jera elements. Ka yi la'akari da $B$ a cikin $U$ kawai.
$B^{c}$ shi ne elements ɗin da suka rage a $U$ bayan an cire elements na $B$. Daga cikin elements na $A$, zaɓi waɗanda ba sa cikin $B$.
bm_setOps.explanation: Tunda $A=\{{As}\}$ da $B=\{{Bs}\}$, $A\cap B^{c}=\{{Rs}\}$ ne kuma jimillar elements ita ce ${ans}$.

bm_transform.prompt: Haɗin maki $\mathrm{P}$ su ne $({a},{b})$. An matsar da $\mathrm{P}$ a kan axis $x$ da ${p}$ da kuma a kan axis $y$ da ${q}$ don samun $\mathrm{Q}$. An nuna $\mathrm{Q}$ ta madubi a kan axis $x$ don samun $\mathrm{R}$, sannan aka nuna $\mathrm{R}$ ta madubi a kan layin $y=x$ don samun $\mathrm{S}(m,n)$. Menene ƙimar $2m+n$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Matsarwa: $(x,y)\to(x+p,\,y+q)$; nuna ta madubi a kan axis $x$: $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$; nuna ta madubi a kan layin $y=x$: $(x,y)\to(y,x)$.
Nemo kowane maki ɗaya bayan ɗaya bisa wannan tsari.

ca1_absNotDiff.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={fx}$, lambobin gaske nawa $k$ ne suke sa $f$ ba ta da derivatif a $x=k$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Aikin $|g(x)|$ yana lanƙwasawa inda alamar $g(x)$ take canzawa. Duba ko alamar tana canzawa a tushen (ko tushen maimaitacce ne).
A tushen da yawan maimaituwarsa marar lissafi biyu ne, aikin ba shi da derivatif; idan yawan maimaituwar lissafi biyu ne, yana da derivatif.
ca1_absNotDiff.explanation: Daga cikin tushen bayanin da ke cikin ƙimar cikakkiya, masu yawan maimaituwa marar lissafi biyu su ne ${oddr}$, masu yawan maimaituwa lissafi biyu kuma su ne ${evenr}$. A tushen mai yawan maimaituwa marar lissafi biyu, alamar tana canzawa, don haka derivatif daga hagu da dama sun bambanta kuma aikin ba shi da derivatif; a tushen mai yawan maimaituwa lissafi biyu, aikin yana da derivatif. Saboda haka yawan maki da ake nema shi ne ${ans}$.

ca1_areaCubicAxis.prompt: Menene jimillar faɗin yankuna biyu da lanƙwasar $y={f}$ da axis $x$ suka kewaye? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Nemo haɗin x na wuraren da lanƙwasar ta haɗu da axis $x$ (tushen ukun polynomial na digiri na uku).
A kowane yanki, duba ko lanƙwasar tana sama ko ƙasa da axis $x$; idan tana ƙasa, juya alamar integral.
ca1_areaCubicAxis.explanation: Wuraren da lanƙwasar ta haɗu da axis $x$ su ne $x={rs}$. A tazara $[{r1},{r2}]$, $\int y\,dx={i1}$, kuma a tazara $[{r2},{r3}]$, $\int y\,dx={i2}$. Saboda haka jimillar faɗin ita ce $\left|{i1}\right|+\left|{i2}\right|={ansf}$.

ca1_areaLineParam.prompt: Idan faɗin yankin da lanƙwasar $y={cur}$ da layin $y=mx$ ($0<m<{a}$) suka kewaye shi ne ${S}$, menene ƙimar m? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Haɗin x na wuraren da lanƙwasar da layin suka haɗu su ne $0$, ${a}-m$.
Bayyana integral na (lanƙwasa)−(layi) tsakanin wuraren haɗuwar biyu ta amfani da m, sannan warware ma'aunin da yake daidai da ${S}$.
ca1_areaLineParam.explanation: Haɗin x na wuraren haɗuwar su ne $0$, ${a}-m$, kuma faɗin shi ne $\int_0^{{a}-m}\{({a}-m)x-x^2\}dx=\frac{({a}-m)^3}{6}$. Wannan daidai yake da ${S}$, don haka ${a}-m={d}$, wato $m={ans}$.

ca1_areaParabolaLine.prompt: Menene faɗin yankin da parabola $y={f}$ da layin $y={g}$ suka kewaye? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Warware ma'aunan biyun tare don nemo haɗin x na wuraren haɗuwa, $\alpha<\beta$.
Yi integral na (aikin da yake sama)−(aikin da yake ƙasa) daga $\alpha$ zuwa $\beta$.
ca1_areaParabolaLine.explanation: Idan aka warware ma'aunan biyun, haɗin $x$ na wuraren haɗuwa su ne ${al}$ da ${be}$, kuma bambancin ayyukan biyu shi ne ${dif}$. Yin integral na (jadawalin sama)−(jadawalin ƙasa) a wannan tazara yana ba da faɗin ${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_areaTangentParabola.prompt: Menene faɗin yankin da layin tangent na parabola $y={f}$ a maki mai haɗin x ${a}$, parabola ɗin, da axis $y$ suka kewaye? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo ma'aunin layin tangent. Layin tangent yana kasancewa a gefe ɗaya kawai (sama ko ƙasa) da parabola.
Yi integral na ƙimar cikakkiya ta (parabola)−(layin tangent) daga $x=0$ zuwa $x={a}$.
ca1_areaTangentParabola.explanation: Ma'aunin layin tangent shi ne $y={tl}$, bambancin parabola da layin tangent kuma shi ne ${dif}$. Yin integral na ƙimar cikakkiya ta wannan bambanci daga $x=0$ zuwa $x={a}$ yana ba da faɗin ${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_contProduct.prompt: Ga ayyuka ${pw}$ da $g(x)={gd}$ (dukkan haruffan da ke cikin furucin $g$ akai-akai ne), idan $f(x)g(x)$ yana ci gaba ga duk ainihin ƙimar $x$, menene ƙimar $g({kq})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Domin $f(x)g(x)$ ya ci gaba a wuraren da $f$ ba ya ci gaba, yaya ya kamata ƙimar $g$ ta kasance a wuraren?
Yi amfani da sharadin $g=0$ a waɗannan wuraren domin nemo akai-akai na haruffan da ke cikin $g$.
ca1_contProduct.explanation: Tunda ƙimar $f$ tana tsalle a wuraren ${ptxt}$, domin $f(x)g(x)$ ya ci gaba dole ne $g=0$ a wuraren nan. Idan aka yi amfani da wannan sharadi domin nemo akai-akai, ana samun $g(x)={gfull}$, don haka $g({kq})={ans}$.

ca1_contRadical.prompt: Idan aikin ${pw}$ yana ci gaba a $x={c}$, menene ƙimar akai-akai $k$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Domin ya ci gaba a $x={c}$, ƙimar iyaka idan $x\to {c}$ dole ne ta zama $k$.
Bayan mayar da furucin marar tushe a cikin mai ƙidaya ko mai ƙididdigewa zuwa mai tushe, rage abubuwan da suka yi tarayya.
ca1_contRadical.explanation: Domin aikin ya ci gaba, $k=\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$. Idan aka mayar da furucin marar tushe zuwa mai tushe sannan aka rage abubuwan da suka yi tarayya yayin da $x\ne {c}$, ana samun $f(x)={rat}$; saboda haka ƙimar iyaka idan $x\to {c}$ ita ce $k={ansf}$.

ca1_contTwoJoint.prompt: Idan aikin ${pw}$ yana ci gaba ga duk ainihin ƙimar $x$, menene ƙimar $a+b$ ga akai-akai $a$ da $b$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Wuraren da aikin zai iya yankewa su ne inda furuci yake sauyawa, $x={p1}$ da $x={p2}$.
Kafa daidaito a kowane wuri, inda ƙimar furucin hagu da na dama suke daidaita.
ca1_contTwoJoint.explanation: A $x={p1}$ da $x={p2}$ ƙimomin furucin hagu da dama dole su yi daidai, don haka ana samun daidaitattun lissafi biyu. Idan aka warware, $a={av}$ da $b={bv}$; saboda haka $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_defIntAbs.prompt: Menene ƙimar $\int_{{p}}^{{q}}|{g}|\,dx$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Nemo tushen da ke cikin yankin da ke sauya alamar furucin da ke cikin cikakken ƙima, wato ƙimar $x$ inda alamar ta canza.
Raba yankin a waɗannan maki, cire cikakken alama a kowanne sashe bisa ga alamarsa, sannan ka yi integral.
ca1_defIntAbs.explanation: Alamar furucin cikin cikakken ƙima tana sauyawa a $x={zs}$, saboda haka a raba yankin. Tunda alamar ba ta sauyawa a kowanne ƙaramin yanki, tara cikakkun ƙimomin definite integral na kowane yanki: ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_defIntFindBound.prompt: Ga tabbataccen $a$, idan $\int_{{lo}}^{a}\left({g}\right)dx={V}$, menene ƙimar $a$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nemo rashin takamaiman integral, sannan ka rubuta $\int_{{lo}}^{a}$ a matsayin polinomial mai ɗauke da $a$.
Nemo tushen da ya cika $a>{lo}$ a cikin lissafin da aka samu. Tunda furucin yana ƙaruwa, tushen guda ɗaya ne kawai.
ca1_defIntFindBound.explanation: Rashin takamaiman integral guda ɗaya shi ne $G(x)={G}$, don haka $G(a)-G({lo})={V}$. Ga $a>{lo}$, ƙimar tana ƙaruwa da $a$, saboda haka akwai tushen guda ɗaya kawai. Warwarewa yana ba da $a={ans}$.

ca1_defIntSplit.prompt: Ga aikin da ke ci gaba $f(x)$, idan $\int_{{a0}}^{{p}}f(x)\,dx={A}$ da $\int_{{a0}}^{{q}}f(x)\,dx={B}$, menene ƙimar $\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({mf}\right)dx$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Yi amfani da ƙa'idodin definite integral: $\int_a^b f\,dx+\int_b^c f\,dx=\int_a^c f\,dx$ da $\int_b^a f\,dx=-\int_a^b f\,dx$.
Bayyana integral na $f$ da ake nema ta amfani da ƙimomin biyu da aka bayar, sannan ka yi integral na ɓangaren akai-akai dabam.
ca1_defIntSplit.explanation: A yankin da ake nema, $\int f(x)\,dx={I}$. A lissafta ɓangaren akai-akai da $\int c\,dx=c\times(\text{tsawon yankin mai alamar alkibla})$, sannan a tara su. Saboda haka ƙimar ita ce ${ans}$.

ca1_defIntSymm.prompt: Menene ƙimar $\int_{-{a}}^{{a}}\left({g}\right)dx$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yankin yana daidaita ne a kan asalin ma'auni. Integral na kowane ƙarfin $x$ mara ma'aurata yana zama $0$.
Faɗaɗa furucin, bar kalmomin da ke da ƙarfin $x$ ma'aurata kaɗai, sannan ka lissafta $2\int_0^{a}$.
ca1_defIntSymm.explanation: Idan aka sauƙaƙa furucin, integral na kalmomin da ke da ƙarfin mara ma'aurata ya zama $0$, yayin da na kalmomin da ke da ƙarfin ma'aurata shi ne ${evp}$. Saboda haka $2\int_0^{a}\left({evp}\right)dx={ansf}$.

ca1_derivSignMin.prompt: Ga aikin polinomial $f$, idan ${given}$, menene jimillar duk ƙimomin $x$ da $f$ ke da ƙaramin ƙima na gida? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ƙimar iyaka tana faruwa ne a wurin da alamar $f'(x)$ ta sauya. A tushen da ya maimaitu (abin da aka ɗaga zuwa murabba'i), alamar ba ta sauyawa.
Bincika alamar $f'(x)$ a hagu da dama na kowanne tushe, sannan ka nemo wurin da alamar ta sauya daga $-$ zuwa $+$.
ca1_derivSignMin.explanation: Wurin da alamar $f'(x)$ ta sauya daga $-$ zuwa $+$ shi ne wurin mafi ƙarancin ƙima na gida. Idan aka zana jadawalin alamu, irin waɗannan wurare suna faruwa ne idan $x$ ya kasance ${mins}$, kuma jimillar ita ce ${ans}$.

ca1_diffLimitPoly.prompt: Idan $f(x)={f}$, menene ƙimar ${lim}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Za ka iya canza furucin zuwa siffar ma'anar ƙimar bambancin $f$: $\lim\frac{f(a+\Delta)-f(a)}{\Delta}$. Gwada ƙara da cirewa domin samu $f(x)-f({a})$ a cikin mai ƙidaya.
Da farko nemo ƙimar $f({a})$ ko $f'({a})$, sannan ka haɗa su bisa yadda furucin ya nuna.
ca1_diffLimitPoly.explanation: Da farko nemo $f'(x)$; ana samun $f'({a})={d1}$ da $f({a})={d0}$. Idan aka bayyana iyakar a matsayin ƙimar bambancin, ${step}={ansf}$.
