ca1_diffParam.explanation: Tunda aikin yana ci gaba a $x={c}$, ƙimomin ayyukan sassan biyu iri ɗaya ne; tunda ana iya bambanta shi, ƙimomin bambancinsu ma iri ɗaya ne. Warware daidaitattun lissafi biyun yana ba da $a={av}$ da $b={bv}$, don haka $a+b={ans}$.
ca1_diffParam.prompt: Idan aikin ${pw}$ ana iya bambanta shi a $x={c}$, menene ƙimar $a+b$ ga akai-akai $a$ da $b$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan ana iya bambanta aikin, to yana ci gaba a $x={c}$, kuma ƙimar bambancin daga hagu da dama iri ɗaya ce.
Ka kafa daidaito biyu: ɗaya cewa ƙimar aikin a $x={c}$ daidai ce a sassan biyu, ɗayan kuma cewa ƙimar bambancin su daidai ce.

ca1_extremaCoef.prompt: Aikin digiri na uku $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ da $c$ akai-akai ne) yana da mafi girman ƙima na gida a $x={m}$ da mafi ƙarancin ƙima na gida a $x={n}$, kuma $f({z})={w}$. Menene jimillar mafi girman ƙima da mafi ƙarancin ƙima? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: A wurin mafi girma ko mafi ƙaranci na gida, $f'(x)=0$; saboda haka ana iya nemo $a$ da $b$ daga $f'({m})=f'({n})=0$.
Bayan nemo $a$ da $b$, yi amfani da sharadin $f({z})={w}$ domin tantance $c$. A ƙarshe, lissafta mafi girman ƙima $f({m})$ da mafi ƙarancin ƙima $f({n})$ dabam, sannan ka tara su.
ca1_extremaCoef.explanation: Daga $f'({m})=f'({n})=0$, ana samun $a={av}$ da $b={bv}$, sannan daga $f({z})={w}$ ana samun $c={cv}$. Mafi girman ƙima ita ce $f({m})={fm}$, mafi ƙarancin kuma ita ce $f({n})={fn}$; jimillar su ita ce ${ans}$.

ca1_indefInitial.prompt: Idan bambancin aikin $f(x)$ shi ne $f'(x)={d}$ kuma $f({p})={q}$, menene ƙimar $f({r})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: $f(x)$ shi ne rashin takamaiman integral na $f'(x)$. Nemo $f(x)$ tare da akai-akai na integral $C$.
Yi amfani da sharadin $f({p})={q}$ domin nemo akai-akai na integral $C$, sannan ka nemo ƙimar $f({r})$.
ca1_indefInitial.explanation: $f(x)=\int f'(x)\,dx={F}+C$, kuma daga $f({p})={q}$ ana samun $C={C}$. Saboda haka $f({r})={ans}$.

ca1_indefSecond.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)$, idan $f''(x)={d}$, $f'({p})={s}$ da $f({q})={w}$, menene ƙimar $f({r})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan aka yi integral na $f''$ sau ɗaya, ana samun $f'$, kuma idan aka sake yi sau ɗaya, ana samun $f$. Ana samun akai-akai na integral guda ɗaya a kowane mataki.
Yi amfani da sharadin $f'({p})={s}$ domin nemo akai-akai na farko, sannan sharadin $f({q})={w}$ domin nemo na biyu.
ca1_indefSecond.explanation: Idan aka yi integral na $f''$ sannan aka yi amfani da $f'({p})={s}$ domin tantance akai-akai, ana samun $f'(x)={g1}$. Idan aka sake yin integral sannan aka yi amfani da $f({q})={w}$, ana samun $f(x)={g0}$. Saboda haka $f({r})={ans}$.

ca1_ineqParam.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={f}$, menene mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ainihin lamba $a$ da ke sa rashin daidaito $f(x)+a\ge 0$ ya zama gaskiya a duk yankin ${dom}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Domin $f(x)+a\ge0$ ya zama gaskiya a ko'ina, mafi ƙarancin ƙimar $f(x)$ a wannan yanki dole ne ya kai aƙalla $-a$.
Nemo mafi ƙarancin ƙimar $f(x)$ a yankin ta hanyar kwatanta ƙimomin iyaka da ƙimomin a ƙarshen yankin.
ca1_ineqParam.explanation: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar $f(x)$ a wannan yanki ita ce ${mn}$. Domin $f(x)+a\ge0$ ya zama gaskiya ko da yaushe, dole ne $a\ge {mn2}$; saboda haka mafi ƙarancin ƙimar $a$ ita ce ${ans}$.

ca1_integralEq.prompt: Idan polynomial function $f(x)$ tana cika $f(x)={rhs}$ ga duk real $x$, menene ƙimar $f({k})$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt$ constant ne da ba ya dogara da $x$. Idan aka kira shi $c$, za a iya rubuta $f(x)$ ta amfani da $c$.
Sanya wannan expression na $f(x)$ cikin $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ domin nemo $c$.
ca1_integralEq.explanation: Idan aka kira $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ (constant), $f(x)$ zai zama quadratic mai $c$. Daga equation cewa integral ɗinsa daga 0 zuwa 1 daidai yake da $c$, ana samun $c={c}$, kuma $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralFuncExtremum.prompt: Idan $f(t)={f}$, menene local minimum na function $G(x)=\int_{{s}}^{x}f(t)\,dt$? (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Tunda $G'(x)=f(x)$, alamar $f(x)$ ce ke ƙayyade ko $G$ tana ƙaruwa ko raguwa.
Local minimum yana faruwa inda alamar $f(x)$ ta canza daga $-$ zuwa $+$, kuma ana lissafa ƙimarsa da $\int_{s}^{x}f(t)\,dt$.
ca1_integralFuncExtremum.explanation: Wurin da alamar $G'(x)=f(x)$ ke canzawa daga $-$ zuwa $+$ shi ne $x={z}$. Local minimum ɗin ita ce $G({z})=\int_{{s}}^{{z}}f(t)\,dt={ansf}$.

ca1_integralFuncFind.prompt: Idan polynomial function $f(x)$ tana cika $\int_{{c}}^{x}f(t)\,dt={F}$ ($a$ constant ne) ga duk real $x$, menene ƙimar $f({k})$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan $x={c}$, integral na bangaren hagu 0 ne, saboda haka za a iya amfani da wannan wajen nemo $a$.
Sannan differentiate bangarorin biyu game da $x$ domin samun $f(x)$.
ca1_integralFuncFind.explanation: Idan $x={c}$, bangaren hagu 0 ne, saboda haka $a={av}$. Idan aka differentiate bangarorin biyu, $f(x)={fx}$, don haka $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralLimit.prompt: Ga polynomial function $f(x)={f}$, menene ƙimar ${lim}$? (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Wannan yana da siffar da numerator da denominator dukansu ke kusantar $0$. Yi amfani da alaƙar definite da indefinite integrals $\frac{d}{d x}\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=f(x)$.
Idan $F'(x)=f(x)$, rubuta $\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=F(x)-F(a)$ domin samun siffar derivative definition.
ca1_integralLimit.explanation: Idan $F'(x)=f(x)$ kuma aka rubuta integral a matsayin $F(upper endpoint)-F(lower endpoint)$, limit ɗin ya zama siffar derivative na $F$, kuma ƙimarsa ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_ivtCount.prompt: Adadin integers $a$ da ke sa equation ${fx}=0$ ya sami real root a cikin open interval $({m},{n})$ nawa ne? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Wannan function tana ƙaruwa a duk interval ɗin. Saboda haka function values a endpoints dole su kasance da alamu daban.
Rubuta sharadin cewa alamun $f({m})$ da $f({n})$ sun bambanta, wato $f({m})f({n})<0$, a matsayin inequality kan $a$.
ca1_ivtCount.explanation: Tunda $f(x)={fx}$ kuma $f'(x)>0$, tana ƙaruwa; necessary and sufficient condition domin samun real root a interval ɗin ita ce $f({m})f({n})<0$. Integers $a$ da ke cika wannan su ne ${alo}<a<{ahi}$, saboda haka akwai ${ans}$.

ca1_kinCoefFind.prompt: Matsayin point P da ke motsi a kan number line a lokacin $t$ shi ne $x(t)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ constants ne). Idan velocity ɗin P a $t={p}$ ya zama 0 kuma acceleration ɗinsa ${q}$, menene matsayin P a lokacin $t={k}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Velocity ita ce $v(t)=x'(t)$, acceleration kuma $a(t)=v'(t)$. Rubuta conditions biyu a matsayin equations: $v({p})=0$, $a({p})={q}$.
Warware equations biyu tare domin nemo $a$ da $b$, sannan ka ƙididdige $x({k})$.
ca1_kinCoefFind.explanation: Tunda $v(t)=x'(t)$, $a(t)=x''(t)$, daga $v({p})=0$ da $a({p})={q}$ ana samun $a={av}$ da $b={bv}$. Saboda haka $x({k})={ans}$.

ca1_limCoefPoly.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ akai-akai ne), idan ${lim}={L}$, menene ƙimar $f(1)$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Tunda ƙimar iyaka tana nan kuma mai ƙididdigewa yana zama $0$, dole ne mai ƙidaya ma ya zama $0$ a $x={c}$.
Saboda haka ƙimar iyaka ita ce ${rel}$. Yi amfani da daidaiton wannan ƙima da ${L}$ tare da sharadin mai ƙidaya domin kafa tsarin lissafi biyu masu ɗauke da $a$ da $b$.
ca1_limCoefPoly.explanation: Dole ne mai ƙidaya ya zama $0$ a $x={c}$, saboda haka $f({c})={m0}$. A wannan yanayin ƙimar iyaka ita ce ${rel}$, kuma tana daidai da ${L}$. Idan aka warware lissafin biyun, ana samun $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, kuma $f(1)={ans}$.

ca1_limCoefRational.prompt: Idan $\lim_{x\to {c}}\frac{{num}}{{den}}={L}$, menene ƙimar $a+b$ ga akai-akai $a$ da $b$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Domin ƙimar iyaka ta kasance yayin da mai ƙididdigewa ya zama $0$ a $x={c}$, mai ƙidaya ma dole ya zama $0$ a $x={c}$.
Bayyana $b$ ta amfani da $a$ domin mai ƙidaya ya samu mai ninkawa ${xc}$, sannan ka kafa lissafi cewa ƙimar iyaka ta furucin da aka rage ta yi daidai da ƙimar da aka bayar (${L}$).
ca1_limCoefRational.explanation: Tunda iyakar tana nan kuma mai ƙididdigewa ya zama $0$ a $x={c}$, mai ƙidaya ma dole ya zama $0$ a $x={c}$. Bayan an rage mai ninkawa gama-gari na mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa, sharadin cewa iyakar da aka samu ta yi daidai da ƙimar da aka bayar (${L}$) yana ba da $a={av}$ da $b={bv}$. Saboda haka $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_limDerivForm.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)$ da za a iya bambanta, idan $f({a})={s}$ da $f'({a})={t}$, menene ƙimar ${lim}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Gwada ƙara da cirewa ko fasa furucin domin mai ƙidaya ya ƙunshi $f(x)-f({a})$ (ko $f(a+h)-f(a)$).
Ma'anar ƙimar bambanci ita ce $\lim_{x\to {a}}\frac{f(x)-f({a})}{{xa}}=f'({a})$.
ca1_limDerivForm.explanation: Idan aka shirya mai ƙidaya a matsayin $f(x)-f({a})$, za a iya amfani da ma'anar ƙimar bambanci. Tunda $f({a})={s}$ da $f'({a})={t}$, ƙimar iyakar ita ce ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_limExistence.prompt: Idan aikin ${pw}$ yana da ƙimar iyaka $\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x}$, menene ƙimar akai-akai $a$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Domin ƙimar iyaka ta kasance, iyakar hagu da iyakar dama yayin da $x\to {c}$ dole ne su yi daidai.
Saka ƙimar da ke kusa da $x={c}$ cikin furucin idan $x<{c}$ da kuma idan $x>{c}$, sannan ka bayyana iyakokin biyun ta amfani da $a$.
ca1_limExistence.explanation: Iyakar hagu ita ce ƙimar furucin idan $x<{c}$ yayin da $x\to {c}$; iyakar dama kuma ita ce ƙimar furucin idan $x>{c}$. Dole ne su yi daidai, saboda haka $a={ans}$.

ca1_limInfRatio.prompt: Menene ƙimar $\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{{num}}{{den}}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko kwatanta ma'aunin mafi girman ƙarfin x a mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa. Idan ma'aunin mai ƙidaya ya ƙasa, ƙimar iyakar ita ce $0$.
Gwada raba mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa da mafi girman ƙarfin $x$.
ca1_limInfRatio.explanation: Yayin da $x\to\infty$, manyan kalmomin da ke ƙayyade mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa su ne ${nl}$ da ${dl}$. Saboda haka ƙimar iyakar daidai take da iyakar rabonsu $\frac{{nl}}{{dl}}$, wato ${ansf}$.

ca1_limPiecewise.prompt: Ga aikin ${pw}$, menene ƙimar {ask}? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Furucin aikin $f$ yana sauyawa a $x={k}$. Da farko tantance ko ƙimar da ke cikin $f$ tana matsowa zuwa ${k}$ daga ƙasa ko daga sama.
Yi amfani da furucin da ya dace domin nemo ƙimar idan $x={k}$. Ƙimar aikin $f({k})$ kanta ba ta shafar iyakar.
ca1_limPiecewise.explanation: Iyakar yayin da $x\to {k}^{-}$ ita ce ${lv}$, yayin da $x\to {k}^{+}$ ita ce ${rv}$ (ƙimar aikin a $x={k}$ ita ce ${e}$, amma ba ta da alaƙa da iyakar). A cikin furucin da ake nema, duba daga wane gefe ƙimar da ke ciki take matsowa zuwa ${k}$, sannan ka yi amfani da ƙimomin da suka dace domin samun ${ans}$.

ca1_limRadical.prompt: Menene ƙimar $\lim_{x\to\infty}\left({expr}\right)$? (Za ka iya rubuta shi a matsayin decimal ko kaso kamar 3/4)
hints: Domin bambancin expressions masu radical, ko expression mai radical da linear expression, ninka numerator da denominator da (expression mai radical)+(sauran expression) don cire radical.
Bayan cire radical, raba numerator da denominator da $x$, sannan ka ɗauki $x\to\infty$.
ca1_limRadical.explanation: Bayan rationalization na numerator, expression ɗin ya zama kamar $\frac{{numr}}{{den2}}$. Idan aka raba numerator da denominator da $x$, numerator yana kusantar ${nc}$, denominator kuma yana kusantar ${dc}$, saboda haka iyakar ita ce ${ans}.$

ca1_maxMinFind.prompt: Aikin $f(x)={f}$ ($a$ constant ne) yana da maximum ${M}$ a kan closed interval $[{s},{t}]$. Menene minimum a wannan interval? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: A closed interval, nemo maximum da minimum ta hanyar kwatanta local extrema a cikin interval da function values a ƙarshen interval.
Nemo maximum tare da $a$ a cikin expression domin ƙayyade $a$, sannan ka yi haka don minimum.
ca1_maxMinFind.explanation: Idan aka kwatanta local extrema a cikin interval da function values a ƙarshen, maximum ɗin ${mx0}+a$ ne kuma wannan daidai yake da ${M}$, saboda haka $a={av}$. Minimum ɗin ${mn0}+a={ans}$ ne.

ca1_monoGiven.prompt: Cubic function $f(x)={f}$ ($a$ da $b$ constants ne) yana raguwa a closed interval $[{m},{n}]$, sannan yana ƙaruwa a interval biyu $(-\infty,{m}]$ da $[{n},\infty)$. Menene bambancin maximum da minimum na $f(x)$ a kan interval $[{m},{n}]$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: A wuraren da $f$ ke sauyawa daga ƙaruwa zuwa raguwa, da daga raguwa zuwa ƙaruwa, $x={m}$ da $x={n}$, muna da $f'(x)=0$.

$f'(x)$ quadratic ne mai tushen $x={m}$ da $x={n}$, saboda haka rubuta shi a matsayin $(coefficient na x^2)\times{fm}{fn}$ don nemo $a$ da $b$. A cikin interval mai raguwa, a wane ƙarshen ne maximum da minimum suke?
ca1_monoGiven.explanation: Tunda sauyin ƙaruwa/raguwa yana faruwa a $x={m}$ da $x={n}$, $f'(x)=0$, don haka $f'(x)={d3}{fm}{fn}$. Idan aka kwatanta coefficients, $a={av}$ da $b={bv}$. A interval ɗin tana raguwa, saboda haka maximum $f({m})={fmv}$ ne, minimum kuma $f({n})={fnv}$; bambancinsu shi ne ${ans}.$

ca1_mvtBound.prompt: Differentiable function $f(x)$ tana cika ${lo}\le f'(x)\le {hi}$ ga dukkan real numbers $x$, kuma ${cond}$. Menene maximum na $f({b})$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Ta hanyar Mean Value Theorem akwai $c$ da ke sa $f(b)-f(a)=f'(c)(b-a)$. Yi amfani da maximum na $f'(c)$.
Idan maki biyu da aka sani suna nan, yi tunani daga wanda ya fi kusa da wurin da ake nema.
ca1_mvtBound.explanation: Mafi kusa daga cikin maki da aka sani ga $f({b})$ shi ne $x={na}$ ($f({na})={nm}$), kuma tazarar ita ce ${gap}$. Ta hanyar Mean Value Theorem, $f({b})-({nm})=f'(c)\times{gap}\le {hi}\times{gap}$, saboda haka $f({b})\le {ans}$. Ana iya samun wannan ƙimar da function mai gradient ${hi}$ a ko da yaushe, don haka maximum ɗin ${ans}$ ne.

ca1_mvtC.prompt: Ga function $f(x)={f}$, menene ƙimar real number $c$ da ke cika Mean Value Theorem a kan interval $[{a},{b}]$ ($c$ ya fi ${a}$ girma kuma ya fi ${b}$ ƙanƙanta)? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: A cikin Mean Value Theorem, $c$ yana cika $\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}=f'(c)$.
Da farko nemo average rate of change, sannan ka zaɓi tushen $f'(c)=(average rate of change)$ da ke cikin open interval.
ca1_mvtC.explanation: Average rate of change ita ce $\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}={sl}$, kuma tushen $f'(c)={sl}$ guda ɗaya tilo da ke cikin interval $({a},{b})$ shi ne $c={ans}$.

ca1_noExtremum.prompt: Ga cubic function $f(x)={f}$, adadin integers $a$ da ke sa $f$ ba ta da local extrema nawa ne? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Cubic function ba ta da local extrema yana nufin alamar $f'(x)$ ba ta sauyawa.
Rubuta discriminant na quadratic $f'(x)=0$ a matsayin inequality $D\le 0$ akan $a$, sannan ka ƙirga integer solutions.
ca1_noExtremum.explanation: Alamar $f'(x)$ dole ta kasance ba ta sauyawa, saboda haka discriminant na $f'(x)=0$ dole ne ya cika $D\le 0$. Integers $a$ da ke cika wannan su ne ${lo}\le a\le {hi}$, don haka akwai ${ans}.$

ca1_optimBox.prompt: Daga kusurwoyi huɗu na takardar murabba'i mai tsawo mai faɗi ${W}$ cm da tsawo ${H}$ cm, ana yanke murabba'ai masu gefe iri ɗaya. Ana lanƙwasa ragowar domin yin akwati marar murfi mai siffar akwatin murabba'i mai tsawo. Menene mafi girman girman akwati, a cm³? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: A ce tsawon gefen murabba'in da aka yanke shi ne $x$, sannan ka bayyana girman akwati a matsayin aikin $V(x)$.
Girman akwati yana kaiwa mafi girma a mafitar $V'(x)=0$ da ke cikin yankin $0<x<(\text{gefe mafi guntu})\div 2$.
ca1_optimBox.explanation: Idan gefen murabba'in da aka yanke yana da tsawon $x$ cm, to $V(x)=x({W}-2x)({H}-2x)$ ($0<x<{hh}$). Warware $V'(x)=0$ yana nuna cewa girman yana kaiwa kololuwa a $x={x}$, inda yake sauyawa daga ƙaruwa zuwa raguwa. Mafi girman girma shi ne ${ans}$ cm³.

ca1_optimProfit.prompt: Ana ƙera kaya x a kowace rana ($0\le x\le {X}$), kuma ana sayar da duka. Jimillar kuɗin da ake kashewa ita ce $C(x)={cost}$ (rukunin won 10,000), farashin sayar da guda ɗaya kuma ${price}$ a wannan rukuni. Menene mafi girman ribar yau da kullum (kuɗin sayarwa kaɗan da jimillar kuɗin kashewa), a cikin rukunin won 10,000? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Rubuta ribar a matsayin $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$, sannan ka warware $P'(x)=0$.
Kwatanta ƙimar aikin a wurin da ya fi girma, har ma da ƙimomi a ƙarshen yankin $x=0$ da $x={X}$.
ca1_optimProfit.explanation: $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$, kuma mafita a cikin yankin daga $P'(x)=0$ da ke ba da matsakaicin ƙima ita ce $x={xs}$. A wannan wurin da kuma a ƙarshen yankin, $P({xs})={ans}$, $P(0)={p0}$, $P({X})={pX}$; saboda haka mafi girman ƙima ita ce ${ans}$ a cikin rukunin won 10,000.

ca1_powerFindN.prompt: Ga lambar halitta $n$, aikin shi ne $f(x)={f}$. Idan $f'({a})={V}$, menene ƙimar $n$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Bambancin $x^n$ shi ne $nx^{n-1}$.
Bayyana $f'(x)$ a matsayin furuci mai ɗauke da $n$, sannan ka yi tunanin yadda ƙimarsa ke sauyawa idan $n$ ya ƙaru.
ca1_powerFindN.explanation: Tunda $f'(x)={cc}\cdot n\cdot x^{n-1}-{kk}$, ana samun $f'({a})={cc}\cdot n\cdot{a}^{n-1}-{kk}$. Wannan ƙima tana ƙaruwa yayin da $n$ ke ƙaruwa, don haka akwai lambar halitta guda ɗaya da ƙimarta ${V}$, wato $n={ans}$.

ca1_powerTangentN.prompt: A kan lanƙwasa $y={fx}$ ($n$ lambar halitta ce da ta kai aƙalla 2), idan y-intercept na layin taɓawa a wurin da ma'aunin $x$ yake ${a}$ shi ne ${V}$, menene ƙimar $n$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Tunda bambancin $x^n$ shi ne $nx^{n-1}$, gangaren layin taɓawa yana zama furuci mai ɗauke da $n$.
Idan aka bayyana y-intercept na layin taɓawa da $n$, cikakkiyar ƙimarsa tana ƙaruwa yayin da $n$ ke ƙaruwa.
ca1_powerTangentN.explanation: Daga $f(x)={fx}$ ana samun $f'(x)={cc}nx^{n-1}$, saboda haka y-intercept na layin taɓawa shi ne $f({a})-{a}f'({a})=(1-n)\cdot{ccp}\cdot{a}^n$. Cikakkiyar ƙimar wannan tana ƙaruwa yayin da $n$ ke ƙaruwa, don haka akwai $n$ guda ɗaya da ƙimarsa ${V}$, wato $n={ans}$.

ca1_prodAbstract.prompt: Ga ayyuka biyu $f(x)$ da $g(x)$ da za a iya bambanta su, idan $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, $g({a})={u}$, kuma $g'({a})={w}$, kuma $h(x)={hx}$, menene ƙimar $h'({a})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ƙa'idar bambancin ninkawa ita ce $\{f(x)g(x)\}'=f'(x)g(x)+f(x)g'(x)$.
Idan ninkawar tana da abubuwa fiye da biyu, tara jimillar kalmomin da aka samu ta bambanta abu guda a lokaci ɗaya.

ca1_returnTime.prompt: Maki P yana motsi a kan layin lamba, ya fara daga asalin ma'auni a lokacin $t=0$, kuma gudunsa a lokaci $t$ ($t\ge0$) shi ne $v(t)={v}$. Menene gudun maki P a lokacin farko da ya koma asalin ma'auni bayan farawa? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Matsayi shi ne rashin takamaiman integral na gudu; tunda matsayin farawa shi ne $0$, $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds$.
Nemo mafi ƙarancin ƙimar $t$ mai kyau da ta cika $x(t)=0$, sannan ka saka ta cikin $v(t)$.
ca1_returnTime.explanation: $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds={xt}$, kuma ƙimomin $t$ masu kyau da suka sa $x(t)=0$ su ne ${rs}$. A mafi ƙarancin ƙima $t={t0}$, ana samun $v({t0})={ans}$.

ca1_rootCountK.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={f}$, adadin lambobin integer $k$ da ke sa lissafin $f(x)=k$ ya sami ainihin tushen real daban-daban ${nr}$ nawa ne? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Yi la'akari da yawan wuraren da jadawalin $y=f(x)$ ya haɗu da layi kwance $y=k$.
Nemo manyan da ƙananan ƙimomi na gida, sannan ka ƙayyade iyakar $k$ da ke ba da wuraren haɗuwa ${nr}$.
ca1_rootCountK.explanation: Idan aka nemo ƙimomin juyawa daga $f'(x)=0$, su ne ${ext}$. Domin samun ainihin tushen daban-daban ${nr}$, dole ne ${rng}$; saboda haka adadin lambobin integer $k$ shi ne ${ans}.$

ca1_tangentFromPoint.prompt: Menene sakamakon ninka gangaren tangents biyu da aka zana zuwa curve $y={f}$ daga wurin $({p},{q})$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan $t$ shi ne x-coordinate na wurin taɓawa, tangent ɗin ita ce $y=f'(t)(x-t)+f(t)$, kuma idan $x={p}$, dole ne $y={q}$.
Samo lissafin quadratic na $t$ daga wannan sharadi, nemo tushen biyu, sannan ka ƙididdige gangaren $f'(t)$.
ca1_tangentFromPoint.explanation: Idan $t$ shi ne x-coordinate na wurin taɓawa, sharadin cewa tangent ɗin tana da $y={q}$ idan $x={p}$ yana ba da quadratic mai tushen $t={t1}$ da ${t2}$. Gangaren su bi da bi su ne $f'({t1})$ da $f'({t2})$, kuma sakamakon ninkarsu shi ne ${ans}.$

ca1_tangentIntercept.prompt: Tangent ɗin curve $y={f}$ a wurin da x-coordinate yake ${a}$ tana haɗuwa da y-axis a wane y-coordinate? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Gangaren tangent ɗin ita ce derivative $f'({a})$ a wurin taɓawa.
Daga lissafin tangent $y-f({a})=f'({a})\{x-({a})\}$, nemo ƙimar $y$ idan $x=0$.
ca1_tangentIntercept.explanation: Tunda $f'({a})={d1}$ da $f({a})={d0}$, tangent ɗin ita ce $y-({d0})=({d1})\{x-({a})\}$. Idan $x=0$, to $y={ans}$.

ca1_tangentIntersect.prompt: Tangent ɗin curve $y={f}$ a wurin da x-coordinate yake ${a}$ ta sake haɗuwa da curve a wani wuri dabam da wurin taɓawa. Menene y-coordinate na wannan wurin? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: x-coordinate na wuraren haɗuwar curve da tangent su ne tushen $(equation na curve)−(equation na tangent)=0$, kuma lissafin yana da tushe mai maimaituwa a $x={a}$.
Ana iya samun jimillar tushen cubic daga coefficient na $x^2$. Nemo sauran tushen, sannan ka saka shi cikin lissafin curve.
ca1_tangentIntersect.explanation: Lissafin $(curve)−(tangent)=0$ cubic ne mai tushe mai maimaituwa a $x={a}$, kuma alaƙar tushen da coefficients tana ƙayyade jimillar tushen ukun. Sauran tushen shi ne $x={s}$; idan aka saka shi cikin lissafin curve, y-coordinate shi ne ${ans}.$

ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.prompt: Akwai layuka biyu masu taɓa curve $y={f}$ kuma gangarensu ${m}$ ne. Menene jimillar y-intercepts na waɗannan layukan? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan gangara ita ce ${m}$, x-coordinate na wurin taɓawa yana warware $f'(x)={m}$.
A kowane wurin taɓawa $(s, f(s))$, y-intercept shi ne $f(s)-s\cdot{m}$.
ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.explanation: Idan aka warware $f'(x)={m}$, x-coordinates na wuraren taɓawa su ne ${s1}$ da ${s2}$. Idan aka nemo y-intercepts na tangents biyu aka tara su, sakamakon shi ne ${ans}.$

ca1_throwImpact.prompt: An jefa ƙwallo sama daga wurin da yake ${h0}$ m sama da ƙasa, kuma bayan daƙiƙu $t$, tsayinta shi ne $h(t)={h}$ (m). Menene saurin ƙwallon lokacin da ta bugi ƙasa? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Lokacin da ta taɓa ƙasa, ita ce ƙimar $t$ mai kyau da ke sa $h(t)=0$. Sauri shi ne $h'(t)$.
Warware $h(t)=0$ don nemo tushe mai kyau, sannan ka ƙididdige absolute value na saurin a wannan lokacin.
ca1_throwImpact.explanation: Tushen mai kyau na $h(t)=0$ shi ne $t={T}$ seconds, kuma $h'(t)={v0}-10t$, saboda haka $h'({T})={vv}$. Speed shi ne absolute value na velocity, saboda haka ${ans}$ m/s.

ca1_totalDistPos.prompt: Matsayin point P da ke motsi a kan number line a lokacin $t$ ($t\ge0$) shi ne $x(t)={f}$. Nawa ne nisan da P ya yi daga lokacin $t=0$ zuwa $t={T}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Nisan tafiya ba canjin matsayi ba ne; a raba lokacin a wuraren da alkibla ta sauya, sannan a tara nisan kowane tazara.
Da farko duba ko akwai lokacin da $v(t)=x'(t)=0$ a cikin tazara $(0,{T})$.
ca1_totalDistPos.explanation: Idan aka warware $v(t)=x'(t)=0$, lokutan da alkibla ta sauya a cikin wannan tazara su ne ${turns}$. Idan aka raba tazara a waɗannan lokutan aka tara absolute value na canjin matsayi, jimillar nisan da aka yi ita ce ${ans}.$

ca1_totalDistVel.prompt: Gudun maki P mai motsi a kan layin lamba a lokaci $t$ ($t\ge0$) shi ne $v(t)={v}$. Wace tazara ce P ya yi daga lokaci $t=0$ zuwa $t={T}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Tazarar da aka yi ita ce integral na saurin $|v(t)|$.
Raba yankin a lokutan da $v(t)=0$, sannan ka yi integral bisa ga alamar a kowane sashe.
ca1_totalDistVel.explanation: Lokacin da alamar gudu ta sauya a cikin yankin shi ne ${zs}$. Idan aka raba yankin a wannan lokacin, alamar tana daidaita a kowanne sashe; tara cikakkun ƙimomin $\int v(t)\,dt$ a sassan: ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_twoRootsK.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={f}$, jimillar duk ainihin ƙimomin $k$ da za su sa lissafin $f(x)=k$ ya sami tushen ainihi dabam-dabam guda ${nr}$ nawa ne? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ka yi tunanin iyakar da yawan tushen ainihi dabam-dabam ke sauyawa: lokacin da layin kwance $y=k$ ya taɓa jadawali a ƙimar iyaka.
Daga cikin ƙimomin iyaka da layin ya taɓa jadawali, yi amfani da siffar jadawalin domin tantance waɗanda ke ba da tushen ${nr}$ daidai.
ca1_twoRootsK.explanation: Ƙimomin iyaka su ne ${ext}$. Idan aka duba yawan wuraren haɗuwa yayin da layin kwance ya taɓa jadawali a ƙimar iyaka da kuma idan bai taɓa ba, ƙimomin $k$ da suka cika sharadin su ne ${kk}$, kuma jimillarsu ita ce ${ans}$.

ca1_velZeroAccel.prompt: Matsayin maki P mai motsi a kan layin lamba a lokaci $t$ ($t\ge0$) shi ne $x(t)={f}$. Menene hanzarin maki P a lokacin da ya fi baya daga cikin lokuta biyu da gudunsa ya zama $0$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Gudu shi ne bambancin matsayi bisa ga $t$, wato $v(t)=x'(t)$; hanzari kuma shi ne bambancin gudu, $a(t)=v'(t)$.
Nemo tushen biyu na $v(t)=0$, sannan ka saka tushen da ya fi baya cikin $a(t)$.
ca1_velZeroAccel.explanation: $v(t)=x'(t)$, kuma tushen biyu na $v(t)=0$ su ne $t={t1}$ da $t={t2}$. Ƙimar $a(t)=v'(t)$ a lokacin baya $t={t2}$ ita ce ${ans}$.

ca2_addTheorem.prompt: Idan ${ga}$, ${gb}$, ${ra}$ da ${rb}$, nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da ƙimomin da aka bayar da $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$ domin nemo sauran ƙimomin ayyukan trigonometry da ake buƙata. Alamar ƙimar tana dogara da yankin kusurwar.
Saka ƙimomin da aka samu cikin ƙa'idar haɗa kusurwoyi.

ca2_areaCurves.prompt: Idan faɗin yankin da jadawali $y={f}$ da $y={g}$ da layukan $x={a}$ da $x={b}$ suka kewaye shi shi ne $S$, nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Lura: axis $x$ ita ce $y=0$.) (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi integral na furucin jadawalin da ke sama a yankin, ka cire furucin jadawalin da ke ƙasa.

Yi amfani da $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$ da $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ domin nemo rashin takamaiman integral na aikin ƙarfin, trigonometry da kaso; idan furucin ya ƙunshi aiki a cikin wani aiki, yi amfani da maye gurbi yayin integral.
ca2_areaCurves.explanation: A yankin $[{a},{b}]$, $y={f}$ yana sama, saboda haka $S=\int_{{a}}^{{b}}({f}-{gg})\,dx={wk}$. Don haka ƙimar ${ask}$ ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_ballDistance.prompt: An saukar da ƙwallo daga tsayin ${h}$ m. Duk lokacin da ta bugi ƙasa, sai ta tashi zuwa tsayin da yake ${ratio}$ na tsayin da ta faɗo daga gare shi a baya, sannan ta sake faɗuwa; ana maimaita haka har abada. Menene jimillar tazarar motsin ƙwallon, a m? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Raba tunaninka zuwa tazarar faɗuwar farko ${h}$ m da tazarar hawa-da-sauka bayan haka (sau biyu na kowane tsayin hawa).
Tsayin hawan yana samar da jerin rabon gama-gari wanda ajali na farko shi ne (tsayin farko)×(rabon tsalle).
ca2_ballDistance.explanation: Jimillar tsayin hawa ita ce ${up}$ m. Tazarar hawa da sauka ita ce sau biyu na wannan, don haka jimillar tazara ita ce ${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_ballReverse.prompt: An saukar da ƙwallo daga wani tsayi. Duk lokacin da ta bugi ƙasa, sai ta tashi zuwa tsayin da yake sau ${ratio}$ na tsayin da ta faɗo daga gare shi a baya, sannan ta sake faɗuwa; wannan yana maimaituwa har abada. Idan tsayin da ta tashi a karo na ${nb}$ shi ne ${H}$ m, menene jimillar tazarar motsin ƙwallon, a m? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Idan tsayin farko shi ne $h$ m, tsayin kowanne hawan yana zama sau ${ratio}$ na wanda ya gabace shi; don haka tsayin hawan karo na $n$ shi ne $h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{n}$.
Da farko nemo $h$, sannan ka tara tazarar faɗuwar farko $h$ da tazarar hawa da sauka bayan haka (sau biyu na jimillar tsayin hawa).
ca2_ballReverse.explanation: Idan tsayin farko shi ne $h$ m, to ${H}=h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{{nb}}$, don haka $h={h}$. Jimillar tsayin hawa ita ce ${up}$ m, saboda haka jimillar tazara ita ce ${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_chainTable.prompt: Ga ayyuka biyu $f$, $g$ da za a iya bambanta, ana da ${tbl}$. Idan $h(x)={hx}$, nemo ƙimar $h'({a})$. (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko kasr kamar 3/4)
hints: Duba ko $h$ ninkawa ne, rabo ne, ko aikin haɗaɗɗe, sannan ka yi amfani da ƙa'idar bambancin da ta dace.
Nemo ƙimomin aiki da bambanci da ake buƙata a $x={a}$ daga jadawalin, sannan ka saka su. Idan aikin haɗaɗɗe ne, ƙimar aikin ciki ita ce ma'aunin da za a saka a aikin waje.

ca2_commonTangent.prompt: Jadawalin lanƙwasar $y={f}$ da $y={g}$ suna haɗuwa a $x={x0}$, kuma suna da layin taɓawa guda a wurin. Nemo ƙimar $ab$ ga akai-akai $a$ da $b$. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan lanƙwasar biyun sun haɗu a $x={x0}$, ƙimomin ayyukansu iri ɗaya ne; idan layin taɓawa ɗaya ne, bambancin ayyukansu ma iri ɗaya ne.
Haɗa lissafi biyun masu ɗauke da $a$ da $b$ domin nemo ƙimominsu.
ca2_commonTangent.explanation: $y={f}$ yana da ƙimar aiki ${F}$ da bambancin ${D}$ a $x={x0}$, saboda haka ${wk}$. Don haka $ab={ans}$.

ca2_derivExpLog.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={fx}$, nemo ƙimar $f'({x0})$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo $f'(x)$ ta amfani da $(e^{x})'=e^{x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ da ƙa'idar bambancin aikin haɗaɗɗe.
Idan ƙimar da za a saka tana da siffar $\ln m$, yi amfani da $e^{\ln m}=m$.

ca2_doubleAngle.prompt: Idan ${cd}$, nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da $\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$, $\cos2\alpha=\cos^{2}\alpha-\sin^{2}\alpha$, da $\sin^{2}\alpha+\cos^{2}\alpha=1$.

Idan an bayar da $\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha$, ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu zuwa murabba'i. Idan $\tan\alpha=t$, $\sin2\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos2\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$; idan $\tan\frac{\alpha}{2}=t$, $\sin\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$.

ca2_eExponent.prompt: Idan $\lim_{{to}}{ex}=e^{k}$, nemo ƙimar $k$. (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko kasr kamar 3/4)
hints: Mayar da furucin zuwa siffar $\lim_{h\to0}(1+h)^{\frac{1}{h}}=e$.
Raba da ninka ma'aunin ƙarfin domin ya zama akasin juna da $h$ da ke cikin tushe.
ca2_eExponent.explanation: Idan aka yi amfani da $(1+h)^{\frac{1}{h}}\to e$ sannan aka sauƙaƙa ma'aunin ƙarfin, ana samun $k={wk}={res}$.

ca2_expLogLimit.prompt: Nemo ƙimar iyaka da ke biye: $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Sauya furucin domin amfani da $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{e^{x}-1}{x}=1$ da $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}=1$.
Ninka da raba da mai haɗi domin samun siffa iri ɗaya a mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa.
ca2_expLogLimit.explanation: Idan aka sauya furucin domin amfani da iyakar asali, ana samun ${wk}$, saboda haka ƙimar iyaka ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_extremaPair.prompt: Aikin $f(x)={fx}$ yana da mafi girman ƙima na gida da mafi ƙarancin ƙima na gida sau ɗaya kowanne. Idan yana da mafi girman ƙima a $x=\alpha$ da mafi ƙaranci a $x=\beta$, nemo ƙimar $\alpha-\beta$. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nemo ƙimomin $x$ da suka sa $f'(x)=0$, sannan ka duba yadda alamar $f'(x)$ take sauyawa kafin da bayan kowanne.
Idan alamar $f'(x)$ ta sauya daga mai kyau zuwa mara kyau, mafi girman ƙima ce; idan ta sauya daga mara kyau zuwa mai kyau, mafi ƙarancin ƙima ce.
ca2_extremaPair.explanation: Tunda $f'(x)={fp}$, mafi girman ƙima na faruwa a $x={mx}$, mafi ƙarancin kuma a $x={mn}$. Saboda haka $\alpha-\beta=({mx})-({mn})={ans}$.

ca2_geoConvCount.prompt: Nemo jimillar duk lambobi cikakku $x$ da ke sa furuci mai zuwa ya tattaru: ${obj}$ (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Jerin $\{r^{n}\}$ yana tattaru idan $-1<r\le 1$, yayin da jerin rabon gama-gari mara ƙarewa $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}r^{n}$ yake tattaru idan $-1<r<1$.
Rubuta sharadin tattaruwar a matsayin rashin daidaito mai ɗauke da $x$, sannan nemo duk lambobi cikakku da suka cika shi ka tara su.
ca2_geoConvCount.explanation: Daga sharadin tattaruwar ana samun ${rg}$. Lambobi cikakku $x$ da suka cika shi su ne ${lst}$, don haka jimillarsu ita ce ${ans}$.

ca2_geoSeriesParam.prompt: Idan jerin marar ƙarewa $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$ yana tattaru kuma jimillarsa ita ce ${S}$, nemo ƙimar akai-akai $r$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Jimillar jerin rabon gama-gari mara ƙarewa ita ce (ajali na farko)÷(1-rabon gama-gari).
Da farko nemo ajali na farko da rabon gama-gari daga ajali na gaba ɗaya na jerin.
ca2_geoSeriesParam.explanation: Ajali na farko shi ne ${fa}$, rabon gama-gari kuma ${ratio}$; saboda haka jimillar ${sumf}=${S}. Idan aka warware, $r={res}$.

ca2_implicitDeriv.prompt: Idan $y$ aiki ne na $x$, a maki $ {pt} $ da ke kan lanƙwasa ${eq}$, nemo ƙimar ${what}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi bambanci ga ɓangarorin lissafin biyu bisa ga $x$; idan wani abu yana ɗauke da $y$, ninka shi da $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$.
Saka ma'aunan maki cikin lissafin da aka samu, sannan ka warware don $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$. Idan ana son bambancin sau biyu, sake bambanta lissafin da aka samu bisa ga $x$.
ca2_implicitDeriv.explanation: Bayan an bambanta ɓangarorin biyu bisa ga $x$ kuma an ɗauki $y'=\frac{ dy }{ dx }$, ana samun ${wk}$; saboda haka ƙimar ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_integralBasic.prompt: Idan $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({fx}\right)dx$, nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da $\int e^{x}dx=e^{x}$, $\int\sin x\,dx=-\cos x$, $\int\cos x\,dx=\sin x$, $\int\frac{1}{x}dx=\ln|x|$, da $\int\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}dx=\tan x$.
Ka lura cewa $\int f(kx)\,dx=\frac{1}{k}F(kx)$; saka iyakar sama da ta ƙasa, sannan ka cire ƙimomin.

ca2_inverseDeriv.prompt: Idan $f(x)={fx}$ aiki ne mai ƙaruwa a dukkan ainihin lambobi, kuma aikin da yake juyinsa shi ne $g(x)$, nemo ƙimar $g'({b})$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo $a$ da ya cika $f(a)={b}$.
Ƙa'idar bambancin aikin juyawa: $g'({b})=\frac{1}{f'(a)}$.
ca2_inverseDeriv.explanation: Tunda $f({xa})={b}$, ana samun $g({b})={xa}$; daga $f'(x)={fp}$ kuma $f'({xa})={fd}$. Saboda haka $g'({b})=\frac{1}{f'({xa})}={res}$.

ca2_limitPair.prompt: Ga constants $a$, $b$, idan ${eq}$, nemo ƙimar $ab$. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan limit yana wanzuwa amma denominator ya kusanci $0$, dole numerator ma ya kusanci $0$. Da farko nemo alaƙar $a$ da $b$ daga wannan condition.
Sanya wannan alaƙar a cikin expression, sannan nemo limit ta factorization, rationalization, ko maye gurbin $1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$, sannan ka daidaita da ƙimar da aka bayar.

ca2_lineAngle.prompt: Idan acute angle tsakanin lines $ {l1} $ da $ {l2} $ ita ce $\theta$, nemo ƙimar $\tan\theta$. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Idan line mai slope $m$ ta yi angle $\alpha$ da positive direction na x-axis, to $\tan\alpha=m$. Mayar da equation zuwa siffar $y=mx+k$ domin gano slope.
Yi amfani da tangent addition formula don bambancin angles biyu, sannan ka ɗauki positive value tunda angle ɗin acute ne.
ca2_lineAngle.explanation: Slopes na lines biyu su ne $m_1={m1}$ da $m_2={m2}$, saboda haka $\tan\theta=\left|\frac{m_1-m_2}{1+m_1m_2}\right|=\left|\frac{({m1})-({m2})}{1+({m1})({m2})}\right|={res}$.

ca2_monotoneParam.prompt: Nemo adadin integers $a$ da ke sa function $f(x)={fx}$ ya ƙaru a dukkan real number. (Ana ɗauka yana ƙaruwa idan $f'(x)\ge 0$ ga duk real $x$.) (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Domin differentiable function ta ƙaru a duk real line, dole $f'(x)\ge0$ ga duk $x$.
Nemo iyakar $a$ da ke sa minimum (ko discriminant) na $f'(x)$ ya zama aƙalla $0$, sannan ka ƙirga integers.
ca2_monotoneParam.explanation: ${wk}$. Saboda haka integers $a$ da ke cika condition ɗin su ne ${lst}$, jimilla ${ans}$.

ca2_motionReverse.prompt: Matsayin point P a kan number line a lokacin $t$ ($t>0$) shi ne $x(t)={xt}$. Nemo acceleration a lokacin farko da velocity na P ya zama $0$. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Velocity ita ce derivative na position game da $t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$; acceleration ita ce $a(t)=v'(t)$.
Nemo mafi ƙaramin positive $t$ da ke sa $v(t)=0$, sannan ka saka shi cikin $a(t)$.
ca2_motionReverse.explanation: Tunda ${wk}$, acceleration a lokacin farko da velocity ya zama $0$ ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_paramDeriv.prompt: Ga curve $x={xt}$, $y={yt}$, idan $t={t0}$, nemo ƙimar ${what}$. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Don differentiation na parametric function, $\frac{ dy }{ dx }=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}$.
Don second derivative, fara rubuta $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$ a matsayin function na $t$, differentiate da $t$, sannan ka raba da $\frac{ dx }{ dt}$.

ca2_partialSumSeries.prompt: A cikin sequence $\{a_n\}$, jimillar daga term na farko zuwa term na $n$ ita ce $S_n=\frac{{sa}}{{sb}}$. Nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: $a_1=S_1$, kuma idan $n\ge 2$, $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.
Da farko bambanta ko ana neman term ne ko jimillar series. Jimillar infinite series ita ce limit na partial sums $S_n$, term kuma ana samu da $S_n-S_{n-1}$.
ca2_partialSumSeries.explanation: Tunda ${wk}$, ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_partsEval.prompt: Idan $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$, nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: A cikin product da ke ƙarƙashin integral, zaɓi factor da zai sauƙaƙa idan aka differentiate a matsayin $u$, wanda kuma ke da sauƙin integrate a matsayin $v'$, sannan yi integration by parts: $\int uv'dx=uv-\int u'v\,dx$.
Idan ya zama dole, maimaita integration by parts sau ɗaya. Ƙididdige trig values a iyakar interval ɗin.
ca2_partsEval.explanation: Bayan integration by parts, ${wk}$, saboda haka ƙimar ${ask} ita ce ${res}$.$

ca2_partsFormula.prompt: Aikin $f$ yana da derivatif, kuma $f'$ yana ci gaba. Idan ${given}$, nemo ƙimar ${tg}$. (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko kaso kamar 3/4)
hints: Hanyar haɗa samfur: $\int_{a}^{b}u\,v'\,dx=\left[uv\right]_{a}^{b}-\int_{a}^{b}u'\,v\,dx$.
Sanya $f'(x)$ ya zama $v'$, sannan sanya abin da aka ninka da shi ya zama $u$.

ca2_quotientDeriv.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={fx}$, nemo ƙimar $f'({x0})$. (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da ƙa'idar derivatif na rabo: $\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^{2}}$.
Nemo ƙimomin $u$, $v$, $u'$, da $v'$ a $x={x0}$, sannan saka su a cikin ƙa'idar.

ca2_riemann.prompt: Idan $L=\lim_{n\to\infty}{pre}\sum_{k=1}^{n}{body}$, nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Ka ɗauki jimillar a matsayin jimillar faɗin murabba'ai da suka raba tazara gida n daidai, sannan maye gurbin $\frac{k}{n}$ da $x$ don rubuta ta a matsayin integral tabbatacce.
Ana samun iyakokin integral daga iyakar ƙimar $\frac{k}{n}$ lokacin $k=1$ da $k=n$.
ca2_riemann.explanation: Idan aka mayar da jimillar zuwa integral tabbatacce, $L={wk}$. Saboda haka ƙimar ${ask}$ ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_rootCount.prompt: Nemo yawan tushen gaske mabambanta na ma'aunin ${eq}$. (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Sanya gefen hagu ya zama $f(x)$, sannan ka yi la'akari da yawan wuraren da jadawalin $y=f(x)$ da layin $y=k$ (inda $k$ yake adadi tsayayyen gefen dama) suke haɗuwa.
Bincika yadda $f$ ke ƙaruwa ko raguwa, nemo ƙimomin kololuwa, da iyakokin lokacin $x\to\pm\infty$. Kwatanta $k$ da waɗannan ƙimomi. Kimanta $e$ da $2.7<e<2.8$.
ca2_rootCount.explanation: Tunda ${fpx}$, binciken ƙaruwa da raguwa ya nuna ƙimomin kololuwa ${ext}$, kuma iyakokin su ne ${lim}$. A nan ${cm}$, don haka jadawalin $y=f(x)$ da layin $y=k$ suna haɗuwa a maki ${ans}$, kuma yawan tushen gaske ma ${ans}$ ne.

ca2_rootCountParam.prompt: Nemo yawan lambobin cikakku $k$ da suke sa ma'aunin ${eq}$ ya sami tushen gaske mabambanta ${nr}$. (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Sanya gefen hagu ya zama $f(x)$, sannan ka yi amfani da ƙaruwa/raguwa da ƙimomin kololuwa na jadawalin domin nemo tazarar $k$ da ke sa jadawalin $y=f(x)$ da layin $y=k$ su haɗu a maki ${nr}$.
Idan ƙimar kololuwa ta ƙunshi $e$, yi kimanta da $2.7<e<2.8$ sannan ƙirga lambobin cikakku a tazarar.
ca2_rootCountParam.explanation: Tunda ${fpx}$, ƙimomin kololuwa su ne ${ext}$, kuma domin samun haɗuwa a maki ${nr}$ dole ne ${rg}$. Lambobin cikakku $k$ a wannan tazara su ne ${lst}$, saboda haka akwai ${ans}$.

ca2_seqGeoLimit.prompt: Nemo iyakar wannan jerin. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Ƙarfi mai tushe mafi girman ƙimar absolute a sama da ƙasa ne ke ƙayyade iyakar.
Raba sama da ƙasa da wannan ƙarfi; sauran sassan masu tushe ƙaramar ƙimar absolute za su kusanci $0$.
ca2_seqGeoLimit.explanation: Idan aka raba sama da ƙasa da ${dom}$, wanda tushe mafi girman ƙimar absolute yake da shi, sauran sassan za su kusanci $0$ kuma coefficients kawai za su rage, wato ${wk}$. Saboda haka iyakar ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_seqLimit.prompt: Nemo iyakar wannan jerin. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Raba sama da ƙasa da babban ƙarfi a ƙasa, ko kuma idan akwai tushen, fara da cire tushen daga ma'auni.
Lokacin $n\to\infty$, kalmomi kamar $\frac{1}{n}$ da $\frac{1}{n^{2}}$ suna kusantar $0$.
ca2_seqLimit.explanation: Idan aka sauƙaƙa ma'aunin, ${wk}$, saboda haka iyakar ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_seqSumLimit.prompt: Nemo ƙimar iyaka da ke biye: $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{2}=\frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$, da $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{3}=\left\{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}\right\}^{2}$ domin bayyana jimillar a matsayin polinomial mai ɗauke da $n$.
Yayin da $n\to\infty$, kwatanta masu haɗin manyan ƙarfin mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa kawai.
ca2_seqSumLimit.explanation: Idan aka bayyana jimillar ta amfani da $n$, ana samun ${wk}$, saboda haka ƙimar iyaka ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_subsTransform.prompt: Ga aikin $f$ da ke ci gaba, idan ${gv}$, nemo ƙimar ${tg}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Sanya furucin da ke cikin integral a matsayin $u$, sannan canza iyakar da $dx$ zuwa furucin mai ɗauke da $u$.
Duba ko iyakar da aka canza ta yi daidai da iyakar integral ɗin da aka bayar.

ca2_substitution.prompt: Nemo ƙimar definite integral $\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Zaɓi wani furuci guda ɗaya a cikin integral (na cikin baka, tushen murabba'i, ƙarfin ko mai ƙididdigewa) a matsayin $u$, domin $du$ ya yi daidai da sauran ɓangaren.
Ka tuna cewa bayan canjin, iyakar integral ma tana sauyawa zuwa ƙimomin $u$.

ca2_tangentLine.prompt: Nemo ma'aunin $y$ na wurin da layin taɓawa a maki $ {pt} $ a kan lanƙwasa ${cv}$ ya haɗu da axis $y$. (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko kasr kamar 3/4)
hints: Bambancin aikin a wurin taɓawa shi ne gangaren layin taɓawa.
Saka $x=0$ a lissafin layin taɓawa $y-y_0=m(x-x_0)$.
ca2_tangentLine.explanation: Ma'aunan wurin taɓawa su ne $ {pt} $, gangara kuma $m={sl}$; saboda haka layin taɓawa shi ne $y={tl}$, kuma ma'aunin $y$ na wurin yanke shi ne ${res}$.

ca2_tangentTriangle.prompt: Nemo faɗin alwatika da layin taɓawa a maki $ {pt} $ a kan lanƙwasa ${cv}$ ya yi tare da axis $x$ da axis $y$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo lissafin layin taɓawa, sannan nemo wuraren da yake yanke axis biyu.
Tushe da tsawon alwatikan su ne $|x-intercept|$ da $|y-intercept|$.
ca2_tangentTriangle.explanation: Layin taɓawa shi ne $y={tl}$, x-intercept ${xi}$, y-intercept ${yi}$; saboda haka faɗin alwatika shi ne $\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={res}$.

ca2_telescope.prompt: Nemo jimillar jerin marar ƙarewa $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Abubuwan da ke ninka mai ƙididdigewa suna bi juna da tazara iri ɗaya. Gwada raba kasr zuwa jimillar ƙananan kasrori.

Yi amfani da $\frac{1}{A(A+d)}=\frac{1}{d}\left(\frac{1}{A}-\frac{1}{A+d}\right)$; idan abubuwan ninkawa uku ne, $\frac{1}{A(A+1)(A+2)}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{A(A+1)}-\frac{1}{(A+1)(A+2)}\right)$. Nemo abin da ya rage bayan kalmomi sun soke juna a jimillar sassan farko.
ca2_telescope.explanation: Idan aka raba zuwa kasrori, jimillar sassan farko bayan soke kalmomi tana ba da ${wk}$, saboda haka jimillar ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_trigDeriv.prompt: Ga aikin $f(x)={fx}$, nemo ƙimar $f'({x0})$. (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko kasr kamar 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$, $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$, tare da ƙa'idar bambancin ninkawa, rabon, da aikin haɗaɗɗe domin nemo $f'(x)$.
Saka $x={x0}$ cikin $f'(x)$ da aka samu, sannan ka lissafta ƙimomin ayyukan trigonometry.

ca2_trigLimit.prompt: Nemo darajar limit ɗin nan. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Rubuta shi a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi. Idan integer ne, rubuta integer ɗin. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Yi amfani da $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1$, $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\tan x}{x}=1$ da $1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$.
Ga limit inda $x\to c$, sa $t=x-c$ don mayar da shi zuwa $t\to0$. Idan $x\to\infty$, sa $h=\frac{1}{x}$.
ca2_trigLimit.explanation: Idan aka sake tsara shi domin amfani da limit na asali, ana samun ${wk}$; saboda haka darajar limit ita ce ${res}$.

ca2_trigLimitUnknown.prompt: Nemo darajar positive integer $a$ da za ta sa daidaito ${eq}$ ya zama gaskiya. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ka bayyana darajar limit yayin da $x\to0$ ta amfani da $a$.
Ka daidaita expression ɗin da aka samu da ƙimar da aka bayar, sannan ka warware domin $a$. Sharadin cewa $a$ positive integer ne zai tantance ƙima guda ɗaya.
ca2_trigLimitUnknown.explanation: Darajar limit ita ce ${wk}$, kuma ta yi daidai da ƙimar da aka bayar. Positive integer da ya cika wannan sharadi shi ne $a={ans}$; idan aka maye gurbinsa, ${chk}$ ya tabbata.

ca2_velocityIntegral.prompt: A kan layin lamba, gudun batu P a lokacin $t$ ($t\ge0$) shi ne $v(t)={vt}$. Nemo nisan da P ya yi daga lokacin $t=0$ zuwa $t={T}$. (Rubuta shi a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi. Idan integer ne, rubuta integer ɗin. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Nisan da aka yi shi ne integral na speed $|v(t)|$, wato $\int_{0}^{T}|v(t)|\,dt$.
Nemo lokutan da alamar velocity ke canjawa kuma ka raba interval ɗin. A kowane interval, tantance alamar $|v(t)|$ sannan ka yi integral.
ca2_velocityIntegral.explanation: Tunda ${wk}$, nisan da aka yi shi ne ${res}$.

ca2_volumeRotate.prompt: Idan an juya yankin da graf na $y={f}$ da $y={g}$ da kuma layuka $x={a}$ da $x={b}$ suka kewaye shi game da axis na $x$, a ce volume na solid ɗin da aka samu shi ne $V$. Nemo ƙimar ${ask}$. (Lura: axis na $x$ shi ne $y=0$.) (Rubuta shi a matsayin fraction mafi sauƙi. Idan integer ne, rubuta integer ɗin. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Volume na solid ɗin juyawa shi ne $V=\pi\int_{\alpha}^{\beta}\{(\text{outer radius})^{2}-(\text{inner radius})^{2}\}\,dx$.
Yi amfani da graf na sama a matsayin outer radius, na ƙasa kuma a matsayin inner radius. $ (\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$ kuma $\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos 2x}{2}$.

cm1_absIneqCount.prompt: A cikin mafita na rashin daidaito ${expr}$, integer nawa ne $x$ za su iya zama? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: $|A|<c$ na nufin abu ɗaya da $-c<A<c$ ($c>0$; haka ma idan alamar ita ce $\le$).
Haɗa dukkan terms masu absolute value a gefe guda don mayar da shi siffar $|A|<c$, sannan ka cire alamar absolute value.
cm1_absIneqCount.explanation: Bayan tsarawa, ana samun ${norm}$, wato ${chain}$; saboda haka ${sol}$. Integers $x$ da suka cika wannan sharadi su ne ${ints}$, jimilla ${ans}$ ne.

cm1_absIneqRep.prompt: Idan mafita na rashin daidaito $|{mx}-a|{op}c$ ita ce ${lo}{op}x{op}{hi}$, menene ƙimar $a+c$ ga constants $a$ da $c$? (An bayar da $c>0$.) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: $|A|{op}c$ na nufin abu ɗaya da $-c{op}A{op}c$.
Sake rubuta shi a matsayin $a-c{op}{mx}{op}a+c$. Idan aka kwatanta ƙarshen range na $x$ da mafitar da aka bayar, za a sami simultaneous linear equations na $a$ da $c$.
cm1_absIneqRep.explanation: Daga $-c{op}{mx}-a{op}c$ ana samun $a-c{op}{mx}{op}a+c$. Tunda mafitar ita ce ${lo}{op}x{op}{hi}$, $a-c={mlo}$ da $a+c={mhi}$. Saboda haka $a={a}$, $c={c}$, kuma $a+c={ans}$.

cm1_coloring.prompt: Akwai yankuna ${n}$, lambobinsu su ne ${regs}$. Yankuna biyu suna taɓa juna ne kawai a waɗannan ma'aurata: ${edges}$. Ana son a yi wa yankuna da suke taɓa juna launuka mabambanta. Idan akwai launuka ${k}$ da za a yi amfani da su, kuma ana iya amfani da launi ɗaya ga yankuna da dama, haka kuma ba sai an yi amfani da dukkan launukan ba, hanyoyi nawa ake da su na yi wa dukkan yankuna launi? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Ka tsara jerin yin launin, sannan yayin da kake yi wa kowane yanki launi, ka ƙirga launukan da suka rage bayan cire launukan da aka yi amfani da su a yankunan maƙwabta da aka riga aka yi wa launi.
Idan yawan launukan da ake da su ya danganta da ko yankunan maƙwabta da aka yi wa launi a baya suna da launi ɗaya ko mabambanta, ka raba su zuwa yanayi sannan ka yi amfani da ƙa'idar haɗawa.
cm1_coloring.explanation: Idan aka yi wa yankuna launi a jere kuma aka ƙirga launukan da za a iya amfani da su bisa ƙa'idar ninkawa da ƙa'idar haɗawa, ana samun ${work}={ans}$ hanyoyi.

cm1_combCommittee.prompt: Ana son a zaɓi mambobin kwamiti ${r}$ daga cikin samari ${m}$ da 'yan mata ${w}$. Dole a zaɓi wani saurayi na musamman, kada a zaɓi wata yarinya ta musamman, sannan a tabbatar an zaɓi aƙalla 'yan mata ${a}$. Hanyoyi nawa ake da su na zaɓen? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Idan an riga an kayyade mutum ɗaya da dole a zaɓa da kuma wanda ba za a zaɓa ba, sai a zaɓi sauran mutanen da ake buƙata daga cikin sauran mutane.
Raba su zuwa yanayin da aka zaɓi 'yan mata ${a}$, ${a}+1$, $\ldots$; a kowanne yanayi tara (yawan hanyoyin zaɓen 'yan mata)$\times$(yawan hanyoyin zaɓen samari).
cm1_combCommittee.explanation: An riga an zaɓi saurayi ɗaya kuma an cire yarinya ɗaya. Saboda haka a zaɓi ƙarin mutane ${r1}$ daga cikin samari ${m1}$ da 'yan mata ${w1}$, inda adadin 'yan matan ya zama aƙalla ${a}$. ${work}={ans}$ ne.

cm1_complexCond.prompt: Ga ainihin lamba $x$, wane ƙimar $x$ ne zai sa hadadden lamba $z={zs}$ ta zama hasashen lamba marar ainihi zalla? (Hasashen lamba marar ainihi zalla ita ce hadaddiyar lamba mai ainihin ɓangare 0 da kuma ɓangaren hasashen lamba marar ainihi wanda ba 0 ba.) (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Sake rubuta $z$ a siffar (ainihin ɓangare)$+$(ɓangaren hasashen lamba marar ainihi)$i$. $i^2=-1$ ne.
Nemo $x$ da ke sa ainihin ɓangaren ya zama $0$, sannan ka tabbatar cewa ɓangaren hasashen lamba marar ainihi ba $0$ ba ne a wannan ƙimar.
cm1_complexCond.explanation: Ainihin ɓangaren $z$ shi ne ${re}$, ɓangaren hasashen lamba marar ainihi kuma shi ne ${im}$. Dole ne ainihin ɓangaren ya zama $0$, saboda haka ${roots}$. A wannan ƙimar, ɓangaren hasashen lamba marar ainihi shi ne ${chk}$; don haka $x={ans}$ ce kaɗai ke sa ta zama hasashen lamba marar ainihi zalla.

cm1_cubicOneReal.prompt: Idan jimillar tushen lamba na ainihi mabambanta na ma'aunin ${eq}=0$ ita ce $S$, kuma ninkar dukkan tushen lamba marar ainihi mabambanta ita ce $T$, menene ƙimar $S+T$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Tushen lamba na cikakkiyar lamba na ma'auni mai cikakkun ma'aunai da babban ma'auninsa 1 yana daga cikin masu raba ma'aunin tsayayye. Tabbatar da hakan ta amfani da ka'idar dalilai.

Idan ka nemo tushen ɗaya ka raba ta hanyar haɗaɗɗen rabo, za a rage wata ma'auni mai ƙaramin daraja. Yi amfani da diskriminant na ma'aunin ƙwadratiki da ya rage domin tabbatar da ko yana da tushen lamba marar ainihi.
cm1_cubicOneReal.explanation: Idan aka warware zuwa dalilai, ana samun ${eq}={fac}$. Diskriminant na ma'aunin ƙwadratiki ${quad} shi ne $D={D}<0$, saboda haka yana da tushen lamba marar ainihi biyu; ninkarsu ita ce $T={q}$, jimillar tushen lamba na ainihi kuma ita ce $S={S}$. Saboda haka $S+T={ans}$ ne.$

cm1_discrimCount.prompt: Cikakkun lambobin $k$ nawa ne a cikin ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ da ke sa tushen biyu na ma'aunin ƙwadratiki ${eq}=0$ su zama lambobi marasa ainihi? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Domin ma'aunin ƙwadratiki ya sami tushen lambobi marasa ainihi, diskriminant dole ya zama $D<0$.
Idan ma'aunin $x$ ma lamba ce mara kyau, yana da sauƙi a yi amfani da $\frac{D}{4}=\left(\frac{b}{2}\right)^2-ac$. Warware wannan dangantaka a matsayin rashin daidaito mai ɗauke da $k$.
cm1_discrimCount.explanation: Dole ne $\frac{D}{4}={d4}<0$ ya cika; idan an warware shi, ana samun ${kr}$. Cikakkun lambobin $k$ da suka cika wannan sharadi su ne ${ks}$, saboda haka akwai ${ans}$ a cikin ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$.

cm1_divisorCount.prompt: Daga cikin masu raba tabbatattu na lambar halitta $N={fac}$, nawa ne suke zama ninkar ${m}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Masu raba da suke ninkar ${m}$ za a iya rubuta su a siffar ${m}\times t$. Ka yi tunanin lambobin da za su iya zama $t$.
Irin wannan mai raba yana da siffar ${m}\times t$, kuma $t$ mai raba ne na $\frac{N}{{m}}$.
cm1_divisorCount.explanation: Masu raba da suke ninkar ${m}$ suna da siffar ${m}\times t$, inda $t$ mai raba ne na $\frac{N}{{m}}={Nm}$. Yawan masu raba shi ne ${prod}={ans}$.

cm1_factorEval.prompt: Yi amfani da factorization domin nemo ƙimar ${expr}$. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Sanya babbar lamba a matsayin alamar $N$, factor numerator sannan ka soke abubuwan da suka yi daidai da denominator.
Misali, a cikin $N^3-1=(N-1)(N^2+N+1)$, $N^4+N^2+1=(N^2+N+1)(N^2-N+1)$, $N^4-1=(N^2+1)(N^2-1)$, factors na numerator sun yi daidai da wasu expressions na denominator.
cm1_factorEval.explanation: Idan $N={N}$, factorization na numerator ya zama ${fac}$, kuma bayan an rage da denominator, ya zama ${simp}$. Saboda haka ƙimar ita ce ${ans}.$

cm1_gridPaths.prompt: A kan coordinate plane, tafiya daga $(0,0)$ zuwa $({a},{b})$ ta hanya mafi guntu, ana motsawa sau ɗaya ɗaya da $+1$ kawai a alkiblar x-axis ko y-axis. Hanyoyi nawa ne suke wucewa ta wurin A$({p},{q})$ amma ba su wuce ta wurin B$({u},{v})$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Yawan shortest paths daga $(0,0)$ zuwa $(m,n)$ shi ne ${}_{m+n}\mathrm{C}_{m}$, yawan hanyoyin zaɓar matakai m zuwa dama da n zuwa sama.
Ga hanyoyin da suke wucewa, ninka yawan hanyoyin kowane segment; don hanyoyin da ba su wucewa, cire hanyoyin da suka bi ta A da B daga duk hanyoyin da suka bi ta A.
cm1_gridPaths.explanation: Yawan hanyoyin da suke bi ta wurin A shi ne ${t1}$. A cikinsu, ${t2}$ ne ke bi ta wurin B ma. Saboda haka yawan hanyoyin da ake nema shi ne ${ans}.$

cm1_iPower.prompt: Idan $z={z}$, menene jimillar real part da imaginary part na ${expr}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)$
hints: Powers na $i$ suna maimaituwa a jere kamar $i,\ -1,\ -i,\ 1$. Idan $z$ yana da siffa mai rikitarwa, da farko sauƙaƙa shi zuwa $a+bi$.
Tunda $z^4=1$, ƙimar powers na $z$ tana maimaituwa bayan kowane 4. Dubi remainder kawai idan aka raba exponent da $4$.
cm1_iPower.explanation: Bayan sauƙaƙawa, $z={zs}$ kuma $z^4=1$. Idan aka maye gurbin exponent da remainder ɗinsa bayan an raba da $4$, ana samun ${work}$. Saboda haka jimillar real part da imaginary part ita ce ${ans}.$

cm1_iPowerSum.prompt: Idan $z={z}$, menene jimillar real part da imaginary part na ${expr}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)$
hints: Da farko sauƙaƙa $z$ zuwa siffar $a+bi$, sannan ka duba ko $z^4=1$. Idan haka ne, za ka iya sanin jimillar powers huɗu a jere $z+z^2+z^3+z^4$.
Idan aka haɗa terms huɗu- huɗu, jimillar kowace rukuni iri ɗaya ce. A ƙarshe za a sami saura na terms daidai da remainder idan aka raba adadin terms da $4$.
cm1_iPowerSum.explanation: Bayan sauƙaƙawa, $z={zs}$, saboda haka $z^4=1$ kuma $z+z^2+z^3+z^4=0$. Idan aka haɗa terms huɗu-huɗu, jimillar kowane rukuni $0$ ce, kuma ${n}={q4}\times4+{rm}$, don haka terms ${rm}$ na farko ne kawai suka rage: ${work}$. Saboda haka jimillar real part da imaginary part ita ce ${ans}.$

cm1_identity.prompt: A cikin identity ${lhs}=${rhs}$ game da $x$, menene ƙimar ${ask}$ idan constants ɗin su ne ${consts}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Identity equation ce da ke zama gaskiya ga kowace ƙimar $x$. Za a iya faɗaɗa bangaren hagu, sannan a kwatanta coefficients na powers iri ɗaya.
Idan $x={p}$, expression ɗin da ke cikin parentheses ya zama $0$. Sanya wannan ƙima domin a samu ƙimar da ta dace da constant term kai tsaye.
cm1_identity.explanation: Ta hanyar kwatanta coefficients ko sanya ƙimar da ta dace ga $x$, za a samu ${sol}$. Saboda haka ${ask}={ans}.$

cm1_linIneqCount.prompt: Daga cikin mafita na simultaneous inequalities ${i1}, ${i2}, integer $x$ nawa ne? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Warware kowace inequality dabam domin nemo iyakar $x$, sannan ka nemo yankin da suka haɗu. Idan aka ninka ko aka raba ɓangarorin biyu da lamba mara kyau, alamar inequality tana juyawa.
Nuna iyakokin biyu a kan number line, sannan ka ƙirga integers a yankin haɗin. Kula ko an haɗa iyakar da alamar equality.
cm1_linIneqCount.explanation: Mafita ta farko ita ce ${s1}$, ta biyu kuma ${s2}$, saboda haka iyakar da suka haɗu ita ce ${s}$. Integers $x$ da suka cika wannan su ne ${ints}$, jimilla ${ans}$.

cm1_linIneqParam.prompt: Idan daidaitattun mafita na rashin daidaito biyu ${i1}$, ${i2}$ sun ƙunshi daidai jimillar ƙimomin lamba ${n}$ na $x$, menene jimillar duk ƙimomin lamba $k$ da suka dace? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko warware rashin daidaiton da ba shi da $k$ domin nemo kewayon $x$; a ɗayan rashin daidaiton, bayyana kewayon $x$ ta amfani da $k$.
Domin yankin da kewayon biyun suka haɗu ya ƙunshi daidai ƙimomin lamba ${n}$, bincika tsakanin waɗanne ƙimomin lamba ne iyakar yankin za ta kasance.
cm1_linIneqParam.explanation: Mafitar rashin daidaito na farko ita ce ${s1}$, na biyu kuma ita ce ${s2}$. Domin a sami daidai ƙimomin lamba ${n}$ na $x$, dole ne ${kr}$; saboda haka ƙimomin lamba $k$ su ne ${ks}$, kuma jimillarsu ita ce ${ans}$.

cm1_matCayley.prompt: Akwai ainihin lambobi $p$ da $q$ da suka cika $A^{{n}}=pA+qE$ ga matriks $A={A}$ da $E={Emat}$. Menene ƙimar ${ask}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Lissafta abubuwan da ke cikin $A^{{n}}$ kai tsaye ta hanyar ninkawa da matriks.
Bayyana abubuwan da ke cikin $pA+qE$ ta amfani da $p$ da $q$, sannan ka kwatanta su da abubuwan da ke cikin $A^{{n}}$ domin samun daidaitattun lissafi biyu masu ɗauke da $p$ da $q$.
cm1_matCayley.explanation: $A^{{n}}={Apow}$ ne. Idan aka kwatanta wannan da abubuwan da ke cikin $pA+qE$, ana samun $p={p}$ da $q={q}$. Saboda haka ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_matWord.prompt: Shaguna A da B suna sayar da nau'ikan kayayyaki ${ni}$. Abun (i, j) na matriks $P={mp}$ shi ne farashin kaya na j a shago i (jere na 1: Shago A, jere na 2: Shago B), a won. Abun (j, l) na matriks $Q={mq}$ shi ne adadin kaya na j da mutum na l daga cikin mutane Ja (shafi na 1) da Wo (shafi na 2) yake son saya. Ja da Wo kowannensu zai sayi duk kayayyakin da yake buƙata daga shago guda, kuma kowannensu zai zaɓi shagon da ya fi arha. Menene jimillar kuɗin da su biyun za su biya, a won? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Kuɗin da mutum l zai biya a shago i ana samunsa ta hanyar ninka abubuwan da ke jere na i na $P$ da waɗanda ke shafi na l na $Q$ bisa tsari sannan a tara su.
Waɗannan ƙimomi su ne abubuwan matriks $PQ$. Nemo $PQ$, sannan ka zaɓi mafi ƙarancin ƙima a kowanne shafi ka tara su.
cm1_matWord.explanation: $PQ={pq}$. Ja zai biya ${pq11}$ won a Shago A ko ${pq21}$ won a Shago B, saboda haka zai biya mafi ƙaranci, ${m1}$ won. Wo zai biya ${pq12}$ won a Shago A ko ${pq22}$ won a Shago B, saboda haka zai biya mafi ƙaranci, ${m2}$ won. Jimillar kuɗin ita ce ${ans}$ won.

cm1_omega.prompt: Idan ɗaya daga cikin tushen ƙima na ƙarya na lissafin digiri na biyu ${eq}$ shi ne $\omega$, menene ƙimar ${expr}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan aka ninka ɓangarorin biyu na lissafin da $x-1$ ko $x+1$, za ka iya nemo ƙimar $\omega^3$.
Idan $\omega^3=\pm1$, to $\omega^6=1$. Ka duba ragowar da aka samu idan aka raba ma'aunin ƙarfin da tsawon zagayowar.
cm1_omega.explanation: Tunda $\omega$ tushen ${eq}$ ne, ${rel}$. Saboda haka ƙimomin ƙarfin suna maimaituwa bayan kowane ${per}$, kuma idan aka duba ragowar ma'aunin ƙarfin bayan an raba da ${per}$, ana samun ${step}$. Don haka ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLine.prompt: Menene ƙimar akai $k$ idan parabola da layi mai zuwa suka taɓa juna? (parabola $y={f}$, layi $y={g}$) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Taɓa juna yana nufin lissafin digiri na biyu da aka samu ta hanyar haɗa lissafin biyun yana da tushen da ya ninka sau biyu.
Kawar da $y$ daga lissafin biyun, sannan ka sa diskriminant ɗin lissafin digiri na biyu ya zama $0$.
cm1_parabolaLine.explanation: Daga ${f}={g}$ ana samun ${eq2}=0$. Tunda suna taɓa juna, diskriminant ɗin $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)=0$. Warware wannan lissafin yana ba da $k={ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLineCount.prompt: Akwai ƙimomin lamba nawa na $k$ a cikin ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ da za su sa parabola da layi masu zuwa kada su haɗu? (parabola $y={f}$, layi $y={g}$) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan zane-zanen biyu ba su haɗu ba, lissafin digiri na biyu da aka samu ta hanyar haɗa lissafinsu ba shi da tushen ainihi.
Nemo kewayon $k$ da ke sa diskriminant na lissafin digiri na biyu bayan kawar da $y$ daga lissafin biyun ya zama $D<0$, sannan ka ƙirga ƙimomin lamba da ke cikin kewayon.
cm1_parabolaLineCount.explanation: Daga ${f}={g}$ ana samun ${eq2}=0$, kuma domin kada su haɗu, dole ne diskriminant ya cika $D<0$. Daga $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)={dk}<0$ ana samun ${kr}$; saboda haka ƙimomin lamba da ke cikin ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ su ne ${ks}$, jimillarsu ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaXaxis.prompt: Zanen aikin quadratic $y={f}$ ya haɗu da axis ɗin $x$ a maki biyu daban-daban, kuma tazarar da ke tsakanin maki biyun ita ce ${d}$. Menene darajar ma'aunin $k$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Abubuwan haɗuwar suna da coordinates na $x$ waɗanda suke tushen biyu na lissafin ${f}=0$.
Idan tushen biyun su ne $\alpha$ da $\beta$, tazarar maki biyun ita ce $|\alpha-\beta|$, kuma $(\alpha-\beta)^2=(\alpha+\beta)^2-4\alpha\beta$.
cm1_parabolaXaxis.explanation: Coordinates na $x$ na maki haɗuwar, $\alpha$ da $\beta$, su ne tushen biyu na ${f}=0$, saboda haka $\alpha+\beta={sm}$. Daga $(\alpha-\beta)^2=({sm})^2-4\alpha\beta={d}^2$, muna samun $\alpha\beta={ab}$. Dangane da alaƙar tushen da coefficients, $\alpha\beta=\frac{k}{{p}}$, don haka $k={ans}$.

cm1_permArrange.prompt: Ana jera samari ${m}$ da ’yan mata ${w}$ a layi. Idan ba a yarda ’yan mata biyu su kasance maƙwabta ba, hanyoyi nawa ne za a iya jerawa? (Duk ɗalibai mutane ne daban.) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Yana da sauƙi a sanya ɓangaren da bai kamata su kasance maƙwabta ba (’yan mata) daga baya. Da farko a jera samarin.
Za a samu guraben ’yan mata tsakanin samari da kuma a ƙarshen layin. A zaɓi gurabe daban-daban daga cikinsu, a saka ’yan matan.
cm1_permArrange.explanation: Akwai hanyoyi ${mf}=${m}! na jera samari ${m}. Akwai hanyoyi ${pv}=${}_{{m1}}\mathrm{P}_{{w}} na zaɓar ${w} daga cikin gurabe ${m1} tsakanin samari da ƙarshen layin da sanya ’yan matan a ciki. Saboda haka, hanyoyi ${mf}\times{pv}=${ans} ne.$

cm1_permNumbers.prompt: Akwai katuna ${nc}, kowacce tana da lamba daban; lambobin da aka rubuta su ne ${digs}. Idan aka zaɓi katuna ${r} aka jera su a layi domin a ƙirƙiri lamba ta halitta mai wurare ${r}, katunan nawa ne za su ba da lamba mai rabawa da ${m}? (Ba a yarda 0 ya kasance a farkon lambar ba.) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)$
hints: Ko lambar tana rabawa da ${m} ya danganta da lambar wuri na ƙarshe. Da farko a zaɓi lambobin da za su iya kasancewa a wuri na ƙarshe.$
Bayan an zaɓi lambar wuri na ƙarshe, a zaɓi lambar farko daga waɗanda ba 0 ba, sannan a cika sauran wuraren da katunan da suka rage (dokar ninkawa).
cm1_permNumbers.explanation: Lambobin da za su iya kasancewa a wuri na ƙarshe su ne ${Lstr}. Ga kowacce, a ƙirga (hanyoyin zaɓar lambar farko)\times(hanyoyin cika sauran wuraren), sannan a tara: ${work}=${ans}.$

cm1_polyDivQR.prompt: Ga polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, idan rabon $P(x)\div({dv})$ yana da quotient $Q(x)$ da remainder $R(x)$, menene darajar $Q({t})+R({t})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: A raba manyan terms ɗin farko domin samun term na farko na quotient, sannan a maimaita aikin ninkawa da mai rabawa da kuma cirewa.
Term na farko na quotient shi ne ${qlead}, kuma degree na remainder ya yi ƙasa da degree na mai rabawa.$
cm1_polyDivQR.explanation: Bayan rabon, $P(x)=({dv})({qq})+({rr})$, saboda haka $Q(x)={qq}$ da $R(x)={rr}$. Don haka $Q({t})+R({t})={ans}.$

cm1_polyProdCoef.prompt: Ga polynomials biyu $A={pa}$ da $B={pb}$, menene coefficient na $x^{{k}}$ idan aka faɗaɗa $AB$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ba sai an faɗaɗa dukkan $AB$ ba. Nemo kawai nau'ukan terms waɗanda samfurinsu ya zama $x^{{k}}$.
Ga kowanne nau'i, tara degrees na term na $A$ da na $B$; idan jimillar ita ce ${k}$, ninka coefficients ɗinsu sannan a tara sakamakon.
cm1_polyProdCoef.explanation: Tara dukkan samfurin coefficients na terms waɗanda samfurinsu yake da sifar $x^{{k}}$: ${terms}=${ans}$. (Idan aka faɗaɗa, $AB={prod}$ ne.)$

cm1_quadFence.prompt: Da shingen da tsawon ${L}$ m, za a gina shinge mai siffar murabba'i mai tsawo, tare da ɗaya daga cikin gefunansa yana manne da bango. Za a sanya rabe-raben tsaye ${j}$ don raba wurin. Idan ba a sa shinge a gefen bangon ba, kuma an yi rabe-raben da wannan shingen, menene mafi girman faɗin dukkan wurin da shingen ya kewaye, a $\mathrm{m}^2$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: A sa tsawon gefen da ke tsaye da bango ya zama $x$ m, sannan ƙirga yawan irin waɗannan gefuna.
Bayyana tsawon gefen da yake layi ɗaya da bango ta amfani da $x$, ka rubuta faɗin a matsayin aikin digiri na biyu na $x$, sannan nemo kololuwar sa.
cm1_quadFence.explanation: Adadin gefunan da ke tsaye da bango shi ne 2 na ƙarshe da kuma rabe-raben ${j}$, jimillarsu ${k}$. Saboda haka tsawon gefen da yake layi ɗaya da bango shi ne $({L}-{k}x)$ m. Faɗin $S(x)=x({L}-{k}x)$ yana kaiwa mafi girma idan $x={u}$, kuma mafi girman ƙimar ita ce ${ans}$ $\mathrm{m}^2$.

cm1_quadIneqAlways.prompt: Lambobin cikakku $k$ nawa ne ke sa rashin daidaito ${ineq}$ ya kasance gaskiya ga duk lambobin gaske? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Coefficient ɗin $x^2$ shi ne $k$, don haka yi la'akari da lokutan $k=0$ da $k\ne0$ dabam. Idan $k\ne0$, parabola tana buɗewa ƙasa, kuma dole ne discriminant ya cika $D<0$ (ko $D\le0$).
Rubuta discriminant $D$ a matsayin aikin $k$, sannan warware rashin daidaiton. Idan parabola tana buɗewa sama ($k<0$), ba zai yiwu ya zama gaskiya ga duk lambobin gaske ba.
cm1_quadIneqAlways.explanation: Idan $k=0$, ɓangaren hagu ya zama adadi tsayayye ${n}$, kuma wannan adadin ya fi $0$, don haka rashin daidaiton yana aiki koyaushe. Idan $k\ne0$, parabola dole ne ta buɗe ƙasa, saboda haka $k>0$, sannan $\frac{D}{4}={d4}{rel}0$. Warware wannan ya ba da ${kr}$. Saboda haka lambobin cikakku $k$, har da $k=0$, su ne ${ks}$, don haka adadinsu ${ans}$ ne.

cm1_quadIneqSol.prompt: Idan mafitar rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu ${mx2}+ax+b{op}0$ ita ce ${sol}$, menene ƙimar ${ask}$ dangane da tsayayyun ƙimomin $a$, $b$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Ƙarshen mafitar rashin daidaiton su ne tushen ma'aunin digiri na biyu ${mx2}+ax+b=0$.
Rubuta ma'aunin a matsayin (coefficient ɗin $x^2$)$\times(x-\alpha)(x-\beta)$, faɗaɗa shi, sannan kwatanta sassan.
cm1_quadIneqSol.explanation: Tun da mafita ita ce ${sol}$, tushen biyun su ne ${lo}$ da ${hi}$. Coefficient ɗin $x^2$ shi ne ${m}$, saboda haka ${mx2}+ax+b={fac}={full}$. Saboda haka $a={a}$, $b={b}$, kuma ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_quadRange.prompt: Menene jimillar mafi girman da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar aikin $y={f}$ a cikin ${m}\le x\le {n}$? (A ce $x$ lambar gaske ce.) (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Da farko duba ko ƙimar $x$ ta kololuwar aikin digiri na biyu tana cikin tazarar da aka bayar.
Idan kololuwa tana cikin tazarar, kwatanta ƙimar aikin a kololuwar da a ƙarshen tazarar biyu. Idan tana waje, kwatanta ƙimomin a ƙarshen tazarar biyu.
cm1_quadRange.explanation: Kololuwar wannan aikin ita ce $({h},{kv})$, kuma a ƙarshen tazarar, ƙimar $y$ ita ce ${fm}$ lokacin da $x={m}$, da ${fn}$ lokacin da $x={n}$. Duba ko ƙimar $x$ ta kololuwa tana cikin tazarar ${m}\le x\le {n}$, sannan nemo mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta. Jimillarsu ita ce ${ans}$.

cm1_quadRevenue.prompt: Farashin kaya a wurin saye shi ne ${w}$ won, kuma idan aka sayar da shi a kan ${a}$ won, ana sayar da kaya ${b}$ a kowace rana. Duk lokacin da aka ƙara farashin sayarwa da ${s}$ won, yawan kayan da ake sayarwa a rana yana raguwa da ${c}$. Idan za a iya ƙara farashin sau ${s}$, sau adadin lamba cikakkiya (har da sau $0$), menene mafi girman ribar rana a won? (Ana lissafa riba da (farashin sayarwa $-$ farashin saye)$\times$(yawan kaya).) (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: A sa yawan ƙarin farashin ya zama $t$, sannan bayyana farashin sayarwa da adadin tallace-tallace ta amfani da $t$.
(Ribar kowane kaya)$\times$(yawan tallace-tallace) aikin digiri na biyu ne na $t$. Duba ko ƙimar $t$ a kololuwa lamba cikakkiya ce.
cm1_quadRevenue.explanation: Idan yawan ƙarin farashin shi ne $t$, ribar kowane kaya ita ce $({e1}+{s}t)$ won, kuma yawan tallace-tallace shi ne $({b}-{c}t)$ kaya. Saboda haka ribar ita ce $({e1}+{s}t)({b}-{c}t)$ won. Wannan aikin digiri na biyu yana kaiwa mafi girma idan $t={tstar}$, kuma ribar a lokacin ita ce ${ans}$ won.

cm1_remQuadDiv.prompt: Ga polynomial $P(x)$, remainder na $P(x)\div({dv1})$ shi ne ${r1}$, na $P(x)\div({dv2})$ kuma ${r2}$. Idan remainder na $P(x)\div\left(({dv1})({dv2})\right)$ shi ne $R(x)$, mene ne ƙimar $R({c})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Remainder idan an raba da quadratic polynomial linear ne ko constant. A sa $R(x)=px+q$.
A cikin $P(x)=({dv1})({dv2})Q(x)+R(x)$, saka waɗancan ƙimomin biyu da ke sa divisor ya zama $0$.
cm1_remQuadDiv.explanation: Idan aka ce $R(x)=px+q$, to $R({a})=P({a})={r1}$, $R({b})=P({b})={r2}$. Warware equations biyu tare yana ba da $p={p}$, $q={q}$, saboda haka $R(x)={Rx}$ kuma $R({c})={ans}.$

cm1_remUnknown.prompt: Ga polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, idan remainder na $P(x)\div({dv})$ shi ne ${R}$, mene ne ƙimar constant $k$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Remainder theorem: remainder idan an raba polynomial $P(x)$ da $x-a$ daidai yake da $P(a)$.
Ƙimar $x$ da ke sa divisor ya zama $0$ ita ce $x={t}$. Saka wannan ƙima cikin $P(x)$ domin samun linear equation mai ɗauke da $k$.
cm1_remUnknown.explanation: Bisa remainder theorem, dole ne $P({t})={R}$. Tunda $P({t})={lhs}$, daga ${lhs}={R}$ ana samun $k={ans}.$

cm1_rootSignCond.prompt: Mene ne mafi ƙaramin integer $k$ wanda ke sa duka distinct real roots biyu na quadratic equation ${eq}=0$ su fi ${t}$ girma? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan aka kira gefen hagu $f(x)$, wannan yanayin yana nufin graph na $y=f(x)$ ya haɗu da x-axis a maki biyu dabam, kuma waɗannan maki biyu suna gefen dama na $x={t}$.
Duba duk waɗannan sharuɗɗan: discriminant $D>0$, wurin axis of symmetry (axis $x>{t}$), da $f({t})>0$.
cm1_rootSignCond.explanation: A cikin $f(x)={eq}$, domin roots biyu su fi ${t}$ girma dole ne (i) $\frac{D}{4}={d4}>0$, (ii) a axis $x=k$ a samu $k>{t}$, (iii) $f({t})={ft}>0$. Mafi ƙaramin integer $k$ da ya cika sharuɗɗan duka shi ne ${ans}.$

cm1_symmetricEval.prompt: Ga real numbers $x$ da $y$, idan ${cond}$, mene ne ƙimar ${expr}? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)$
hints: Bayyana expression ɗin da ake nema ta amfani da jimilla $x+y$ da ninka $xy$. Misali, $x^2+y^2=(x+y)^2-2xy$.
Ga cubes, yi amfani da $x^3+y^3=(x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)$; ga powers na huɗu, fara nemo $x^2+y^2$, sannan yi amfani da $x^4+y^4=(x^2+y^2)^2-2(xy)^2$.
cm1_symmetricEval.explanation: Idan aka sake tsara formula na ninkawa, ana samun ${expr}={work}$. (A nan, $(x-y)^2=(x+y)^2-4xy={dd}\ge0$, saboda haka akwai real numbers $x$ da $y$ da suka cika sharaɗin.) Don haka ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}.$

cm1_symmetricInv.prompt: Ga real number $x$, idan $x+\frac{1}{x}={k}$, mene ne ƙimar ${expr}? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)$
hints: Ninkar $x$ da $\frac{1}{x}$ ita ce $1$. Saboda haka, idan an san jimillarsu $x+\frac{1}{x}$, za a iya nemo jimillar powers.
$x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^2-2$, $x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^3-3\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)$; don power na huɗu, sake yin square na $x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}$.
cm1_symmetricInv.explanation: Idan aka sake tsara formula na ninkawa, ana samun ${expr}={work}$. (Ga real $x$, $\left|x+\frac{1}{x}\right|\ge2$, saboda haka akwai real number da ya cika sharaɗin.) Don haka ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}.$

cm1_sysReal.prompt: Tsarin lissafi ${e1}$, ${e2}$ yana da mafita ta gaske $(x, y)$. Lambobin $k$ nawa ne a cikin $-{M}\le k\le {M}$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Yi amfani da ɗaya daga cikin ma'aunai don kawar da $y$; za ka samu ma'aunin digiri na biyu mai alaƙa da $x$.
Domin samun mafita ta gaske, discriminant ɗin wannan ma'aunin digiri na biyu dole ne ya zama $0$ ko fiye.
cm1_sysReal.explanation: Idan aka kawar da $y$ ta amfani da ma'auni ɗaya, za a samu ma'aunin digiri na biyu mai alaƙa da $x$. Domin samun mafita ta gaske, dole ne ${dcond}$. Wato ${kr}$, saboda haka akwai lambobin cikakku ${ans}$ a cikin $-{M}\le k\le {M}$.

cm1_sysTwo.prompt: Idan lambobin gaske $x$, $y$ mafita ne na tsarin lissafi ${e1}$, ${e2}$, menene mafi girman ƙimar $x$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Yi ƙoƙarin rage yawan alamomi ta hanyar warware ɗaya daga cikin ma'aunai ko bayyana alama ɗaya ta amfani da ɗayar.
Nemo duk mafita ta gaske $(x, y)$ da za su yiwu, sannan ka zaɓi mafi girman ƙimar $x$.
cm1_sysTwo.explanation: Idan aka warware tsarin lissafin, za a samu $(x,\ y)={sols}$. A cikin waɗannan, mafi girman ƙimar $x$ ita ce ${ans}$.

cm1_vietaExpr.prompt: A ce tushen ma'aunin digiri na biyu ${eq}=0$ su ne $\alpha$, $\beta$. Menene ƙimar ${expr}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Jimillar tushen $ax^2+bx+c=0$ ita ce $-\frac{b}{a}$, kuma samfurinsu shi ne $\frac{c}{a}$.
Bayyana abin da ake nema ta amfani da $\alpha+\beta$ da $\alpha\beta$, sannan saka ƙimomin.
cm1_vietaExpr.explanation: Dangantakar tushen da ma'aunai ta nuna cewa $\alpha+\beta={sf}$, $\alpha\beta={pf}$. Saboda haka ${expr}={work}={res}$.

cm1_vietaUnknown.prompt: A ce tushen ma'aunin digiri na biyu $x^2-kx{cs}=0$ su ne $\alpha$, $\beta$. Idan ${cond}$, menene ƙimar $k$ mai kyau? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Dangantakar tushen da ma'aunai ta nuna cewa jimillar tushen biyu ita ce $k$, kuma samfurinsu shi ne ${c}$.
Bayyana sharadin da aka bayar ta amfani da $\alpha+\beta$, $\alpha\beta$, ko sanya ɗaya daga cikin tushen ya zama alama sannan ka bayyana ɗayan ta amfani da ita don nemo $k$.
cm1_vietaUnknown.explanation: Dangantakar tushen da ma'aunai ta nuna cewa $\alpha+\beta=k$, $\alpha\beta={c}$. ${work}$ Saboda haka $k={ans}$.

cm2_amgmMin.prompt: Idan ${dom}$, menene mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ${ex}$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Ga kowace adadi biyu masu kyau $A$, $B$, $A+B\ge 2\sqrt{A\,B}$ (daidaito yana samuwa idan $A=B$).

Haɗa adadun ta yadda samfurinsu ya zama tsayayye, sannan yi amfani da dangantakar matsakaicin lissafi da matsakaicin yanayin lissafi. Tabbatar cewa ƙimar $x$ da ke sa daidaito ya samu tana cikin sharadin ${dom}$.
cm2_amgmMin.explanation: ${work}$, kuma daidaito yana samuwa idan $x={xe}$. Wannan ƙimar tana cikin sharadin ${dom}$. Saboda haka mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ita ce ${ans}$.

cm2_chordLength.prompt: Da'ira $C$: ${circ}$, layi $l$: ${line}$. Menene tsawon maɗaurin da $l$ ya yanke a $C$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Layinu mai tsaye daga cibiyar da'ira zuwa layi yana raba maɗauri gida biyu daidai. Da farko nemo tazara tsakanin cibiyar da layin.
Idan radius ɗin da'ira $r$ ne, kuma tazarar cibiyar da layin $d$ ce, tsawon maɗaurin shi ne $2\sqrt{r^2-d^2}$.
cm2_chordLength.explanation: Cibiyar da'irar ita ce $({cx}, {cy})$, kuma radius ɗin ta ${rad}$. Tazarar cibiyar da layin ita ce $d=\frac{|{la}\times({cx})+({lb})\times({cy})+({lc})|}{\sqrt{({la})^2+({lb})^2}}=\frac{{dh}}{{h}}={d}$. Saboda haka tsawon maɗaurin shi ne $2\sqrt{{rad}^2-{d}^2}=2\times{half}={ans}$.

cm2_circleGeneral.prompt: Siffar da ma'aunin ${eq}$ ke wakilta da'ira ce. Idan cibiyar da'irar tana $(a, b)$ kuma tsawon radius ɗinta $r$ ne, menene ƙimar $a+b+r$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Mayar da shi zuwa siffar $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$ ta hanyar kammala murabba'in $x$ da $y$.
Raba ɓangarorin biyu da coefficient ɗin $x^2$ da $y^2$, sannan tattara kalmomin $x$ tare da juna da na $y$ tare da juna domin kammala murabba'ai.
cm2_circleGeneral.explanation: Coefficient ɗin $x^2$ shi ne ${kk}$. Raba ɓangarorin biyu da wannan coefficient sannan kammala murabba'in don samun ${std}$. Cibiyar ita ce $({cx}, {cy})$, radius ɗin kuma ${rad}$, saboda haka $a+b+r={cx}+({cy})+{rad}={ans}$.

cm2_circleTangentAxes.prompt: Daga cikin da’irori masu cibiyarsu a kwata na farko kuma suke taɓa axis ɗin $x$ da na $y$, akwai da’irori guda biyu da suke wucewa ta wurin $P({p}, {q})$. Menene radius mafi girma daga cikin radius biyun? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Cibiyar da’irar da ke cikin kwata na farko kuma take taɓa axis biyu ita ce $(r, r)$, radius ɗinta kuma $r$.
Saka haɗin wurin cikin da’irar $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$, sannan ka warware ma’aunin quadratic na $r$.
cm2_circleTangentAxes.explanation: Ma’aunin da’irar shi ne $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ ($r>0$). Tun da tana wucewa ta wurin $P$, $({p}-r)^2+({q}-r)^2=r^2$, wato $r^2-{u}r+{t}=0$. Idan aka warware, $r={rs}$ ko $r={rl}$; saboda haka radius mafi girma shi ne ${ans}.$

cm2_compFindG.prompt: Idan $f(x)={f}$ ga ayyuka biyu $f$ da $g$, kuma aikin haɗin gwiwa $(f\circ g)(x)={comp}$ ne, menene darajar $g({t})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Tun da $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, saka $g(x)$ a wurin $x$ cikin furucin $f$.
Daga $f(g(x))={comp}$, warware ma’aunin dangane da $g(x)$ domin nemo $g(x)$, sannan saka $x={t}$.

cm2_compTable.prompt: An ba da ayyuka biyu $f$ da $g$ daga tarin $X=\{{xset}\}$ zuwa $X$ kamar haka: $f$: ${ft}$, $g$: ${gt}$. Nawa ne yawan abubuwan $x$ a cikin $X$ da ke cika $(f\circ g)(x)=(g\circ f)(x)$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, kuma $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$. Nemo kowace daraja dabam ga kowane $x$.
Ga $x=1, 2, \dots$, yi jadawali don kwatanta $f(g(x))$ da $g(f(x))$ a jere.
cm2_compTable.explanation: Idan aka nemo $f(g(x))$ da $g(f(x))$ ga kowane $x$, ${work}$. Akwai abubuwan $x$ guda ${ans} da suke ba da darajoji iri ɗaya.$

cm2_divPoint.prompt: Ga maki biyu $A({x1}, {y1})$ da $B({x2}, {y2})$, akwai maki $P$ da ke raba sashen layi $AB$ a ciki. Idan $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={m}:{n}$, menene jimillar haɗin $x$ da haɗin $y$ na maki $P$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Haɗin maki da ke raba sashen layi $AB$ zuwa $m:n$ shi ne $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Nemo haɗin $x$ da na $y$ dabam, sannan ka haɗa su. Haɗin $x$ shi ne $\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}}$.
cm2_divPoint.explanation: Tun da $P\left(\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}},\ \frac{{m}\times({y2})+{n}\times({y1})}{{m}+{n}}\right)=({px}, {py})$, jimillar haɗin biyun ita ce ${px}+({py})={ans}.$

cm2_divRatioFind.prompt: A cikin maki uku $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, da $P({px}, {py})$, maki $P$ yana kan sashen layi $AB$, kuma $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=m:n$. Idan $m$ da $n$ lambobin ƙidaya ne marasa rabon gama gari, menene darajar $m+n$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan $P$ ya raba $AB$ zuwa $m:n$, haɗin $x$ shi ne $\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n}$. Yi amfani da haɗin $P$ don samo rabon a baya.
Yi amfani da bambancin haɗin $x$ don samo $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=|p_x-x_1|:|x_2-p_x|$, sannan ka taƙaita.
