cm2_divRatioFind.explanation: Idan aka kwatanta haɗin $x$, $|{px}-({x1})|={u}$, kuma $|({x2})-({px})|={w}$. Saboda haka $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={u}:{w}$; idan aka rubuta shi a matsayin rabon lambobi marasa rabon gama gari, ${m}:{n}$. (Haɗin $y$ ma yana ba da wannan rabon.) Saboda haka $m+n={ans}.$

cm2_existsInterval.prompt: $U$ shi ne set na duk integers daga ${p}$ zuwa ${q}$ inclusive. Menene mafi girman integer $k$ da ke sa proposition 'akwai wani element $x$ na $U$ da ya cika ${form}' ta zama gaskiya? (Rubuta lamba kawai)$
hints: 'Akwai wani $x$' yana gaskiya idan akwai aƙalla x ɗaya da ya cika condition ɗin.
Mayar da inequality zuwa siffar $k<g(x)$, sannan nemo mafi girman ƙimar $g(x)$ a kan elements na $U$.
cm2_existsInterval.explanation: Ana iya mayar da ${form}$ zuwa siffar $k<{gx}$. Daga cikin elements na $U$, ${gx}$ ya kai maximum ${gm}$ idan $x={xm}$. Idan $k<{gm}$, proposition ɗin gaskiya ne a wannan x. Saboda haka mafi girman integer $k$ shi ne ${ans}.$

cm2_funcInjective.prompt: Daga cikin injective functions $f$ daga set $X=\{{xset}\}$ zuwa set $Y=\{{yset}\}$, nawa ne ke cika $f(1)\le {t}$ da $f(2)\ge {u}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Injective function tana haɗa elements daban-daban na $X$ da function values daban-daban. Da farko zaɓi $f(1)$ da $f(2)$.
Ƙirga yawan pairs $(f(1), f(2))$ da ke da $f(1)\ne f(2)$, sannan ka ninka da yawan hanyoyin sanya function values ga sauran elements.
cm2_funcInjective.explanation: Akwai zaɓuɓɓuka ${t}$ don $f(1)$ da ${n}-{u}+1$ don $f(2)$, kuma akwai ${ov}$ lokutan da $f(1)=f(2)$, saboda haka $(f(1), f(2))$ akwai ${pairs}$. Sauran elements ${mr}$ suna injectively map zuwa values ${nr}$ da suka rage ta hanyoyi ${rest}$, saboda haka jimillar functions ${pairs}\times{rest}={ans}$.

cm2_funcMonotone.prompt: Daga cikin functions $f$ daga set $X=\{{xset}\}$ zuwa set $Y=\{{yset}\}$, nawa ne ke cika ${chain}$ da $f(1)\ge {u}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan $f(1)<f(2)<\cdots$, function values duka daban ne, kuma zaɓar values ɗin yana ƙayyade assignment ɗaya kacal bisa girma.
Possible values na function suna integers daga ${u}$ zuwa ${w}$ inclusive; ana zaɓar distinct ${m}$ daga cikinsu.
cm2_funcMonotone.explanation: Ana zaɓar distinct ${m}$ values daga integers ${k}$ da ke tsakanin ${u}$ da ${w}$ inclusive. Idan aka sanya values ɗin da aka zaɓa daga ƙarami zuwa babba ga $f(1), f(2), \dots$, assignment ɗaya ne kacal, saboda haka adadin ita ce $_{{k}}\mathrm{C}_{{m}}={ans}$.

cm2_inclusionParam.prompt: Ga sets biyu na real numbers $A=\{x\mid {Ac}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {Cc}\}$, nawa ne sets $B=\{x\mid a\le x\le b\}$ ($a$, $b$ integers ne) ke cika $A\subset B\subset C$? (A nan, $\subset$ ya haɗa da sets da suke daidai.) (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Da farko rubuta $A$ da $C$ a matsayin intervals masu siffar $\alpha\le x\le\beta$.

Idan $A\subset B$, to $a$ ba ya fi ƙarshen hagu na A girma, kuma b bai gaza ƙarshen dama na A ba. Idan $B\subset C$, a da b dole su kasance cikin interval na C. Ƙirga ƙimar da za a iya ɗauka ga a da b dabam-dabam.
cm2_inclusionParam.explanation: $A=\{x\mid {al}\le x\le {ar}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {cl}\le x\le {cr}\}$. Domin $A\subset B\subset C$, dole ne ${cl}\le a\le {al}$ da ${ar}\le b\le {cr}$. Akwai ${na}$ zaɓuɓɓuka ga a da ${nb}$ ga b, saboda haka adadin B sets ita ce ${na}\times{nb}={ans}$.

cm2_inverseQuadDom.prompt: Idan $g$ inverse function ne na $f(x)={fx}$ (${dom}$), menene ƙimar $g({t})$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Da an takaita domain (${dom}$), $f$ injective ne kuma yana da inverse function.
Idan $g({t})=x$, to $f(x)={t}$. Warware quadratic equation $f(x)={t}$, sannan ka zaɓi tushen da ke cikin domain.
cm2_inverseQuadDom.explanation: Ana iya rubuta shi a siffar $f(x)={vf}$, kuma daga $f(x)={t}$ ana samun ${sq}={s2}$, saboda haka ${xp}=\pm{s}$. Tunda domain shi ne ${dom}$, ${xp}={rt}$, kuma $g({t})={ans}$.

cm2_inverseRational.prompt: Idan inverse function na $f(x)=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ shi ne $g$, mene ne ƙimar $g({k})$? (A nan, domain na $f$ ya ƙunshi dukkan real numbers waɗanda denominator ɗinsu ba sifili ba ne.) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan $g({k})=x$, to $f(x)={k}$.
Ninka ɓangarorin biyu na $\frac{{num}}{{den}}={k}$ da denominator, sannan ka warware linear equation mai ɗauke da $x$.
cm2_inverseRational.explanation: Idan aka ce $g({k})=x$, to $f(x)={k}$, saboda haka ${num}={k}\times({den})$. Idan aka shirya dangane da $x$, ana samun $({coef})x={rhs}$, don haka $x={ans}$, wato $g({k})={ans}.$

cm2_irrLineCount.prompt: Nawa ne adadin integers $k$ waɗanda ke sa curve $y=\sqrt{{fr}}$ da line $y=x+k$ su sami maki biyu na haɗuwa? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: A ayyana sabon symbol $t$ kamar haka: $t=\sqrt{{fr}}$ ($t\ge 0$). Sai a iya bayyana $x$ ta amfani da $t$. Adadin maki na haɗuwa daidai yake da adadin distinct nonnegative real roots na quadratic equation mai ɗauke da $t$.
Sharuɗɗan da quadratic equation mai ɗauke da $t$ ke buƙata domin ta sami distinct nonnegative roots biyu su ne $D>0$, (jimillar roots)$\ge 0$, da (ninkar roots)$\ge 0$.
cm2_irrLineCount.explanation: Idan aka ayyana $t$ ta $t=\sqrt{{fr}}\ (t\ge 0)$, to $x=\frac{t^2-({b})}{{a}}$, kuma daga $t=x+k$ ana samun $t^2-{a}t+({a}k-({b}))=0$. Domin samun distinct nonnegative roots biyu, dole ne $D={a}^2-4({a}k-({b}))>0$ kuma ninkar roots ${a}k-({b})\ge 0$ (jimillar roots ${a}>0$). Saboda haka ${lt}\le k<{ht}$. Integers $k$ da suka cika wannan sharaɗi su ne daga ${lo}$ zuwa ${hi}$, jimillarsu ${ans}.$

cm2_irrationalMinMax.prompt: Mene ne maximum value na function $f(x)={fx}$ a kan ${lo}\le x\le {hi}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Tunda furuci a ƙarƙashin tushen square root linear ne, $f(x)$ yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa ne kawai yayin da $x$ ke ƙaruwa. Saboda haka ka kwatanta ƙimomin function a ƙarshen interval biyu.
Nemo ƙimar function idan $x={lo}$ da kuma idan $x={hi}$, sannan ka zaɓi mafi girma.
cm2_irrationalMinMax.explanation: $f({lo})=\sqrt{{rl}}+({c})={flo}$, $f({hi})=\sqrt{{rh}}+({c})={fhi}$. A wannan interval, $f$ yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa ne kawai; saboda haka mafi girma daga cikin waɗannan ƙimomi biyu shi ne maximum, wato ${ans}.$

cm2_irrationalPass.prompt: Idan maki ɗaya a kan graph na irrational function $y=\sqrt{a({xp})}{qs}$ ($a$ constant ne da ba sifili ba) shi ne $P({x0}, {y0})$, mene ne ƙimar $a$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Saka coordinates ɗin maki a cikin equation. Ka lura cewa square root ba ya zama ƙasa da $0$.
Ka bar square root shi kaɗai, sannan ka yi square na ɓangarorin biyu kuma ka warware linear equation mai ɗauke da $a$.
cm2_irrationalPass.explanation: Idan aka saka maki $P$, ana samun ${y0}=\sqrt{a({x0}-({p}))}+({q})$, saboda haka $\sqrt{a\times({d})}={s}$. Idan aka yi square na ɓangarorin biyu, $a\times({d})={s2}$, saboda haka $a={ans}.$

cm2_lineCircleCount.prompt: Da’ira $C$: ${circ}$, line $l$: ${line}$. Nawa ne adadin positive integers $k$ waɗanda ke sa $C$ da $l$ su haɗu a maki biyu dabam? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da’ira da line suna haɗuwa a maki biyu dabam idan nisan tsakanin center ɗin da line ya fi radius ƙanƙanta.
Ka shirya inequality $\frac{|{u}\times({cx})+({w})\times({cy})-k|}{\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}}<{rad}$ domin ta shafi $k$.
cm2_lineCircleCount.explanation: Nisan daga center $({cx}, {cy})$ zuwa line dole ya zama ƙasa da radius ${rad}$, saboda haka $|{K0}-k|<{rad}\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}=\sqrt{{R2}}$. Integers da suka cika wannan su ne ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$; daga cikinsu akwai ${ans}$ positive integers.

cm2_lineThroughPerp.prompt: Menene y-coordinate na wurin da perpendicular daga point $P({px}, {py})$ zuwa line $l$: ${line}$ ya haɗu da $y$-axis? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan lines biyu sun yi perpendicular, samfurin slopes ɗinsu $-1$ ne.
Da farko nemo slope na $l$, sannan ka kafa point-slope equation ta amfani da slope na perpendicular line, ka sanya $x=0$.
cm2_lineThroughPerp.explanation: Slope na line $l$ ita ce ${ms}$, saboda haka slope na perpendicular line ita ce ${mp}$. Tunda yana wucewa ta P, $y-({py})={mp}\left(x-({px})\right)$, kuma idan aka sanya $x=0$, $y={ans}$.

cm2_necessaryDiv.prompt: Ga conditions biyu game da integer $x$: $p$: $x$ multiple ne na $m$; $q$: $x$ multiple ne na ${n}$. Adadin natural numbers $m$ da ke sa $p$ necessary condition na $q$ amma ba sufficient condition ba nawa ne? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan $p$ necessary condition ne ga $q$, to $q\Rightarrow p$. A matsayin truth sets, $Q\subset P$.
Domin duk multiples na ${n}$ su zama multiples na $m$, dole ne $m$ divisor ne na ${n}$. Domin wannan ba sufficient condition ba, $p\Rightarrow q$ dole ya gaza.
cm2_necessaryDiv.explanation: Saboda $p$ necessary condition ne, $q\Rightarrow p$, wato duk multiples na ${n}$ dole ne su zama multiples na $m$, wanda ke nufin $m$ divisor ne na ${n}$. Domin wannan ba sufficient condition ba, $p\Rightarrow q$ dole ya zama ƙarya; cikin divisors na ${n}$, hakan ba ya faruwa ne kawai idan $m={n}$. Adadin divisors na ${n}$ shi ne ${nd}$, saboda haka adadin ƙimar $m$ da ake nema ${nd}-1={ans}$.

cm2_perpParam.prompt: Ga lines biyu $l_1: {l1}$ da $l_2: {l2}$, jimillar duk real values na $k$ da ke sa lines ɗin su zama parallel ko perpendicular nawa ce? (Idan lines ɗin sun zo daidai, kada a ɗauke su parallel.) (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Lines $ax+by+c=0$ da $a'x+b'y+c'=0$ suna parallel (ko coincident) idan $ab'-a'b=0$, kuma perpendicular idan $aa'+bb'=0$.
Sharadin parallel yana zama quadratic equation kan $k$, na perpendicular kuma linear equation ne. Warware kowanne, sannan ka tara values ɗin.
cm2_perpParam.explanation: Coefficients na $x$ da $y$ a $l_1$ su ne ${p}$ da $k$, na $l_2$ kuma $k{qs}$ da ${rr}$. Sharadin parallel: ${p}\times({rr})=k(k{qs})$, wato ${eqPar}=0$, wanda ya ba da $k={k1}$ ko $k={k2}$, kuma babu ɗayan da ke sa lines ɗin su zo daidai. Sharadin perpendicular: ${p}(k{qs})+({rr})k=0$, wanda ya ba da $k={k3}$. Saboda haka jimillar ita ce ${k1}+({k2})+({k3})={ans}$.

cm2_pointLineDist.prompt: Menene nisan daga point $P({x0}, {y0})$ zuwa line ${line}$? (Za ka iya rubuta decimal ko fraction kamar 3/4)
hints: Nisan tsakanin point $(x_0,y_0)$ da line $ax+by+c=0$ ita ce $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$.
Nemo numerator $|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|$; denominator kuma shi ne $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}$.
cm2_pointLineDist.explanation: A cikin $\frac{|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|}{\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}}$, numerator shi ne ${N}$ kuma $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}={h}$, saboda haka nisan ita ce $\frac{{N}}{{h}}={ans}$.

cm2_rationalAsym.prompt: Idan asymptotes biyu na jadawalin rational function $y=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ su ne layukan $x=p$ da $y=q$, menene ƙimar $p+q$? (Za ka iya rubuta decimal ko fraction kamar 3/4)
hints: Ƙimar x da ke sa denominator ya zama $0$ ita ce vertical asymptote.
Ƙimar da y ke kusantowa idan absolute value na $x$ ya yi girma sosai ita ce horizontal asymptote. Ita ce ratio na coefficients na x a numerator da denominator.
cm2_rationalAsym.explanation: Vertical asymptote ita ce ƙimar x da ke sa denominator ya zama $0$, wato line $x={px}$. Idan $x\to\infty$, $y\to\frac{{a}}{{c}}={qy}$, saboda haka horizontal asymptote ita ce $y={qy}$. Don haka $p+q=({px})+({qy})={ans}$.

cm2_rationalIntersectCount.prompt: A cikin ƙimomin lamba $n$ masu cika $-{N}\le n\le {N}$, guda nawa ne ke sa jadawalin aikin $y={fr}$ da layi ${line}$ su haɗu a maki 2? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Haɗa daidaitattun lissafin biyun domin samun lissafin digiri na biyu mai ɗauke da $x$, sannan ka yi tunanin sharadin samun tushen ainihi biyu dabam-dabam (diskriminant).
Tunda an ninka da furuci mai ɗauke da $x$ domin kawar da abin da ke ƙasa a kaso, ka kuma tabbatar cewa tushen lissafin digiri na biyu ba ya sa abin da ke ƙasa ya zama $0$.
cm2_rationalIntersectCount.explanation: Idan aka haɗa su, daga $\frac{{k}}{{den}}{qs}={mx}+n$ ana kawar da abin da ke ƙasa a kaso a samar da lissafin digiri na biyu, wanda diskriminant ɗinsa shi ne $D=({nstr})^2{ds}$. (Tushen ba sa mayar da abin da ke ƙasa a kaso zuwa $0$.) Dole ne $D>0$; idan aka cire ƙimomin lamba $n$ da ba su cika wannan sharadi ba, daga cikin ƙimomin ${tot}$ da ke yankin za a cire ${bad}$, don haka saura ${ans}$.

cm2_rationalParam.prompt: Wani maki a kan jadawalin aikin $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k$ ba akai-akai na $0$ ba) bayan an matsar da shi ${p}$ a kan axis $x$ da ${q}$ a kan axis $y$ shi ne $P({x0}, {y0})$. Menene ma'aunin $x$ na wurin da wannan jadawalin ya haɗu da axis $x$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Bayan matsar da jadawali, $x$ ya zama $x-({p})$, kuma $y$ ya zama $y-({q})$ a cikin furuci.
Saka ma'aunan wurin da aka bayar domin nemo $k$, sannan ka saka $y=0$.
cm2_rationalParam.explanation: Jadawalin bayan matsawa shi ne $y=\frac{k}{{xsh}}{ysh}$. Tunda maki $P$ yana kan jadawalin, daga ${y0}=\frac{k}{{dx}}{ysh}$ ana samun $k={kk}$. Idan $y=0$, to $\frac{{kk}}{{xsh}}={nq}$, saboda haka $x={ans}$.

cm2_reflectChainOrder.prompt: Matsar da maki $P(a, b)$ da ${m}$ a kan axis $x$ da ${n}$ a kan axis $y$ ya ba da maki $Q$. Ana nuna maki $R$ ta hanyar juyar da $Q$ a kan asalin ma'auni, sannan a juya $R$ a kan axis $x$ domin samun $S$. Idan ma'aunan $S$ su ne $({sx}, {sy})$, menene ƙimar $a+b$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Juyawa a kan asalin ma'auni ita ce $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, kuma juyawa a kan axis $x$ ita ce $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$.
Tunda ana matsawa kafin juyawa, alamun adadin matsawa ma suna juye. Ka bi matakan baya daga $S$, ko ka bayyana su ta amfani da $a$ da $b$.
cm2_reflectChainOrder.explanation: Idan aka bayyana ta amfani da $a$ da $b$, $Q(a+({m}), b+({n}))$, $R(-a-({m}), -b-({n}))$, sannan $S(-a-({m}), b+({n}))$. Daga $-a-({m})={sx}$ ana samun $a={pa}$, kuma daga $b+({n})={sy}$ ana samun $b={pb}$; saboda haka $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectCurve.prompt: Idan aka fara juyar da jadawalin aikin $y={orig}$ a kan asalin ma'auni, sannan aka matsar da shi ${m}$ a kan axis $x$ da ${n}$ a kan axis $y$, ana samun parabola mai kololuwa $(s, t)$. Menene ƙimar $s+t$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Juyawa a kan asalin ma'auni ita ce $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$; saboda haka sauya $x$ zuwa $-x$ da $y$ zuwa $-y$ a cikin furucin.
Za ka iya nemo kololuwar parabola ta farko sannan ka yi amfani da matsawar biyu bi da bi, ko kuma ka kafa furucin jadawalin bayan matsawa kai tsaye.
cm2_reflectCurve.explanation: Kololuwar parabola ta farko ita ce $({h}, {k})$. Bayan juyawa a kan asalin ma'auni, parabola tana da siffar $y=-({orig2})$, kuma kololuwarta ita ce $({nh}, {nk})$. Idan aka matsar da ita ${m}$ a kan axis $x$ da ${n}$ a kan axis $y$, to $(s, t)=({s}, {t})$, saboda haka $s+t={ans}$.

cm2_reflectPointChain.prompt: Juyar da maki $P(a, b)$ a kan layin $y=x$ ya ba da maki $Q$; juyar da $Q$ a kan axis $y$ ya ba da $R$; sannan matsar da $R$ da ${m}$ a kan axis $x$ da ${n}$ a kan axis $y$ ya ba da $S$. Idan ma'aunan $S$ su ne $({sx}, {sy})$, menene ƙimar $a+b$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Juyawa a kan layin $y=x$ ita ce $(x,y)\to(y,x)$, kuma juyawa a kan axis $y$ ita ce $(x,y)\to(-x,y)$.
Bi matakan baya ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga $S$, ko ka bayyana ma'aunan daga $P(a,b)$ zuwa $S$ ta amfani da $a$ da $b$.
cm2_reflectPointChain.explanation: Idan aka bayyana ta amfani da $a$ da $b$, $Q(b, a)$, $R(-b, a)$, sannan $S(-b+({m}), a+({n}))$. Daga $-b+({m})={sx}$ ana samun $b={pb}$, kuma daga $a+({n})={sy}$ ana samun $a={pa}$; saboda haka $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectShortest.prompt: Ga points A$({a1}, {a2})$, B$({b1}, {b2})$ a kan coordinate plane, da point P da ke motsi a kan $x$-axis, menene mafi ƙarancin ƙimar $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Points biyun suna gefe ɗaya na $x$-axis, saboda haka za a iya mayar da $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ zuwa tsawon segment ɗaya ta hanyar nuna ɗaya daga cikin points a ɗayan gefen $x$-axis kamar madubi.
Idan aka nuna $B$ game da $x$-axis don samun $B'$, to $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$ kuma $\overline{A P}+\overline{PB'}\ge\overline{AB'}$.
cm2_reflectShortest.explanation: Idan an nuna $B$ game da $x$-axis, a samu $B'({b1}, {nb2})$, to $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$ saboda haka $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}\ge\overline{AB'}$. Tunda $A$ da $B'$ suna gefuna dabam na $x$-axis, segment $AB'$ zai haɗu da $x$-axis kuma equality zai cika. $\overline{AB'}=\sqrt{({b1}-({a1}))^2+({a2}-({nb2}))^2}=\sqrt{{dx}^2+{ss}^2}={ans}$.

cm2_setOpSum.prompt: $U$ shi ne set na dukkan positive integers daga 1 zuwa ${N}$, $A$ kuma set ne na divisors na ${da}$ da suke cikin $U$, $B$ kuma set ne na multiples na ${mb}$ da suke cikin $U$. Menene jimillar dukkan elements na set ${ex}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Da farko jera elements na $A$ da $B$ ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
Complement $X^c$ shi ne elements da suka rage a $U$ bayan an cire elements na $X$. Yi lissafi daga cikin parentheses zuwa waje.
cm2_setOpSum.explanation: Tunda $A=\{{As}\}$ da $B=\{{Bs}\}$, $${ex}=\{{Rs}\}$, kuma jimillar elements ita ce ${ans}.

cm2_setSumCount.prompt: Ga sets biyu $A=\{{sa}\}$, $B=\{{sb}\}$, menene jimillar dukkan elements na set $C=\{x+y\mid x\in A,\ y\in B\}$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Ɗauki element ɗaya daga $A$ da ɗaya daga $B$, sannan ka samar da dukkan jimloli masu yiwuwa.
Ko da wata jimilla ta bayyana sau da yawa, ana lissafa ta sau ɗaya kawai a matsayin element na set.
cm2_setSumCount.explanation: Idan aka nemo dukkan jimloli masu yiwuwa, unique values su ne ${sc}$. Tunda set ba ya maimaita element ɗaya, jimillar elements ita ce ${ans}.$

cm2_sufficientQuad.prompt: Ga conditions biyu kan real number $x$: $p$: $x>a$, da $q$: ${quad}>0$. Menene mafi ƙaramin integer $a$ da ke sa $p$ ya zama sufficient condition na $q$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan $p$ sufficient condition ne na $q$, to $p\Rightarrow q$, wato truth set na $p$ yana cikin truth set na $q$.
Da farko warware quadratic inequality ${quad}>0$ domin nemo truth set na $q$.
cm2_sufficientQuad.explanation: Mafitar ${quad}>0$ ita ce $x<{Rs}$ ko $x>{Rl}$. Domin truth set na $p$, $\{x\mid x>a\}$, ya kasance ƙarƙashin wannan set, dole ne $a\ge {Rl}$. Saboda haka mafi ƙaramin integer $a$ shi ne ${ans}.$

cm2_tangentAtPoint.prompt: A kan circle ${circ}$, point ɗaya a kan tangent a wurin $({x1}, {y1})$ ita ce $Q({t}, k)$. Menene ƙimar $k$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Tangent a wurin point ɗaya a kan circle tana tsaye da radius ɗin da ke haɗa wannan point da center.
Da farko kafa equation na tangent, sannan ka saka coordinates na point $Q$.
cm2_tangentAtPoint.explanation: Equation na tangent ita ce ${tang}$. Tunda point $Q$ yana kan tangent, idan aka sanya $x={t}$ da $y=k$, za a samu $k={ans}$.

cm2_translateCurve.prompt: An matsar da jadawalin function $y={orig}$ a layi ɗaya da $x$-axis da nisa $m$, sannan da $y$-axis da nisa $n$, kuma ya yi daidai da jadawalin function $y={img}$. Menene ƙimar $m+n$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan aka matsar da jadawali da nisa $m$ a gefen $x$-axis, da nisa $n$ a gefen $y$-axis, maye gurbin $x$ da $x-m$, $y$ kuma da $y-n$.
Faɗaɗa $y-n=f(x-m)$, sannan ka kwatanta coefficient na $x$ domin fara nemo $m$.
cm2_translateCurve.explanation: Equation bayan translation ita ce $y-n={shift}$. Idan aka faɗaɗa aka kwatanta coefficient na $x$, ${b}-({tw})m={b2}$, saboda haka $m={m}$. Ta hanyar kwatanta constant term, $n={n}$. Saboda haka $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_truthRange.prompt: Ga conditions biyu game da real number $x$: $p$: ${quad}\le 0$, $q$: $|{cx}|\le a$. Idan mafi ƙaramin natural number $a$ da ke sa contrapositive na proposition $p\to q$ gaskiya ita ce $\alpha$, kuma mafi girman natural number $a$ da ke sa converse na proposition $p\to q$ gaskiya ita ce $\beta$, menene ƙimar $\alpha\beta$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Proposition da contrapositive ɗinsa suna da truth value iri ɗaya. Converse $q\to p$ kuwa a tantance shi dabam. Idan truth sets su ne $P$ da $Q$, idan $p\to q$ gaskiya ne, to $P\subset Q$.

Da farko rubuta $P$ a matsayin interval, sannan warware $|{cx}|\le a$ domin bayyana $Q$ dangane da $a$. Nemo iyakokin $a$ dabam domin contrapositive ya sa $P\subset Q$, converse kuma ya sa $Q\subset P$.
cm2_truthRange.explanation: $P=\{x\mid {m}\le x\le {n}\}$ kuma $|{cx}|\le a$ daidai yake da $-a\le {cx}\le a$. Tunda contrapositive yana da truth value iri ɗaya da proposition na asali, dole $P\subset Q$, kuma values na ${cx}$ a ƙarshen $x={m}$ da $x={n}$ su ne ${u}$ da ${w}$; saboda haka $a\ge {d1}$ da $a\ge {d2}$. Don haka $\alpha={al}$. Don converse, dole $Q\subset P$, kuma ${lowS}\le {kx}\le {highS}$; saboda haka ${lowS}\ge {km}$, ${highS}\le {kn}$, wato $a\le {d1}$ da $a\le {d2}$. Saboda haka $\beta={be}$, kuma $\alpha\beta={al}\times{be}={ans}$.

cm2_vennReverse.prompt: Ga sets biyu A da B masu subset na universal set $U$, idan $n(U)={nu}$, $n(A)={na}$, $n(B)={nb}$, $n((A\cup B)^c)={nc}$, menene ƙimar $n(A^c\cup B)$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo yawan elements na union ta $n(A\cup B)=n(U)-n((A\cup B)^c)$.
Yi amfani da $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$, sannan $n(A^c\cup B)=n(U)-n(A-B)$.
cm2_vennReverse.explanation: $n(A\cup B)={nu}-{nc}={un}$ kuma $n(A\cap B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cup B)={na}+{nb}-{un}={ab}$. Tunda $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$ kuma $n(A-B)={na}-{ab}$, to $n(A^c\cup B)={nu}-({na}-{ab})={ans}$.

cul_bordaMax.prompt: Wannan Borda vote ne don zaɓar ɗaya daga cikin candidates A, B, C. Ana ba da maki $2$ ga matsayi na farko, $1$ ga na biyu, $0$ ga na uku. Idan yawan mutane {n1} suka zaɓi ranking '{b1}', {n2} suka zaɓi '{b2}', {n3} kuma suka zaɓi '{b3}', menene mafi girman total points na candidates ukun? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Nemo matsayi na kowane candidate a kowane ranking domin tantance maki.
Nemo total points na candidates ukun, sannan ka zaɓi mafi girma.
cul_bordaMax.explanation: Total points na A shi ne ${eA}$, na B ${eB}$, na C kuma ${eC}$. Mafi girman total points shi ne ${ans}.$

cul_bordaTotal.prompt: Wannan Borda vote ne don zaɓar ɗaya daga cikin candidates A, B, C. Ana ba da maki $2$ ga matsayi na farko, $1$ ga na biyu, $0$ ga na uku. Idan mutane {n1} sun zaɓi 'A>B>C', {n2} sun zaɓi 'B>C>A', {n3} sun zaɓi 'C>A>B', menene jimillar maki na candidate A? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo matsayi na A a kowane ranking.
Tara (yawan masu jefa ƙuri'a)×(maki na matsayi) duka.
cul_bordaTotal.explanation: A yana matsayi na farko a ranking na farko (maki 2), na uku a na biyu (maki 0), na biyu a na uku (maki 1), saboda haka ${n1}\times2+{n2}\times0+{n3}\times1={ans}$ points.

cul_brailleAtMost.prompt: A cikin cell ɗin Braille akwai positions ${d}$ inda dige zai iya kasancewa. Kowane position na iya zama mai kumburi ko a'a. Tsarin nawa ne daban-daban ke da aƙalla digo 1 amma ba fiye da ${k}$ masu kumburi a cell ɗaya? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Yawan tsarin da ke da daidai j dige masu kumburi shi ne yawan hanyoyin zaɓar j daga positions ${d}$.
Nemo kowane adadi daga $j=1$ zuwa $j={k}$, sannan ka tara.
cul_brailleAtMost.explanation: Tsarin da ke da j dige masu kumburi su ne $_{{d}}\mathrm{C}_{j}$, saboda haka ${terms}={ans}$ tsari.

cul_pitchFifth.prompt: Yawan girgizar sautun asali ita ce ${f}$ Hz. Idan aka daga wannan sauti sama da oktaba ${k}$, sannan aka sake daga shi sama da cikakkiyar kashi ta biyar (rabon yawan girgiza $3:2$), yawan girgizar sabon sautin nawa ne Hz? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Sautin da yake sama da oktaba ɗaya yana da yawan girgiza ninki 2.
Domin hawa cikakkiyar kashi ta biyar, ninka yawan girgizar da $\frac{3}{2}$.
cul_pitchFifth.explanation: Sama da oktaba ${k}$: ${f}\times 2^{{k}}={mid}$ Hz; sama da cikakkiyar kashi ta biyar: ${mid}\times\frac{3}{2}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_stringLength.prompt: Idan tsawon igiyar kayan kiɗan mai igiya ya ragu, yawan girgizarta yana ƙaruwa; idan kaurin igiyar da tsawonta babu canji, yawan girgiza yana da alaƙar akasin gwargwado da tsawon igiyar. Igiyar da tsawonta ${L}$ cm tana fitar da sauti mai ${f}$ Hz. Idan aka matse igiyar a rage tsawon ɓangaren da ke rawa zuwa ${L2}$ cm, yawan girgizar sautin nawa ne Hz? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Ƙimar (yawan girgiza)×(tsawo) ba ta canzawa.
Raba ƙimar ${f}\times{L}$ da sabon tsawon ${L2}$ cm.
cul_stringLength.explanation: Tun da (yawan girgiza)×(tsawo) ba ya canzawa, ${f}\times{L}=x\times{L2}$. Saboda haka $x=\frac{{f}\times{L}}{{L2}}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_voteGuarantee.prompt: 'Yan takara A, B, da C suna fafatawa a zaɓe, inda wanda ya fi kowa ƙuri'a zai yi nasara. Sakamakon wucin gadi yayin ƙirga shi ne A ƙuri'a ${a}$, B ƙuri'a ${b}$, C ƙuri'a ${c}$, kuma akwai ƙuri'a ${m}$ da ba a ƙirga ba tukuna. Ko da yaya aka raba sauran ƙuri'un tsakanin A da B, C nawa ne aƙalla dole ya samu daga cikin ƙuri'u ${m}$ domin ya zama shi kaɗai a matsayi na farko? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Idan C ya sami ƙuri'a $x$ daga cikin sauran, ƙuri'u ${m}−$x za su je wa sauran 'yan takara. Yanayin da ya fi muni shi ne duk ƙuri'un su je ga ɗan takarar da ke kan gaba yanzu.
Ƙuri'un C dole su fi na ɗan takarar da ke gaba (ba su zama daidai ba). Kafa rashin daidaito domin nemo mafi ƙaramin cikakkiyar lambar $x$.
cul_voteGuarantee.explanation: Mafi yawan ƙuri'un da aka samu yanzu su ne ${M}$. Idan C ya sami ƙuri'a $x$ daga cikin sauran, sannan sauran ${m}-x$ duk suka je ga ɗan takarar da ke da ƙuri'a ${M}$, dole ne ${c}+x>{M}+({m}-x)$. Idan aka sauƙaƙa, $x>{half}$; saboda haka mafi ƙaramin cikakkiyar lambar ita ce ${ans}$.

econ_annuityPV.prompt: Akwai kuɗin fansho da za a karɓi ${A}$ won a ƙarshen kowace shekara har tsawon shekaru ${n}$ (za a karɓi na farko bayan shekara ɗaya, na ƙarshe kuma bayan shekaru ${n}$). Idan ribar shekara-shekara ita ce ${r}$% kuma ana tara riba sau ɗaya a shekara, menene darajar kuɗin fanshon a yau, da won nawa? (A cire duk wani kaso ƙasa da won. Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Mayar da kowace kuɗin da za a biya zuwa darajarta ta yau ta hanyar rage darajarta gwargwadon lokacin biya, sannan a tara su.
Idan ribar ita ce $i=\frac{{r}}{100}$, darajar yau ita ce $A\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}$.
econ_annuityPV.explanation: Tun da $i={r}/100$, darajar yau ita ce ${A}\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}\approx{ex}$ won. Idan an cire duk wani kaso ƙasa da won, sai a sami won ${ans}$.

econ_compoundFV.prompt: An ajiye won ${P}$ na tsawon shekaru ${n}$ a asusun ajiyar kuɗi mai ribar shekara-shekara ${r}$%, inda ake ƙara ribar a jikin babban kuɗi sau ${m}$ a shekara. Ribar kowane lissafi ita ce (ribar shekara-shekara)$\div{m}$, kuma ba a cire kuɗi a tsakani. Jimillar babban kuɗi da riba bayan shekaru ${n}$ nawa ne won? (A cire duk wani kaso ƙasa da won. Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Jimillar yawan lokutan lissafin riba ita ce (yawan lokuta a shekara)×(yawan shekaru).
Idan aka yi amfani da ribar ${rp}$% a kowane lissafi, ana ninka babban kuɗin da $(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})$ har yawan lokutan lissafin ya kai adadinsa.
econ_compoundFV.explanation: Yawan lokutan lissafin shi ne ${m}\times{n}={k}$; ribar kowane lissafi ita ce ${rp}$%, saboda haka jimillar babban kuɗi da riba ita ce ${P}\times(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})^{{k}}\approx{ex}$ won. Bayan cire kaso ƙasa da won, amsar ita ce won ${ans}$.

econ_elasticityPoint.prompt: Aikin buƙata shi ne $q={D}$ ($p$ farashi ne, $q$ kuma yawan buƙata ne). Idan farashin $p={p0}$ ne, menene ƙimar sassaucin buƙata ga farashi $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$? (Rubuta a matsayin kason da aka sauƙaƙa. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta ta a matsayin cikakkiyar lamba. Misali: 3/4.)
hints: Da farko nemo $q'(p)$, sannan nemo ƙimarsa idan $p={p0}$.
Nemo yawan buƙata $q$ idan $p={p0}$, sannan saka shi cikin tsarin $e$.
econ_elasticityPoint.explanation: Ƙimar $q'(p)$ idan $p={p0}$ ita ce ${dqv}$; yawan buƙata kuma shi ne $q={qv}$. Saboda haka $e=\frac{{adq}\times{p0}}{{qv}}={fr}$.

econ_elasticityUnit.prompt: Ga aikin buƙata $q={D}$, a wane farashi $p$ ne sassaucin farashi $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ yake zama 1? (Yi la'akari da yankin da $p>0$ kuma yawan buƙata $q>0$.) (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nemo $q'(p)$, sannan ka rubuta $\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|=1$ a matsayin lissafi mai ɗauke da $p$.
A yankin da $q>0$, $q'(p)<0$; bayan cire cikakkiyar alama, ana samun $-q'(p)\times p=q$.
econ_elasticityUnit.explanation: Tunda $q'(p)={dq}$, daga $-q'(p)\times p=q$ ana samun ${eqn}$; mafita mai kyau ta $p$ ita ce $p={ans}$.

econ_equilibriumTable.prompt: Yawan buƙatar wani kaya shi ne ${qd1}$ idan farashinsa ${p1}$ won ne, kuma ${qd2}$ idan farashinsa ${p2}$ won ne. Yawan samarwa shi ne ${qs1}$ idan farashin ${p3}$ won ne, kuma ${qs2}$ idan farashin ${p4}$ won ne. Idan yawan buƙata da yawan samarwa duka ayyukan layi ne na farashi, farashin daidaito nawa ne a won inda yawan buƙata da samarwa suka yi daidai? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Yi amfani da gangaren layi da ya ratsa maki biyu domin nemo yadda yawan buƙata da samarwa suke sauyawa bisa ga farashi.
A ce yawan buƙata shi ne $Q_d$, samarwa kuma $Q_s$, sannan nemo farashin da ya cika $Q_d=Q_s$.
econ_equilibriumTable.explanation: Matsayin sauyin buƙata shi ne $\frac{{qd2}-{qd1}}{{p2}-{p1}}={md}$, saboda haka $Q_d={qd1}{md}(p-{p1})$. Matsayin sauyin samarwa shi ne ${ns}$, saboda haka $Q_s={qs1}+{ns}(p-{p3})$. Warware $Q_d=Q_s$ yana ba da farashin $p={ans}$ won.

econ_exchangeCross.prompt: Canjin kuɗi shi ne 1 dollar $={d}$ won, 1 euro kuma $={e}$ won. Idan aka canja euro ${n}$ zuwa dollar ba tare da kuɗin hidima ba, dollar nawa ake samu? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo adadin won da euro ${n}$ yake daidai da shi.
Raba adadin won ɗin da farashin dollar ɗaya, ${d}$ won.
econ_exchangeCross.explanation: Euro ${n}$ daidai yake da ${n}\times{e}={won}$ won, kuma ${won}\div{d}={ans}$ dollar.

econ_inverseEntry.prompt: Menene abun $({i}, {j})$ na matriks juyawar $A^{-1}$ idan matriks $A={M}$? (Abun $(i, j)$ shi ne wanda ke jere na $i$, shafi na $j$.) (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Determinant na matriks ${G}$ shi ne $ad-bc$. Idan ba 0 ba, yana da matriks juyawa.
Matriks juyawar ita ce ${H}$.
econ_inverseEntry.explanation: Determinant ɗin shi ne ${ap}\times{dp}-{bp}\times{cp}={det}$, kuma abun $({i}, {j})$ na $A^{-1}$ shi ne $\frac{{num}}{{det}}$, wato ${fr}$.

econ_leontief.prompt: Matriks na ƙimar kayan da ake buƙata daga masana'antu 1 da 2 ita ce $A={M}$ (abun $(i, j)$ na $A$ yana nuna adadin kayan masana'antu $i$ da ake buƙata domin masana'antu $j$ ta ƙera raka'a 1). Idan jimillar samarwar masana'antun biyu su ne $x_1$, $x_2$ (rukunin won 100,000,000), buƙatar ƙarshe kuma $d_1={d1}$, $d_2={d2}$, ana samun ${XV}=A{XV}+{DV}$. Menene ƙimar $x_1$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Mayar da lissafin zuwa $(I-A){XV}={DV}$.
Nemo matriks juyawar $I-A$, sannan ka ninka ta da ${DV}$. Matriks juyawar $2\times2$ tana da siffar ninkawa da matriks da aka sake jera abubuwanta, da $\frac{1}{ad-bc}$.
econ_leontief.explanation: Tunda $(I-A)\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{d}$, ana samun $\mathbf{x}=(I-A)^{-1}\mathbf{d}$. Determinant na $I-A$ shi ne ${D}$; saboda haka $x_1=\frac{{c22}\times{d1}+{a12}\times{d2}}{{D}}={ans}$.

econ_marginalRevenue.prompt: Layin buƙatar kaya shi ne $p={a}-{b}q$ ($p$ farashi ne a won, $q$ kuma yawan kaya da aka sayar). Jimillar kuɗin shiga ita ce $R(q)=pq$, kuɗin shiga na ƙarin kaya guda kuma shi ne bambancin $R(q)$ bisa ga $q$, wato $R'(q)$. Idan kuɗin shiga na ƙarin kaya guda ${m}$ won ne, yawan kaya $q$ nawa aka sayar? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Saka $p={a}-{b}q$ a cikin $R(q)=pq$ domin bayyana $R(q)$ ta amfani da $q$.
Nemo ƙimar $q$ inda bambancin $R(q)$ ya zama ${m}$ won.
econ_marginalRevenue.explanation: Tunda $R(q)=({a}-{b}q)q={a}q-{b}q^2$, ana samun $R'(q)={a}-{twob}q$. Daga $R'(q)={m}$ ana samun $q={ans}$.

econ_presentValue.prompt: Ana lissafa interest na shekara ${r}$% ta hanyar compound a kowace shekara. Menene present value na ${F}$ won da za a karɓa bayan shekara ${n}$? (A cire ƙasa da won 1. Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Present value $P$ ita ce ƙimar da idan aka compound na shekara ${n}$ za ta zama ${F}$ won.
Yi lissafin $P=F\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}$.
econ_presentValue.explanation: $P={F}\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}\approx{ex}$ won ne, idan aka cire ƙasa da won 1, amsar ita ce ${ans}$ won.

econ_profitCubic.prompt: Jimillar kuɗin samar da kayayyaki $q$ ita ce $C(q)=q^3-{b}q^2+{c}q+{f}$(won), kuma farashin sayarwa na kowane ɗaya ${p}$ won ne. Idan an sayar da duk kayayyakin da aka samar, menene maximum na riba (jimillar kuɗin shiga cire jimillar kuɗi)? ($q$ real number ne da bai gaza 0 ba.) (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Riba ita ce $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$. Yi derivative, sannan ka nemo $q$ da ke sa $\pi'(q)=0$.
A tushen mai kyau na $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=0$, alamar $\pi'(q)$ tana sauyawa daga + zuwa -.
econ_profitCubic.explanation: Tunda $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$, $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=-3(q-{q0})(q+{s})$. Ga $q\ge0$, $\pi'$ yana da kyau kafin $q={q0}$, kuma mara kyau bayansa, saboda haka maximum yana faruwa a $q={q0}$, inda $\pi({q0})={ans}$ won.

econ_regionLP.prompt: Wani factory yana ƙera Product A guda $x$ da Product B guda $y$ ($x$, $y$ nonnegative integers ne). Don ƙera guda 1, Product A yana buƙatar ${a1}$ kg na material da ${t1}$ hours na aiki, Product B kuma ${b1}$ kg da ${t2}$ hours. Material da za a iya amfani da shi a rana bai wuce ${M}$ kg ba, kuma jimillar lokutan aikin ma'aikata bai wuce ${T}$ hours ba. Ribar kowane Product A ita ce ${pa}$ ten thousand won, ta Product B kuma ${pb}$ ten thousand won. Menene maximum ribar rana a ten thousand won? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Rubuta constraints a matsayin inequalities, tare da $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$, sannan ka nuna yankin a kan coordinate plane.
Riba ${pa}x+{pb}y$ tana kaiwa maximum a ɗaya daga cikin vertices na yankin. Da farko duba intersection na boundary lines biyu.
econ_regionLP.explanation: Inequalities ɗin su ne ${a1}x+{b1}y\le{M}$, ${t1}x+{t2}y\le{T}$, $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$. Vertex da ke ba da maximum riba ita ce intersection na boundary lines biyu $({x0}, {y0})$. Wannan integer point ne, saboda haka maximum profit ita ce ${pa}\times{x0}+{pb}\times{y0}={ans}$ ten thousand won.

econ_taxBracket.prompt: Harajin kuɗin shiga a wata ƙasa yana amfani da rates daban-daban ga kowane bracket na taxable income. Ana ɗora ${r1}$% kan ɓangaren da bai wuce ${b1}$ ten thousand won ba, ${r2}$% kan ɓangaren da ya wuce ${b1}$ amma bai wuce ${b2}$ ten thousand won ba, sannan ${r3}$% kan ɓangaren da ya wuce ${b2}$ ten thousand won. Idan taxable income ita ce ${x1}$ ten thousand won, nawa ne harajin a ten thousand won? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Ana amfani da rate ne kawai ga adadin kuɗin da ke cikin wannan bracket. Da farko nemo adadin da ya shiga kowane bracket.
Tara (adadin kowane bracket)×(rate) duka.
econ_taxBracket.explanation: Adadin da ke kowane bracket su ne ${s1}$, ${s2}$, ${s3}$ ten thousand won, saboda haka harajin ita ce ${s1}\times\frac{{r1}}{100}+{s2}\times\frac{{r2}}{100}+{s3}\times\frac{{r3}}{100}={ans}$ ten thousand won.

econ_taxEquilibrium.prompt: Demand curve na kaya shi ne $p={a}-{b}q$, supply curve kuma $p={c}+{d}q$. A nan $p$ farashi ne (won), $q$ kuma adadi ne (guda). Idan gwamnati ta ɗora wa supplier haraji ${t}$ won a kan kowanne kaya da aka sayar, supplier zai karɓi kuɗin da consumer ya biya bayan an cire harajin. Menene farashin da consumer zai biya a sabon equilibrium bayan haraji? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Farashin da supplier zai karɓa a zahiri shi ne $p-{t}$.
Sanya $p-{t}$ a madadin $p$ na supply curve, sannan ka saka demand curve $p={a}-{b}q$ don nemo $q$.
econ_taxEquilibrium.explanation: Tunda supplier zai karɓi $p-{t}$, lissafin shi ne $({a}-{b}q)-{t}={c}+{d}q$. Idan aka warware shi, $q={qn}$, kuma farashin da consumer zai biya shi ne $p={a}-{b}\times{qn}={ans}$ won.

econ_utilityBundle.prompt: Kaya x tana da farashin ${a}$ won ga kowace guda, kaya y kuma ${b}$ won ga kowace guda. Ana son kashe duk kasafin ${I}$ won ba tare da saura ba wajen sayen x guda $x$ da y guda $y$ ($x$, $y$ lambobin cikakku marasa kyau ba ne). Idan amfanin da aka bayar shi ne $U={U}$, menene mafi girman ƙimar amfani $U$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Nemo dukkan ma'auratan lambobin cikakku marasa kyau $(x, y)$ da suka cika ma'aunin kasafin ${a}x+{b}y={I}$.
Lissafta ƙimar $U$ ga kowane $(x, y)$ da ka samu, sannan kwatanta su.
econ_utilityBundle.explanation: Ma'auratan $(x, y)$ da suka cika ma'aunin kasafin su ne ${pairs}$. Daga cikin su, ma'auratan da ƙimar $U$ ta fi girma su ne $(x, y)=({bx}, {by})$ (idan akwai fiye da ɗaya, ɗauki ɗaya daga cikinsu), kuma a nan $U={ans}$.

geo_conicGeneral.prompt: Daga cikin focus na conic ${eq}$, a ce wanda haɗin x ɗinsa ya fi girma (ko maki kaɗai idan focus ɗaya ne) shi ne $(a,\ b)$. Menene ƙimar $a+b$? (Rubuta lamba cikakkiya. Idan mara kyau ce, saka - a gabanta)
hints: Kammala murabba'ai dabam ga $x$ da $y$ domin rubuta shi a siffar ma'auni na yau da kullum.
Daga siffar ma'aunin, karanta cibiyar (ko kololuwa), sannan focus shi ne maki da aka matsar daga gare ta da $c$ (ko $p$ ga parabola) zuwa hanyar focus.
geo_conicGeneral.explanation: Idan aka kammala murabba'ai, za a samu ${std}$. Focus shi ne ${foc}$, saboda haka $a+b={ans}$.

geo_conicParam.prompt: Tazara tsakanin focus biyun na lanƙwasa ${eq}$ ita ce ${fd}$, kuma ${cond}$. Menene ƙimar $k$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Idan tazara tsakanin focus biyu ita ce $2c$, fara nemo ƙimar $c$. Sannan gano wane denominator ne $a^2$.
Ga ellipse, $c^2=a^2-b^2$; ga hyperbola, $c^2=a^2+b^2$. Yi amfani da ma'aunin don nemo $k$.
geo_conicParam.explanation: Tunda tazara tsakanin focus biyun ita ce $2c={fd}$, $c={c}$, $c^2={c2}$. ${work}$, saboda haka $k={ans}$.

geo_conicTangentLine.prompt: Ga layin tangent ${ln}$ na lanƙwasa ${eq}$, menene ƙimar $k$ mai kyau? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Saka ma'aunin layin cikin ma'aunin lanƙwasar domin samun ma'aunin digiri na biyu kan $x$. Idan layin tangent ne, discriminant ɗin ma'aunin sifili ne.
Daga discriminant $D=0$, nemo ma'aunin da ya shafi $k$.
geo_conicTangentLine.explanation: Idan aka saka ma'aunin layin cikin ma'aunin lanƙwasar, za a samu ma'aunin digiri na biyu kan $x$, ${quad}$. Da yake tangent ne, discriminant $D=0$. ${work}$, saboda haka ƙimar $k$ mai kyau ita ce ${ans}$.

geo_divPoint.prompt: Ga maki biyu $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ a cikin sararin coordinates, maki P yana kan sashen layi AB kuma $AP:PB={m}:{n}$. Menene jimillar coordinates uku na P? (Rubuta lamba cikakkiya. Idan mara kyau ce, saka - a gabanta)
hints: Coordinates na maki da ke raba sashen AB cikin rabon $m:n$ su ne $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n},\ \frac{mz_2+nz_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Lissafta kowace coordinate dabam.
geo_divPoint.explanation: $P=\left(\frac{{n}\,x_A+{m}\,x_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,y_A+{m}\,y_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,z_A+{m}\,z_B}{{mn}}\right)={pp}$, saboda haka jimillar coordinates ukun ita ce ${ans}$.

geo_divRatioPlane.prompt: Ga maki biyu $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ a sararin coordinates, a ce wurin da sashen AB ya haɗu da plane ${pl}$ shi ne P. Idan $AP:PB=m:n$ ($m$, $n$ lambobin cikakku ne masu kyau marasa common factor), menene ƙimar $m+n$? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Maki da ke kan plane ${pl}$ yana da coordinate ɗaya da yake $0$.
Idan sashen AB ya rabu cikin rabon $s:t$, bayyana wannan coordinate na P ta amfani da $s$, $t$, sannan daidaita shi da $0$.
geo_divRatioPlane.explanation: Idan $AP:PB=s:t$, coordinate ɗin P ɗin shi ne $\frac{t\cdot({za})+s\cdot({zb})}{s+t}=0$, don haka $s:t=|{za}|:|{zb}|={ua}:{ub}$. Bayan ragewa zuwa lambobin da ba su da common factor, wannan shi ne ${m}:{n}$, saboda haka $m+n={ans}$.

geo_dotAngle.prompt: Idan angle tsakanin vectors $\vec a={va}$ da $\vec b={vb}$ ita ce $\theta$ ($0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$), menene ƙimar $\theta$? (Rubuta lambar digiri kawai)
hints: Cosine na angle tsakanin vectors biyu shi ne $\cos\theta=\frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$.
Nemo dot product da magnitude na vectors biyun dabam-dabam.
geo_dotAngle.explanation: Tunda $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, $|\vec a||\vec b|=\sqrt{{na2}}\sqrt{{nb2}}=\sqrt{{pr}}={rt}$, to $\cos\theta=\frac{{dt}}{{rt}}={cs}$. A cikin $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$, $\theta={ans}^\circ$.

geo_dotNormExpand.prompt: Ga vectors biyu $\vec a$, $\vec b$, idan $|\vec a|={na}$, $|\vec b|={nb}$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, menene ƙimar $|{ex}|^2$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Tunda $|\vec x|^2=\vec x\cdot\vec x$, faɗaɗa ${ex}$ ta hanyar nemo dot product ɗinsa da kansa.
Rubuta ta amfani da $|\vec a|^2$, $|\vec b|^2$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b$, sannan ka sanya ƙimomin.

geo_ellipseExtSum.prompt: Ga ellipse ${eq}$ mai focus ɗaya $F({fx},\ {fy})$ da point $A({xa},\ {ya})$ a cikinta. Yayin da point P ke motsi a kan ellipse, menene samfurin maximum da minimum na $PA+PF$? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan ɗayan focus ɗin shi ne F', to $PF=2a-PF'$. Saboda haka $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$.
Ta triangle inequality, $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, kuma tunda A yana cikin ellipse, yiwuwar equality a iyakokin biyu tana nan.
geo_ellipseExtSum.explanation: Idan ɗayan focus ɗin shi ne F', $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$, inda $a={a}$ da $AF'={dd}$. Tunda $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, maximum ɗin $2a+AF'={mx}$, minimum ɗin $2a-AF'={mn}$, kuma samfurin su ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFocal.prompt: Ga foci biyu F da F' na ellipse ${eq}$. Idan point P a kan ellipse ya cika ${cond}$, menene ƙimar ${ask}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)$
hints: Jimillar nisan point na ellipse zuwa foci biyu constant ce kuma daidai take da major axis length.
Idan major axis length ita ce $2a$ kuma tazarar foci biyu ita ce $2c$, to $a={a}$, $c={c}$. Yi amfani da $PF+PF'=2a$.
geo_ellipseFocal.explanation: Major axis length ita ce $2a={tw}$, tazarar foci kuma $2c={tc}$, saboda haka $PF+PF'={tw}$, $FF'={tc}$. Tunda ${work}$, ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFromEq.prompt: Menene tazara tsakanin foci biyu na ellipse ${eq}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)$
hints: Mayar da equation na ellipse zuwa siffar $\frac{x^2}{\square}+\frac{y^2}{\square}=1$; mafi girman denominator daga biyun shi ne $a^2$.
Denominators su ne ${a2}$ da ${b2}$, kuma $c^2=a^2-b^2$.
geo_ellipseFromEq.explanation: Idan aka rubuta a siffar ${std}$, $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, saboda haka $c^2=a^2-b^2={c2}$, $c={c}$. Tazara tsakanin foci biyu ita ce $2c={ans}$.

geo_ellipseRightTri.prompt: Ga foci F da F' na ellipse ${eq}$. Idan point P a kan ellipse ya cika $\angle FPF'=90^\circ$, menene faɗin triangle PFF'? (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Ta ellipse definition, $PF+PF'=2a$, kuma tunda triangle ɗin right triangle ne, $PF^2+PF'^2=(FF')^2$.
Yi amfani da $(PF+PF')^2=PF^2+PF'^2+2\,PF\cdot PF'$ domin nemo $PF\cdot PF'$.
geo_ellipseRightTri.explanation: Tunda $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, $c^2={c2}$, $PF+PF'=2a={tw}$, $FF'=2c={tc}$. $PF^2+PF'^2={tc2}$, saboda haka $2\,PF\cdot PF'=({tw})^2-{tc2}$, wato $PF\cdot PF'={pr}$. Faɗin ita ce $\frac{1}{2}\times PF\times PF'={ans}$.

geo_hyperAsym.prompt: Menene gangaren layin asymptote mai positive slope daga cikin asymptotes biyu na hyperbola ${eq}$? (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Asymptotes na hyperbola $\frac{x^2}{a^2}-\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ su ne $y=\pm\frac{b}{a}x$; na $\frac{y^2}{a^2}-\frac{x^2}{b^2}=1$ kuwa su ne $y=\pm\frac{a}{b}x$.
Idan RHS na equation ba 1 ba ne, da farko mayar da shi zuwa 1, sannan ka karanta $a^2$ da $b^2$ daga denominators na $x^2$ da $y^2$.
geo_hyperAsym.explanation: Tunda tana da siffar ${std}$, asymptotes su ne ${asy}$. Gangaren asymptote mai positive slope ita ce ${ansf}.$

geo_hyperFocal.prompt: A ce foci biyu na hyperbola ${eq}$ su ne F da F'. Idan point P a kan hyperbola ya cika ${cond}$, menene ƙimar ${ask}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)$
hints: Absolute difference tsakanin nisan point a kan hyperbola zuwa foci biyu daidai yake da tsawon transverse axis $2a$.
Tunda $a={a}$, $c={c}$, to $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, kuma nisa daga point a kan hyperbola zuwa kowane focus aƙalla $c-a={ca}$ ne.
geo_hyperFocal.explanation: $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$ ne kuma $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$. Tunda ${work}$, P yana kan reshen da ya fi kusa da F kuma $PF'>PF$. (Idan $PF'=PF-2a$, zai zama ${alt}$, wanda ya gaza $c-a$ kuma ba zai yiwu ba.) Saboda haka ${work2}$, don haka ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}.$

geo_hyperFocalRel.prompt: A ce foci biyu na hyperbola ${eq}$ su ne F da F'. Idan point P a kan hyperbola ya cika ${cond}$, menene ƙimar ${ask}? (Rubuta lamba kawai)$
hints: Absolute difference tsakanin nisan point a kan hyperbola zuwa foci biyu daidai yake da tsawon transverse axis $2a$.
Tunda $a={a}$, $c={c}$, to $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, kuma nisa daga point a kan hyperbola zuwa kowane focus aƙalla $c-a={ca}$ ne.
geo_hyperFocalRel.explanation: $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$ ne, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, $FF'=2c={tc}$. Tunda ${work}$, ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}.$

geo_lineIntersectParam.prompt: A sarari mai girma uku, lines biyu ${l1}$ da ${l2}$ suna haɗuwa a point guda. Menene ƙimar constant $k$? (Rubuta integer; idan negative ne, sanya alamar -)
hints: Sanya common parameters na line ɗaya $s$, na ɗayan kuma $t$, sannan ka rubuta coordinates na point a kan kowace line da waɗannan parameters.
Daga equations da ke sa $x$- da $y$-coordinates su yi daidai, nemo $s$ da $t$, sannan ka kwatanta $z$-coordinates.
geo_lineIntersectParam.explanation: Idan common parameter na line na farko shi ne $s$, na na biyu kuma $t$, $x$- da $y$-coordinates dole su yi daidai, wato ${xy}$; idan aka warware, $s={ss}$ da $t={tt}$. $z$-coordinates ma dole su yi daidai, wato ${eq3}$, saboda haka $k={ans}$.

geo_lineSpacePoint.prompt: Akwai point a kan line ${ln}$ da ke cika ${cond}$. Menene jimillar sauran coordinates biyu na wannan point? (Rubuta integer; idan negative ne, sanya alamar -)
hints: Idan common parameter na fractions ukun shi ne $s$, za ka iya bayyana $x$, $y$, $z$ dukkansu da $s$.
Da farko nemo $s$ ta amfani da sharadin ${cond}$.
geo_lineSpacePoint.explanation: Idan common parameter shi ne $s$, to $(x,\ y,\ z)=({par})$. Daga ${cond}$, $s={ss}$, saboda haka point ɗin ita ce ${pt}$, kuma jimillar sauran coordinates biyu ita ce ${ans}.$

geo_parFocusDir.prompt: Ga parabola mai focus $F({fx},\ {fy})$ da directrix ${dirEq}$, idan point $P(x,\ y)$ a kan parabola ya cika ${cond}$, menene maximum na ${un}? (Rubuta integer; idan negative ne, sanya alamar -)$
hints: Ga point a kan parabola, nisansa zuwa focus daidai yake da nisansa zuwa directrix.
Midpoint tsakanin focus da directrix ita ce vertex. Kafa equation na parabola mai vertex $({vx},\ {vy})$ da $p={pp}$.
geo_parFocusDir.explanation: Tunda vertex ɗin $({vx},\ {vy})$ ne kuma $p={pp}$, equation na parabola ita ce ${eqn}$. Idan ${cond}$, ${un}={sol}$, saboda haka maximum na ${un} shi ne ${ans}.

geo_parMinSum.prompt: A ɗauki F a matsayin mahimmiyar maƙasudin parabola ${eq}$, kuma a ce ma'aunan A su ne $({xa},\ {ya})$. Yayin da P ke motsi a kan parabola, menene mafi ƙarancin darajar $PA+PF$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nisan $PF$ daga P a kan parabola zuwa maƙasudinta daidai yake da nisan daga P zuwa layin tsayinta.
Idan H shi ne ƙafar perpendicular daga P zuwa layin tsayi, mafi ƙarancin darajar $PA+PH$ tana samuwa ne lokacin da A, P, da H suke kan layi madaidaiciya.
geo_parMinSum.explanation: Layin tsayin shi ne ${dir}$. Tunda A yana cikin parabola (${chk}$), idan H ƙafar perpendicular daga P zuwa layin tsayi ne, mafi ƙarancin darajar $PA+PF=PA+PH$ ita ce nisan daga A zuwa layin tsayi, wato ${ans}$ ne.

geo_planeNormal.prompt: Game da $A{pa}$, menene ma'aunin ${ax}$ na wurin da jirgin sama wanda ya ratsa A kuma yake perpendicular ga vector $\vec n=({vn})$ ya haɗu da axis na ${ax}$? (Za ka iya rubuta shi a matsayin decimal ko kashi kamar 3/4)
hints: Idan $\vec p$ shi ne vector ɗin matsayi na kowane batu P a kan jirgin, to $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$.
Da farko nemo ma'aunin jirgin $ax+by+cz=d$, sannan ka yi amfani da cewa ma'aunai biyun da ba na axis na ${ax}$ ba  $0$ ne ga batu a kan wannan axis.
geo_planeNormal.explanation: Ga batu P a kan jirgin, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$, don haka ma'aunin jirgin shi ne ${plane}$. Ma'aunai biyun da ba na axis ${ax}$ ba  $0$ ne ga batu a kan wannan axis; saboda haka, daga ${solve}$, ma'aunin ${ax}$ shi ne ${ans}$.

geo_projEllipse.prompt: Akwai da'ira mai radius ${rr}$ a kan jirgin $\alpha$. Idan aka yi hasashen orthogonal na wannan da'ira a kan jirgin $\beta$, za ta zama ellipse. A ce kusurwar da jiragen $\alpha$ da $\beta$ suka yi ita ce $\theta$, kuma $\cos\theta={cs}$. Menene nisan tsakanin fokus biyu na ellipse ɗin? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Daga cikin diamitocin da'irar, wanda yake a layi ɗaya da mahaɗin jiragen biyu ba ya canja tsawo; wanda yake perpendicular da shi yana raguwa zuwa $\cos\theta$ na tsawonsa.
Nemo tsawon babban axis $2a$ da ƙaramin axis $2b$ na ellipse ɗin da aka yi hasashen, sannan ka lissafa $c=\sqrt{a^2-b^2}$.
geo_projEllipse.explanation: Babban axis na ellipse ɗin da aka yi hasashen yana da tsawon $2a=2\times {rr}$, ƙaramin axis kuma yana da tsawon $2b=2\times {rr}\cos\theta=2\times {bb}$; saboda haka $a={rr}$ da $b={bb}$. Tun da $c=\sqrt{{rr}^2-{bb}^2}={cc}$, nisan tsakanin fokus biyu shi ne $2c={ans}$.

geo_projPlaneArea.prompt: Menene faɗin siffar da aka samu ta hanyar yin hasashen orthogonal na siffar mai faɗin ${ar}$ da ke kan jirgin ${pl} zuwa jirgin ${cp}? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan kusurwar da jirgin da siffar take a kai da jirgin ${cp}$ ita ce $\theta$, faɗin hoton da aka yi hasashe shi ne (faɗin siffar)$\times\cos\theta$.

Ana ɗaukar kusurwar tsakanin jiragen biyu $\theta$ a matsayin $0^\circ\le\theta\le90^\circ$, don haka $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec n_1\cdot\vec n_2|}{|\vec n_1||\vec n_2|}$ (kimar absolute ta dot product na vectors na normal biyu, a raba da ninkin girman su).
geo_projPlaneArea.explanation: Vector normal na jirgin ${pl}$ shi ne $({nv})$, kuma girman sa ${nn}$ ne. Vector normal na jirgin ${cp}$ shi ne $({cn})$, don haka $\cos\theta=\frac{|{ns}|}{{nn}}=\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}$. Faɗin hoton da aka yi hasashe shi ne ${ar}\times\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}={ans}$.

geo_spaceDist.prompt: Menene nisan tsakanin maki biyu $A{pa}$ da $B{pb}$ a sararin daidaitawa? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Nisan tsakanin maki biyu $(x_1,\ y_1,\ z_1)$ da $(x_2,\ y_2,\ z_2)$ a sararin daidaitawa shi ne $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2+(z_2-z_1)^2}$.
Da farko nemo bambancin ma'aunai uku.

geo_sphereExpand.prompt: Idan lissafin ${eq}$ yana wakiltar ƙwallo mai tsayin radius ${rad}$, menene ƙimar akai-akai $s$? (Rubuta cikakkiyar lamba. Idan mara kyau ce, saka - a gabanta)
hints: Mayar da kowace daga cikin $x$, $y$ da $z$ zuwa cikakkiyar murabba'i domin samun siffar $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2+(z-c)^2=r^2$.
Dole ne gefen dama ya zama $r^2={rad2}$.
geo_sphereExpand.explanation: Idan aka mayar da shi zuwa cikakkiyar murabba'i, ana samun ${std}$. Tunda murabba'in radius ɗin ${s4}-s={rad2}$ ne, $s={s4}-{rad2}={ans}$.

geo_sphereSection.prompt: Sashen ƙwallo ${eq}$ da jirgin sama ${pl}$ ya yanke da'ira ne. Idan faɗin wannan da'irar shi ne $m\pi$, menene ƙimar lamba ta halitta $m$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Karanta ma'aunin tsakiyar ƙwallo da murabba'in radius daga lissafin.
Idan ka nemo nisan $d$ daga tsakiya zuwa jirgin, murabba'in radius $r$ na sashen da'irar shi ne $r^2=R^2-d^2$.
geo_sphereSection.explanation: Tsakiyar ƙwallon ita ce ${cc}$, kuma murabba'in radius ɗinta $R^2={rr2}$. Nisan daga tsakiya zuwa jirgin sama ${pl}$ shi ne $d={dd}$; saboda haka murabba'in radius na da'irar sashen shi ne ${rr2}-{dd}^2={ans}$, kuma faɗinta ${ans}\pi$.

geo_sphereTangentPlane.prompt: Ga jirgin sama ${pl}$ da yake taɓa ƙwallo mai tsakiya $C{cc}$ da tsayin radius ${rad}$, wanne ne mafi girman ƙimar akai-akai $k$? (Rubuta cikakkiyar lamba. Idan mara kyau ce, saka - a gabanta)
hints: Idan jirgin yana taɓa ƙwallon, nisan daga tsakiyar ƙwallon zuwa jirgin ya yi daidai da radius.
Nisan daga maki $(x_0,\ y_0,\ z_0)$ zuwa jirgin $ax+by+cz=k$ shi ne $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+cz_0-k|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$.
geo_sphereTangentPlane.explanation: Girman vector na al'ada $({nv})$ shi ne ${nn}$, kuma saka tsakiyar ƙwallon a cikin lissafin jirgin yana ba da ${dc}$. Daga nisan $\frac{|{dc}-k|}{{nn}}={rad}$ ana samun $|{dc}-k|={rl}$; saboda haka $k={dc}\pm{rl}$, kuma ƙima mafi girma ita ce ${ans}$.

geo_tangentAt.prompt: Menene faɗin alwatika da layin taɓawa a maki $P({x0},\ {y0})$ a kan lanƙwasa ${eq}$ ya yi tare da axis $x$ da axis $y$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Ana iya samun layin taɓawa a maki $(x_1,\ y_1)$ a kan lanƙwasa ta hanyar sauya $x^2\to x_1x$, $y^2\to y_1y$ (ga parabola: $y^2\to y_1y$, $x\to\frac{x+x_1}{2}$).
Daga lissafin layin taɓawa, nemo inda ya yanke axis $x$ da axis $y$, sannan ka lissafta $\frac{1}{2}\times|x-intercept|\times|y-intercept|$.
geo_tangentAt.explanation: Lissafin layin taɓawa shi ne ${tan}$; inda yake yanke axis $x$ shi ne ${xi}$, inda yake yanke axis $y$ kuma ${yi}$. Saboda haka faɗin alwatika shi ne $\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={ansf}$.

geo_tangentsFromPoint.prompt: Menene ninkin gangaren layukan taɓawa biyu da aka zana daga maki $({x1},\ {y1})$ zuwa lanƙwasa ${eq}$? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: A ɗauki gangaren layin taɓawa a matsayin $m$, sannan a saka layin ${lnp}$ da ya ratsa ta maki $({x1},\ {y1})$ cikin lissafin lanƙwasa.
Sharadin taɓawa (diskriminant $=0$) yana ba da lissafin digiri na biyu mai ɗauke da $m$; gangaren layukan taɓawa biyun tushen wannan lissafi ne.
geo_tangentsFromPoint.explanation: Dole ne diskriminant na lissafin digiri na biyu mai ɗauke da $x$, wanda aka samu ta saka layin ${lnp}$ a cikin lissafin lanƙwasa, ya zama $0$. Saboda haka gangaren layin taɓawa $m$ su ne tushen lissafin digiri na biyu ${quad}=0$. Daga dangantakar tushen da masu haɗin lissafi, ninkin gangaren layukan taɓawa biyun shi ne ${prod}$.

geo_threePerp.prompt: Daga maki P a wajen jirgin sama $\alpha$, saukar da layin tsaye zuwa $\alpha$ ya taɓa jirgin a H. Daga H, saukar da layin tsaye zuwa layin $\ell$ da ke kan $\alpha$ ya taɓa shi a K; zaɓi maki A a kan $\ell$ da ya bambanta da K. A ce nisan daga P zuwa layin $\ell$ shi ne $d$. Idan ${giv}$, menene ƙimar ${ask}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Tunda $PH\perp\alpha$ da $HK\perp\ell$, bisa ƙa'idar layukan tsaye uku $PK\perp\ell$.
Yi amfani da ka'idar Pythagoras bi da bi a alwatika masu kusurwar dama da aka samu daga ƙa'idar layukan tsaye uku.
geo_threePerp.explanation: Tunda $PH\perp\alpha$ da $HK\perp\ell$, bisa ƙa'idar layukan tsaye uku $PK\perp\ell$. Tunda ${work}$, ƙimar da ake nema ita ce ${ans}$.

geo_vecCircleEq.prompt: A ce a matsayin vectors na matsayi na maki $A{pa}$ da $B{pb}$ su ne bi da bi $\vec a$ da $\vec b$, sannan vector na matsayi na maki P ya zama $\vec p$. Mene ne tsawon radius na da’irar da duk maki P waɗanda suka cika $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ suka samar? (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko juzu’i kamar 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ yana nufin vectors biyu $\vec p-\vec a$ da $\vec p-\vec b$ suna tsaye da juna.
Kusurwar da ake gani daga maki P zuwa sashen layi AB tana da digiri nawa?
geo_vecCircleEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ yana nufin P yana kan da’irar da sashen layi AB ya zama diamitarta. Tunda $AB={ab}$, tsawon radius ɗin shi ne $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}.$

geo_vecDecompose.prompt: Idan $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, $\vec c={vc}$, menene ƙimar ${ask}$ ga lambobin gaske $m$ da $n$ waɗanda suka cika $\vec c=m\vec a+n\vec b$? (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko juzu’i kamar 3/4)
hints: Bayyana sassan $m\vec a+n\vec b$ ta amfani da $m$ da $n$, sannan ka daidaita su da sassan $\vec c$.
Warware tsarin lissafi na $m$ da $n$ da aka samu daga sassan biyu.
geo_vecDecompose.explanation: Idan aka kwatanta sassan, ana samun ${eqs}$, saboda haka $m={mt}$, $n={nt}$. Saboda haka ${ask}={ans}.$

geo_vecDotParam.prompt: Ga vectors biyu $\vec a={va}$ da $\vec b={vb}$, idan $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dd}$, mene ne mafi girman ƙimar real $t$? (Rubuta a matsayin lamba cikakkiya. Idan ba ta da kyau, saka - a gabanta)
hints: Ninka sassan da suka yi daidai sannan ka tara su domin bayyana $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ a matsayin furuci mai ɗauke da $t$.
Warware lissafin da aka samu domin nemo dukkan ƙimomin $t$, sannan ka zaɓi mafi girma.
geo_vecDotParam.explanation: Tunda $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, mafitar lissafin ${dexp}={dd}$ ita ce ${sol}$. Mafi girman ƙimar cikinsu ita ce ${ans}.$

geo_vecLinComb.prompt: Idan $\vec a={va}$ da $\vec b={vb}$, mene ne ƙimar $|{ex}|$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ana lissafa jimlar vectors da ninkawa da real ta amfani da sassan da suka yi daidai.
Da farko nemo sassan ${ex}$, sannan ka nemo tushen murabba’i mai kyau na jimillar murabba’in sassan.

geo_vecOrthoParam.prompt: Idan vectors biyu $\vec a={va}$ da $\vec b={vb}$ suna tsaye da juna, mene ne ƙimar real $t$? (Rubuta a matsayin lamba cikakkiya. Idan ba ta da kyau, saka - a gabanta)
hints: Inner product na vectors biyu masu tsaye da juna shi ne $0$.
Ninka sassan da suka yi daidai sannan ka tara su domin bayyana $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ a matsayin furuci mai ɗauke da $t$.
geo_vecOrthoParam.explanation: Tunda vectors biyu suna tsaye da juna, $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$. Idan $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, warware ${dexp}=0$ domin samun ${sol}.$

geo_vecSphereEq.prompt: A ce vectors na matsayi na maki $A{pa}$ da $B{pb}$ su ne bi da bi $\vec a$ da $\vec b$, sannan vector na matsayi na maki P ya zama $\vec p$. Mene ne tsawon radius na ƙwallon sararin samaniya da duk maki P waɗanda suka cika $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ suka samar? (Za ka iya rubuta a matsayin decimal ko juzu’i kamar 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ yana nufin vectors biyu $\vec p-\vec a$ da $\vec p-\vec b$ suna tsaye da juna.
Kusurwar da ake gani daga maki P zuwa sashen layi AB tana da digiri nawa?
geo_vecSphereEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ yana nufin P yana kan ƙwallon da sashen layi AB ya zama diamitarta. Tunda $AB={ab}$, tsawon radius ɗin shi ne $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}.$

job_boxTunnel.prompt: A cikin wani katako mai siffar akwatin murabba'i mai tsawo, tsawonsa ${a}$ cm, faɗinsa ${b}$ cm, tsayinsa ${c}$ cm, an huda rami madaidaici mai siffar irin wannan akwatin daga tsakiyar saman zuwa ƙasan katakon. Faɗi da tsawon ramin su ne ${p}$ cm da ${q}$ cm (ramin bai kai ga gefen katakon ba). Idan an ƙirga saman cikin ramin cikin jimillar faɗin saman, menene jimillar faɗin saman katakon mai rami, a cm²? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan an huda rami, saman da ƙasan katakon suna raguwa da girman sashen ramin da ya yanke su.
A maimakon haka, sabbin fuskoki huɗu na cikin ramin suna ƙaruwa a jimillar saman.
job_boxTunnel.explanation: Jimillar faɗin saman kafin a huda shi ne $2({a}\times{b}+{b}\times{c}+{c}\times{a})={s0}$ cm². A cire ${p}\times{q}$ sau biyu daga saman da ƙasa, sannan a ƙara girman fuskokin cikin ramin $2({p}+{q})\times{c}$, don haka ${s0}-{pq2}+{inn}={ans}$ cm².

job_boxesCeil.prompt: Ana saka sassa ${n}$ ${k}$ a kowace akwati domin shirya su, sannan a jera akwatuna ${m}$ a kan kowane pallet domin jigilar su. Ko da akwai ragowar sassa, ana saka su a akwati ɗaya; ko da akwai ragowar akwatuna, ana ɗora su a pallet ɗaya. Mene ne mafi ƙarancin adadin pallet da ake buƙata? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan rabo bai zama cikakken lamba ba, ana buƙatar ƙarin akwati (ko pallet) ɗaya domin ɗaukar ragowar.
Da farko nemo adadin akwatunan da ake buƙata, sannan a yi irin wannan lissafi domin nemo adadin pallet.
job_boxesCeil.explanation: Ana buƙatar akwatuna ${bx}$, wato sakamakon ${n}\div{k}$ da aka zagaye zuwa sama. Ana buƙatar pallet ${ans}$, wato sakamakon ${bx}\div{m}$ da aka zagaye zuwa sama.

job_chanceDraw.prompt: Akwati yana ɗauke da sassa ${n}$, kuma ${d}$ daga cikinsu ba su da kyau. Idan aka zaɓi sassa 2 lokaci guda ba tare da nuna bambanci ba, menene yiwuwar aƙalla guda 1 bai da kyau? (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Adadin duk hanyoyin zaɓe shi ne hanyoyin zaɓar guda 2 daga cikin sassa ${n}$.
Kishiyar 'aƙalla guda 1 bai da kyau' ita ce 'duk guda 2 suna da kyau'.
job_chanceDraw.explanation: Duk hanyoyin zaɓe su ne $_{{n}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={tot}$, yayin da hanyoyin da guda 2 ɗin duka suke da kyau su ne $_{{g}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={good}$. Saboda haka yiwuwar da ake nema ita ce $1-\frac{{good}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

job_floorPlan.prompt: Daki mai siffar murabba'i mai tsawo yana da faɗi ${a}$ m da tsawo ${b}$ m. A tsakiyar ɗaya daga cikin bangon faɗinsa akwai wani sashen murabba'i mai tsawo da ya fito waje, mai faɗi ${d}$ m da zurfi ${c}$ m (${d}<{a}$ kuma bai kai ga kusurwar ɗakin ba). Za a sanya allon gindi a cikin ɗakin tare da dukkan bangon ciki, sai dai wajen ƙofar mai faɗin ${w}$ m. Tsawon allon gindi nawa ake buƙata? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ka zana sifar da wani sashen ya fito a gefe, sannan ka yi tunanin yadda kewayawarta ta bambanta da ta murabba'i mai tsawo.
A madadin gefen mai faɗin ${d}$ m guda ɗaya da ya ɓace, an sami gefuna biyu masu zurfin ${c}$ m da wani gefe mai faɗin ${d}$ m.
job_floorPlan.explanation: Jimillar kewayen ɗakin ita ce $2({a}+{b})+2\times{c}={per}$ m (domin maimakon gefen ${d}$ m, an sami gefuna biyu na ${c}$ m da wani gefen ${d}$ m; saboda haka kewayen ya ƙaru da jimillar ${c}$ m sau biyu). Idan aka cire faɗin ƙofa ${w}$ m, ana buƙatar ${per}-{w}={ans}$ m.

job_flowUnits.prompt: Ruwa yana fita kullum daga bututun ruwan sha a ƙimar ${r}$ mL a minti ɗaya. Idan aka bar bututun a buɗe na tsawon sa'o'i ${h}$ da mintuna ${m}$, jimillar ruwa nawa ne zai fita, a L? (1 L = 1000 mL; rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Mayar da dukkan lokacin zuwa mintuna domin nemo tsawon lokacin da aka bar bututun a buɗe.
Lissafta adadin mL ta (adadin ruwa a minti ɗaya)×(adadin mintuna), sannan a raba da 1000 domin mayar da shi zuwa L.
job_flowUnits.explanation: Lokacin da aka bar bututun a buɗe shi ne ${h}\times60+{m}={tot}$ mintuna, kuma ruwan da ya fita shi ne ${r}\times{tot}={ml}$ mL. ${ml}\div1000={ans}$ L.

job_markupProfit.prompt: Shago ya ƙara ribar ${u}$% na farashin sayen kaya ${c}$ won domin saita farashin asali, sannan ya yi rangwamen ${d}$% daga farashin asali kuma ya sayar da kaya ${n}$ duka. Menene jimillar ribar da aka samu idan aka kwatanta da farashin saye, a won? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Farashin asali shi ne $(100+{u})$% na farashin saye.
Farashin sayarwa shi ne $(100-{d})$% na farashin asali, kuma ribar kaya guda ita ce (farashin sayarwa)−(farashin saye).
job_markupProfit.explanation: Farashin asali shi ne ${c}\times\frac{{100+u}}{100}={lp}$ won, kuma farashin sayarwa shi ne ${lp}\times\frac{{100-d}}{100}={sp}$ won. Ribar kaya guda ita ce ${sp}-{c}={g}$ won, saboda haka ribar kaya ${n}$ ita ce ${g}\times{n}={ans}$ won.

job_outfitCount.prompt: Akwai nau'ikan saman kayan aiki ${s}$ da na ƙasan tufafi ${p}$, sannan akwai huluna ${h}$. A zaɓi saman ɗaya da ƙasan ɗaya, kuma a iya saka ɗaya daga cikin hulunan ${h}$ ko a ƙi saka hula. Bisa ƙa'idar tsaro, akwai nau'ikan haɗin (sama, ƙasa) ${f}$ da ba za a iya sakawa tare ba. Jimillar tufafi mabambanta nawa za a iya sakawa? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Da farko nemo yawan nau'ikan haɗin (sama, ƙasa) da za a iya sakawa.
Ƙirga zaɓin hula ɗaya daga cikin nau'ikan ${h}$ ko rashin sanya hula, sannan ninka yawan zaɓin da aka samu.
job_outfitCount.explanation: Haɗin (sama, ƙasa) da za a iya sakawa su ne ${s}\times{p}-{f}={ok}$; zaɓin hula kuwa ya haɗa da rashin sanya hula, don haka akwai ${h}+1={hh}$. Bisa ƙa'idar ninkawa, jimillar su ${ok}\times{hh}={ans}$ ce.

job_planCompare.prompt: Tsarin biyan kuɗi A yana da kuɗin asali na wata ${f1}$ won da kuɗin ${p1}$ won ga kowane amfani. Tsarin B yana da kuɗin asali na wata ${f2}$ won da kuɗin ${p2}$ won ga kowane amfani. Idan yawan amfani a wata ya zama $x$ ($x$ lambar halitta ce), menene mafi ƙaramin $x$ da zai sa kuɗin wata na tsarin B ya yi ƙasa da na tsarin A? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Rubuta kuɗin wata na kowanne tsari a matsayin furuci mai ɗauke da $x$.
Warware rashin daidaiton (kuɗin B)<(kuɗin A) domin nemo zangon $x$.
job_planCompare.explanation: Kuɗin A shi ne ${f1}+{p1}x$, na B kuma ${f2}+{p2}x$. Daga ${f2}+{p2}x<{f1}+{p1}x$, ana samun ${dl}x>{df}$, wato $x>\frac{{df}}{{dl}}$. Mafi ƙaramin lambar halitta da ta cika wannan ita ce ${ans}$.

job_ratioChain.prompt: Rabon yawan kayayyakin da masana'antun A, B, da C suke samarwa a rana shi ne A : B $={a}:{b}$, sannan B : C $={c}:{d}$. Idan jimillar kayayyakin da masana'antun ukun suke samarwa a rana ta kai ${T}$, kayayyaki nawa ne masana'antar C take samarwa a rana? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Yi amfani da B a matsayin ma'auni domin haɗa rabon biyu a layi ɗaya: A : B : C.
Raba jimillar ${T}$ da jimillar lambobin rabon A : B : C domin nemo ƙimar kashi ɗaya.
job_ratioChain.explanation: Idan aka daidaita ƙimar rabon B, ana samun A : B : C $={pa}:{pb}:{pc}$. Jimillar rabon ita ce ${S}$, don haka ƙimar kashi ɗaya ita ce ${T}\div{S}={u}$. Rabon C ya zama ${pc}\times{u}={ans}$ kayayyaki.

job_scaleDrawing.prompt: A zane mai ma'aunin $1:{k}$, an zana ɗaki mai siffar murabba'i mai tsawo da faɗin ${w}$ cm, tsawonsa kuma ${h}$ cm. Menene faɗin saman ɗakin ainihi a m²? (1 m = 100 cm; rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Idan ma'aunin zane $1:{k}$ ne, a ninka tsawon da ke zane da ${k}$ domin samun ainihin tsawon.
Nemo ainihin faɗi da tsawo a cm, sannan ka mayar da su m kafin ninkawa.
job_scaleDrawing.explanation: Ainihin faɗi shi ne ${w}\times{k}={rw}$ cm$={rwm}$ m; ainihin tsawo kuma ${h}\times{k}={rh}$ cm$={rhm}$ m ne. Saboda haka faɗin saman shi ne ${rwm}\times{rhm}={ans}$ m².

job_tableRule.prompt: Wannan jadawalin kuɗin hayar kayan aiki ne. Duk lokacin da hayar ta ƙaru da awa 1, kuɗin yana ƙaruwa da adadi tsayayye. Hayar awa ${x1}$ tana kuɗin ${y1}$ won, awa ${x2}$ tana ${y2}$ won, awa ${x3}$ kuma tana ${y3}$ won. Menene kuɗin hayar awa ${N}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Duba jadawalin domin nemo adadin kuɗin da yake ƙaruwa idan lokacin haya ya ƙaru da awa 1.
Rubuta kuɗin a siffar (ƙarin kuɗi a awa 1)×(yawan awanni)+(kuɗin asali), sannan nemo kuɗin asali.
job_tableRule.explanation: Kuɗin yana ƙaruwa da ${k}$ won a kowace awa, saboda haka ƙa'idar kuɗin ita ce $y={k}x+{b}$ (nemo kuɗin asali ${b}$ domin kuɗin ya zama ${y1}$ won idan haya ta kai awa ${x1}$). Hayar awa ${N}$ tana biyan ${k}\times{N}+{b}={ans}$ won.

job_workTogether.prompt: Ma'aikaci A yana kera kayayyaki ${a}$ a awa ɗaya, ma'aikaci B kuma ${b}$ a awa ɗaya, a kan gudu tsayayye. A ya fara aiki, bayan awanni ${h}$ kuma B ya shiga aiki tare da shi. Awanni nawa A ya yi aiki gaba ɗaya har sai jimillar kayayyakin da suka kera ta kai daidai ${N}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai.)
hints: Idan aka ɗauka A ya yi aiki na awanni $t$, B ya yi aiki na awanni $t-{h}$.
Kafa ma'aunin layi na farko: (yawan da A ya kera)+(yawan da B ya kera)$={N}$.
job_workTogether.explanation: Idan A ya yi aiki na awanni $t$, B ya yi aiki na awanni $t-{h}$, saboda haka ${a}t+{b}(t-{h})={N}$. Idan aka sauƙaƙa, ${ab}t={tot}$, don haka A ya yi aiki na awanni $t={ans}$.

pst_atLeast.prompt: A cikin jaka akwai farin ƙwallaye ${w}$ da baƙaƙen ƙwallaye ${bk}$. Idan aka ɗauki ƙwallaye ${k}$ lokaci guda, nemo yiwuwar samun aƙalla ${r}$ farin ƙwallaye. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Complement na samun 'aƙalla ${r}$' farin ƙwallaye shi ne samun adadin farin ƙwallaye ${zs}$.
Jimillar hanyoyin cire ƙwallaye ita ce $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$.
pst_atLeast.explanation: Complement ɗin shi ne samun adadin farin ƙwallaye ${zs}$, kuma yawan hanyoyin hakan shi ne ${bx}={bad}$. Jimillar hanyoyin ita ce $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$, saboda haka yiwuwar da ake nema ita ce $1-\frac{{bad}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

pst_bayes.prompt: A jefa fair die sau ɗaya; idan ƙimar da ta fito ta kai ${t}$ ko ƙasa, a ɗauki ƙwallo ɗaya daga Box A, in ba haka ba daga Box B. Akwai farin ƙwallaye ${w1}$ da baƙaƙe ${b1}$ a Box A, da farin ƙwallaye ${w2}$ da baƙaƙe ${b2}$ a Box B. Idan ƙwallon da aka ɗauka fari ne, nemo yiwuwar ta fito daga Box A. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: $P(A\mid \text{white ball})=\frac{P(A\cap \text{white ball})}{P(\text{white ball})}$.
Denominator shi ne jimillar yiwuwar samun farin ƙwallo daga A da yiwuwar samun farin ƙwallo daga B.
pst_bayes.explanation: Yiwuwar farin ƙwallo daga A ita ce ${tA}$, daga B kuma ${tB}$, saboda haka yiwuwar da ake nema ita ce $\frac{{tA}}{{tA}+{tB}}={fr}$.

pst_bestOf.prompt: Team A da B suna fafatawa; wanda ya fara samun nasara ${w}$ shi ne zakara. A kowace wasa, yiwuwar Team A ta yi nasara ita ce ${fp}$; wasannin suna zaman kansu kuma ba a samun kunnen doki. Nemo yiwuwar Team A ta zama zakara. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Ka raba damar bisa ga wace wasa ce Team A ta samu nasara ta ${w}$.
Domin lashe wasa na ${w}+j$, a cikin wasannin ${wm1}+j$ na farko dole ne ta samu nasara ${wm1}$ da rashin nasara $j$.
pst_bestOf.explanation: Yiwuwar Team A ta lashe wasa na ${w}+j$ ($j={jr}$) ita ce $\binom{{wm1}+j}{j}\left({fp}\right)^{{w}}\left(1-{fp}\right)^{j}$. Waɗannan ƙimomi bi da bi su ne ${tm}$; idan aka tara su, jimillar ita ce ${fr}$.

pst_binomCoef2.prompt: Nemo coefficient na $x^{{k}}$ a faɗaɗawar $({ax}{bs})^{{n}}$. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: General term na binomial theorem yana da siffar $\binom{N}{j}A^{N-j}B^{j}$.
Nemo term ɗin da ke da $x$ sau ${k}$.
pst_binomCoef2.explanation: Term ɗin yana zaɓar $x$ sau ${k}$ da constant sau ${nk}$, saboda haka coefficient shi ne $\binom{{n}}{{k}}\cdot{a}^{{k}}\cdot({b})^{{nk}}={ans}$.

pst_binomFindN.prompt: Random variable $X$ yana bin binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$, kuma $E(X)={mu}$, $V(X)={vr}$. Nemo ƙimar $n$. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Idan aka raba $V(X)$ da $E(X)$, za a samu $1-p$.
pst_binomFindN.explanation: Tunda $\frac{V(X)}{E(X)}=1-p$, $1-p={q}$, saboda haka $p={pp}$. Daga $np={mu}$, ana samun $n={ans}$.

pst_binomNormal.prompt: Random variable $X$ yana bin binomial distribution $B({n},\ {pf})$. Yi amfani da normal approximation ga $X$ (ba tare da continuity correction ba) domin nemo $P({ev})$. Ga standard normal random variable $Z$: $P(0\le Z\le0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le3)=0.4987$. (Rubuta zuwa wurare 4 bayan decimal)
hints: Za a iya kusantar binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ da $N(np,\ np(1-p))$ idan n ya yi girma.
Standardize ta amfani da (mean, standard deviation)=$({mu},\ {sg})$.
pst_binomNormal.explanation: Tunda $E(X)={mu}$, $\sigma(X)=\sqrt{{vr}}={sg}$, za a iya kusantar $X$ da $N({mu},\ {sg}^{2})$. Bayan standardization ta $Z=\frac{X-{mu}}{{sg}}$, ana samun ${zs}$, saboda haka $P({ev})\approx P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_binomPmfEq.prompt: Idan m bazuwar $X$ tana bin rarrabuwar binomial $B({n},\ p)$ kuma $P(X={r})=P(X={r1})$, nemo ƙimar $p$. (Inda $0<p<1$) (Rubuta a matsayin kasr da aka rage. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Rubuta yiwuwar biyu a siffar $\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$, sannan ka raba ɓangarorin biyu da abu ɗaya na bai ɗaya.
Bayan sauƙaƙawa, za ka samu ƙimar $\frac{p}{1-p}$.
pst_binomPmfEq.explanation: Daga $\binom{{n}}{{r}}p^{{r}}(1-p)^{{nr}}=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p^{{r1}}(1-p)^{{nr1}}$, muna samun $\binom{{n}}{{r}}(1-p)=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p$, wato $\frac{p}{1-p}=\frac{{r1}}{{nr}}$. Saboda haka $p={fe}$.

hints: A cikin ka'idar faɗaɗa binomial $(1+x)^{N}=\sum_{k=0}^{N}\binom{N}{k}x^{k}$, gwada saka ƙimar da ta dace a matsayin $x$.
Zaɓi ƙimar $x$ domin $(1+x)^{N}$ ta zama daidai da jimillar.
pst_binomSumId.explanation: Idan aka saka $x={a}$ a ka'idar binomial, to $\sum_{k=0}^{{n}}\binom{{n}}{k}{at}^{k}=(1+{at})^{{n}}=({base})^{{n}}={ans}$.

pst_binomTail.prompt: Idan m bazuwar $X$ tana bin rarrabuwar binomial $B({n},\ {pf})$, nemo ƙimar $P(X{rel}{t})$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr da aka rage. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: $P(X=j)=\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ ne ($N$ shi ne adadin gwaje-gwaje). Idan akwai kalmomi da yawa da za a tara, yi tunanin yiwuwar akasin haka.
Ka tara kalmomin da $j=$ ${js}$.
pst_binomTail.explanation: $P(X=j)=\binom{{n}}{j}\left({pf}\right)^{j}\left(1-{pf}\right)^{{n}-j}$ ne, kuma yiwuwar da ake nema ita ce jimillar ƙimomin lokacin da $j={js}$, wato $\frac{{tm}}{{D}}=\frac{{num}}{{D}}={fe}$.

pst_binomUnknown.prompt: A cikin faɗaɗa $(x+a)^{{n}}$, idan ma'aunin $x^{{k}}$ ya zama ${V}$, nemo ƙimar $a$ mai kyau. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Bayyana ma'aunin $x^{{k}}$ ta amfani da $a$.
Tunda $\binom{{n}}{{k}}={C}$ ne, da farko nemo ƙimar $a^{{nk}}$.
pst_binomUnknown.explanation: Ma'aunin $x^{{k}}$ shi ne $\binom{{n}}{{k}}a^{{nk}}={C}a^{{nk}}$, saboda haka ${C}a^{{nk}}={V}$, wato $a^{{nk}}={q}$. Da yake $a>0$, $a={ans}$.

pst_ciBounds.prompt: An zaɓi samfurin girma ${n}$ ba bisa ƙa'ida ba daga jama'ar da ke bin rarrabuwar al'ada mai karkacewar ma'auni ${s}$, kuma matsakaicin samfurin ya kasance ${xb}$. A ƙiyasta matsakaicin jama'ar $m$ da tazarar amincewa mai matakin amincewa ${cl}\%$, idan tazarar amincewar ita ce $a\le m\le b$, sannan nemo ƙimar $b$. (Inda ƙimar da ta dace da matakin amincewa ${cl}\%$ ita ce $z={z}$.) (Rubuta a matsayin ƙima ta goma)
hints: Tazarar amincewa ita ce $\overline{x}-z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\le m\le \overline{x}+z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.
Tun da $\sqrt{{n}}={rt}$ ne, fara nemo $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.

pst_ciSampleSize.prompt: Daga population da ke bin normal distribution mai population standard deviation ${s}$, an zaɓi sample randomly domin ƙiyasta population mean da confidence level ${cl}\%$. Nemo mafi ƙaramin sample size integer $n$ da ke sa tsawon confidence interval bai wuce ${L}$ ba. (Ƙimar da ta dace da confidence level ${cl}\%$ ita ce $z={z}$, kuma n natural number ne.) (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Tsawon confidence interval shi ne $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Warware inequality ɗin nan game da $\sqrt{n}$, sannan ka ɗaga bangarorin biyu zuwa square: $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$.
pst_ciSampleSize.explanation: Tsawon confidence interval yana cika $2\times{z}\times\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$; saboda haka $\sqrt{n}\ge\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}$, wato $n\ge\left(\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}\right)^{2}{eq}{nq}$. Mafi ƙaramin natural number da ke cika sharadin shi ne ${ans}.$

pst_condDice.prompt: A jefa fair dice biyu dabam-dabam lokaci guda, a ce lambobin da suka fito su ne $a,\ b$. A ce event $A$ shi ne '$a+b{rel}{t}$', event $B$ kuma shi ne '$a{relb}b$'. Nemo conditional probability $P(B\mid A)$. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo dukkan sakamakon da ke cikin event $A$.
$P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$.
pst_condDice.explanation: Yawan sakamakon event $A$ shi ne ${nA}$; yawan na $A\cap B$ shi ne ${nAB}$. Saboda haka $P(B\mid A)={fe}$.

pst_condTable.prompt: A cikin members ${N}$ na wani club, maza ${m}$ ne, ɗalibai masu tabarau ${g}$ ne, kuma mazan da ke sa tabarau ${x}$ ne. Idan aka zaɓi member ɗaya ba tare da nufi ba, kuma ba ya sa tabarau, nemo yiwuwar cewa mace ce. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Ƙirƙiri jadawali mai cells huɗu na male/female da wear glasses/do not wear glasses, sannan ka cika yawan kowane rukuni.
A cikin conditional probability $P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$, event $A$ shi ne 'ba ya sa tabarau'.
pst_condTable.explanation: Mata ${f}$ ne, kuma mata masu tabarau ${g}-{x}={gy}$ ne, saboda haka mata marasa tabarau ${f}-{gy}={fn}$ ne. Yawan mutanen da ba sa sa tabarau ${N}-{g}={ng}$ ne, saboda haka yiwuwar ita ce ${fe}.$

pst_deMorgan.prompt: Ga events biyu $A,\ B$ idan ${gv}$, nemo ƙimar $P({ev})$. (Rubuta decimal)
hints: Zana Venn diagram a raba shi zuwa yankuna huɗu: $A\cap B$, $A\cap B^{c}$, $A^{c}\cap B$, $A^{c}\cap B^{c}$.

$P(A\cap B^{c})=P(A)-P(A\cap B)$, kuma $P(A^{c}\cap B)=P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Haka kuma ana iya amfani da De Morgan laws $(A\cup B)^{c}=A^{c}\cap B^{c}$, $(A\cap B)^{c}=A^{c}\cup B^{c}$, da $P(E^{c})=1-P(E)$.
pst_deMorgan.explanation: $P(A\cap B)$ shi ne ${der}$. Probabilities na yankuna huɗu su ne $P(A\cap B)={pab}$, $P(A\cap B^{c})={ao}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)={bo}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B^{c})={ne}$, kuma jimillarsu $1$ ce. $P({ev})$ ita ce jimillar yankunan da suka dace, wato ${sumx}$.

pst_diceQuad.prompt: A jefa fair die mai face daga $1$ zuwa ${s}$ sau biyu, lambobin da suka fito a jere su ne $a,\ b$. Nemo yiwuwar quadratic equation $x^{2}-{pa}x+{qb}=0$ ta sami real roots biyu daban-daban. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Sharadin samun real roots biyu daban-dabam shi ne discriminant $D>0$.
$D={d1}-4\times{qb}$ ne. Zaɓi ƙimar $a$ ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka ƙirga ƙimar $b$ da suka cika sharadin.
pst_diceQuad.explanation: Akwai sakamako $(a,\ b)$ ${cnt}$ da ke cika discriminant $D={d1}-4\times{qb}>0$, kuma jimillar sakamako ${tot}$ ce; saboda haka yiwuwar ita ce ${fe}.$

pst_diceSum.prompt: Idan aka jefa ɗan lido biyu na gaskiya lokaci guda, kowanne yana da fuskoki masu lamba daga $1$ zuwa ${s}$, kuma lambobin da suka fito su ne $a,\ b$, nemo yiwuwar $a+b{rel}{t}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Idan aka bambanta ɗan lido biyun, adadin duk hanyoyin da za su iya fitowa shi ne ${s}\times{s}$.
Canza $a$ daga $1$ zuwa ${s}$, ƙirga adadin ƙimomin $b$ da suka cika sharadin, sannan ka tara su.
pst_diceSum.explanation: Dukkan hanyoyi ${tot}$ ne, kuma akwai $(a,\ b)$ guda ${cnt}$ da suka cika sharadin. Saboda haka yiwuwar ita ce ${fe}$.

pst_expectTable.prompt: Idan ƙimomin da canjin yiwuwa $X$ zai iya ɗauka su ne $1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$, kuma $P(X=x)=k(x+{c})$ ($x=1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$), nemo matsakaicin $X$, wato $E(X)$. (a ɗauki $k$ a matsayin akai-akai) (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo $k$ daga sharadin cewa jimillar yiwuwar ita ce $1$.
$E(X)=\sum x\,P(X=x)$.
pst_expectTable.explanation: Tunda jimillar yiwuwar ita ce $1$, $k({t1})={S1}k=1$, wato $k=\frac{1}{{S1}}$. $E(X)=\frac{1}{{S1}}({t2})=\frac{1}{{S1}}\times{S2}={fe}$.

pst_indepFindN.prompt: A cikin katuna $n$ masu lambobin halitta daga $1$ zuwa $n$, a zaɓi kati ɗaya ba tare da son rai ba. A ce abin faruwa $A$ shi ne 'lambar katin mahadar ninkin ${p}$ ce', abin faruwa $B$ kuma shi ne 'lambar katin mahadar ninkin ${q}$ ce'. Daga lambobin halitta $n$ masu cika $2\le n\le {M}$, nemo mafi girman ƙimar $n$ da ke sa abubuwan faruwa $A$ da $B$ su kasance masu zaman kansu. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan abubuwan faruwa masu zaman kansu ne, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, kuma $A\cap B$ ya ƙunshi mahadar ninkin ${l}$. Idan akwai katuna a mahadar ninkin ${p}$ guda $a$, na ${q}$ guda $b$, na ${l}$ kuma guda $c$, sharadin zaman kansu shi ne $ab=cn$.
Duba abin da ke faruwa idan $n$ mahadar ninkin ${l}$ ce.
pst_indepFindN.explanation: Idan $n={l}t$ ($t$ lamba ce ta halitta), $P(A)=\frac{1}{{p}}$, $P(B)=\frac{1}{{q}}$, kuma $P(A\cap B)=\frac{1}{{l}}$, saboda haka suna zaman kansu. Mafi girman mahadar ninkin ${l}$ da ba ta wuce ${M}$ ba ita ce ${ans}$. Ga $n$ mafi girma fiye da wannan, idan adadin katuna da suke mahadar ninkin ${p}$, ${q}$, da ${l}$ su ne $a$, $b$, da $c$, a bincika ko sharadin zaman kansu $\frac{c}{n}=\frac{a}{n}\cdot\frac{b}{n}$, wato $ab=cn$, ya cika. Tunda ${chk}$, ba su zaman kansu ba. Saboda haka amsar ita ce ${ans}$.

pst_indepUnknown.prompt: Idan abubuwan faruwa biyu $A,\ B$ masu zaman kansu ne, $P(A)={fa}$, kuma $P(A\cup B)={fu}$, nemo ƙimar $P(B)$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Idan suna zaman kansu, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$.
Mayar da ƙa'idar haɗawa $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$ zuwa lissafi mai ɗauke da $P(B)$.
pst_indepUnknown.explanation: Tunda abubuwan faruwa masu zaman kansu ne, $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$, wato $P(B)\{1-P(A)\}=P(A\cup B)-P(A)$. Tunda $1-{fa}={d1}$ da ${fu}-{fa}={d2}$, ana samun $P(B)={d2}\div{d1}={fr}$.

pst_latticePath.prompt: Daga maki $(0,\ 0)$ a kan filin ma'auni zuwa maki $({m},\ {n})$, ana motsi mataki ɗaya zuwa dama ko sama kawai. Hanyoyi nawa ne mafi guntu da ba sa wucewa ta maki $\mathrm{P}({p},\ {q})$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
