hints: Yi amfani da permutashin da ke da abubuwa iri ɗaya domin ƙirga jimillar hanyoyi. Hanyoyin da ba su wucewa ta maki = jimillar hanyoyi - hanyoyin da suka wuce ta maki.
A ƙirga hanyoyin da suka ratsa $\mathrm{P}$ ta hanyar ninka (hanyoyi daga farawa zuwa $\mathrm{P}$) × (daga $\mathrm{P}$ zuwa ƙarshe).
pst_latticePath.explanation: Jimillar hanyoyi ${tot}$ ne. Hanyoyi daga farawa zuwa $\mathrm{P}$ ${via1}$ ne, daga $\mathrm{P}$ zuwa ƙarshe kuma ${via2}$ ne; saboda haka hanyoyin da suka wuce ta $\mathrm{P}$ ${via1}\times{via2}={via}$ ne. Saboda haka ${tot}-{via}={ans}$ hanya ne.

pst_linTransform.prompt: Idan mean na random variable $X$ ita ce ${m}$, standard deviation kuma ${s}$, nemo ƙimar $E(Y^{2})$ ga random variable $Y={ya}$. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: Yi amfani da $E(Y)=aE(X)+b$, $V(Y)=a^{2}V(X)$.

pst_lineUp.prompt: Idan maza ${m}$ da mata ${w}$ suna tsayawa a layi, nemo yiwuwar cewa babu mata biyu da suke tsaye kusa da juna. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Ko da ba a bambanta mutane masu jinsi ɗaya ba, yiwuwar tana nan iri ɗaya idan aka duba tsarin jinsi kawai. Da farko jera maza, sannan ka yi tunanin mata suna tsayawa a tsakanin su da gefuna biyu.
Akwai wurare ${m1}$ da mata za su iya tsayawa.
pst_lineUp.explanation: Jimillar gender arrangements ita ce $\binom{{nn}}{{w}}={tot}$. Idan aka zaɓi wurare ${w}$ daga cikin ${m1}$ da ke tsakanin maza da gefuna, mata za su tsaya ba tare da makwabta ba a hanyoyi $\binom{{m1}}{{w}}={good}$. Yiwuwar ita ce ${fe}$.

pst_monotoneSeq.prompt: Ga elements a, b, c, d na set $\{1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}\}$, nemo yawan ordered tuples $(a,\ b,\ c,\ d)$ da ke cika $a{r1}b{r2}c{r3}d$. (Rubuta lamba kawai)
hints: A wurin da inequality ke da alamar $<$, dole lambobin biyu su bambanta. Rage range na lambobin da za a iya zaɓa gwargwadon haka.
Idan inequalities duka da $\le$ ne, zaɓar lambobi huɗu daidai yake da combinations tare da maimaitawa.
pst_monotoneSeq.explanation: $a<b$ daidai yake da $a+1\le b$, saboda haka idan akwai $<$ ɗaya, za a iya rage lambobin da ke baya da 1 domin mayar da wannan inequality zuwa $\le$. A wannan tambaya, akwai $<$ guda ${s}$, saboda haka inequalities duka su zama $\le$ kuma range ɗin lambobi ya zama daga 1 zuwa ${ms}$. Wannan yawan hanyoyin zaɓar lambobi 4 daga range ɗin tare da maimaitawa, don haka ${}_{{ms}}\mathrm{H}_{4}=\binom{{top}}{4}={ans}$.

pst_multiplesUnion.prompt: A cikin katuna ${N}$ da aka rubuta lambobi daga 1 zuwa ${N}$, an zaɓi kati ɗaya ba tare da nufi ba. Nemo yiwuwar lambar da ke katin ta zama multiple na ${p}$ ko ${q}$. (Rubuta fraction mafi sauƙi; idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo yawan multiples na ${p}$ da ${q}$. Multiples na duka lambobin biyu su ne multiples na least common multiple ɗinsu.
Yawan elements na union = jimillar yawan elements − yawan intersection.
pst_multiplesUnion.explanation: Akwai multiples na ${p}$ guda ${np}$, multiples na ${q}$ guda ${nq}$, da multiples na LCM ${l}$ guda ${nl}$. Saboda haka ${np}+{nq}-{nl}={cnt}$, kuma yiwuwar ita ce ${fe}$.

pst_normalBetween.prompt: Idan random variable $X$ yana bin normal distribution $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$, nemo ƙimar $P({a}\le X\le {b})$. Ga standard normal random variable $Z$: $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Rubuta zuwa wurare 4 bayan decimal)
hints: Standardize da $Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$ domin samun siffar $P(z_1\le Z\le z_2)$.
Jadawalin standard normal yana da symmetry game da $Z=0$.
pst_normalBetween.explanation: Idan aka standardize da $Z=\frac{X-{m}}{{s}}$, ana samun $\frac{{a}-{m}}{{s}}={z1}$ da $\frac{{b}-{m}}{{s}}={z2}$, saboda haka $P({z1}\le Z\le {z2})={expr}$.

pst_normalFindParam.prompt: Idan random variable $X$ yana bin rarrabawar normal $N(m,\ {s}^{2})$ kuma $P(X\ge {c})={pv}$, nemo ƙimar constant $m$. Ga random variable $Z$ mai rarrabawar standard normal, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Mayar da $P(X\ge {c})$ zuwa yiwuwar da ta shafi $Z$, sannan ka kwatanta da $0.5$.
A cikin tebur, nemo $z_0$ wanda ya dace da ƙimar $P(0\le Z\le z_0)$.
pst_normalFindParam.explanation: $P(X\ge {c})=P\left(Z\ge \frac{{c}-m}{{s}}\right)={pv}$. A cikin tebur, $P(0\le Z\le |z_0|)=|{pv}-0.5|={tv}$, don haka $|z_0|={az}$. Tunda ${cmp}$, to ${zsg}$, kuma $\frac{{c}-m}{{s}}={zz}$. Saboda haka $m={ans}$.

pst_normalSymmetric.prompt: Idan random variable $X$ yana bin rarrabawar normal $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$ kuma $P(X\le {L})=P(X\ge {R})$, nemo ƙimar constant $k$. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Lanƙwan rarrabawar normal tana da daidaito a kusa da matsakaici $m$.
Ƙimomin biyu suna nesa iri ɗaya daga matsakaicin amma a ɓangarori dabam. Wato jimillar ƙimomin biyu $2m$ ce.
pst_normalSymmetric.explanation: Tunda lanƙwan rarrabawar normal tana da daidaito game da $x={m}$, $({L})+({R})=2\times{m}$. Idan aka sauƙaƙa, ana samun ${A}k+({BD})={m2}$, saboda haka $k={ans}.$

pst_repCombEq.prompt: Ga integers marasa korau $x,\ y,\ z,\ w$, idan $x+y+z+w={n}$ da ${cond}$, nemo adadin ordered quadruples $(x,\ y,\ z,\ w)$. (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Ga variable da ƙaramar ƙimarsa ta fi $0$, cire wannan ƙaramar ƙima domin canza shi ya zama ba ƙasa da $0$.
Lissafin da aka canza zai kasance a sigar $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$.
pst_repCombEq.explanation: A ayyana sabbin variables kamar haka: ${subs}$. (Idan akwai variable mai ƙaramar ƙima $0$, a bar shi yadda yake, wato $x'=x$.) Sai $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$ kuma kowane variable integer ne marar korau. Saboda haka, ta amfani da combinations with repetition, ${}_{4}\mathrm{H}_{{m2}}=\binom{{m3}}{{m2}}={ans}.$

pst_repPermCond.prompt: Daga lambobi $0,\ 1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}$, ana samar da natural numbers masu lambobi ${k}$ ta hanyar maimaita lambobi (lambar farko ba $0$ ba ce). Nawa ne daga cikinsu ke amfani da lamba ${t}$ aƙalla sau ɗaya? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Don “aƙalla sau ɗaya”, yana da sauƙi a yi amfani da complementary event (“ba a yi amfani da ita ko sau ɗaya ba”). Lambar farko ba za ta iya zama 0 ba.
Akwai ${tot}$ jimillar natural numbers masu lambobi ${k}.$
pst_repPermCond.explanation: Akwai ${tot}$ jimillar natural numbers masu lambobi ${k}, kuma akwai ${noExpr}={no}$ waɗanda ba sa amfani da lamba ${t}$ ko sau ɗaya. Saboda haka, ${tot}-{no}={ans}$ ne.$

pst_sampleMeanDist.prompt: Akwai ƙwallo 3 a cikin jaka, kuma lambobin da ke kansu su ne ${lst}. Ana cire ƙwallo ɗaya, a duba lambarta sannan a mayar da ita; ana maimaita wannan aikin ${nt}$ sau. Idan matsakaicin lambobin ${nt}$ da aka gani shi ne $\overline{X}$, nemo $P(\overline{X}\ge {t})$. (Rubuta a matsayin juzu’i mafi sauƙi. Idan integer ne, rubuta integer. Misali: 3/4)$
hints: Tunda ana mayar da ƙwallon, duk ordered pairs suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya.
Ƙirga duk ordered pairs waɗanda matsakaicinsu ya kai ko ya fi ${t}.$
pst_sampleMeanDist.explanation: Akwai ${tot}$ hanyoyi idan aka bambanta jerin, kuma ${cnt}$ daga cikinsu suna da matsakaici aƙalla ${t}. Saboda haka yiwuwar ita ce ${fe}.

pst_sampleMeanNormal.prompt: Idan aka zaɓi samfurin mutane ${n}$ ba bisa ƙa'ida ta musamman ba daga yawan jama'a da ke bin rabon al'ada mai matsakaicin yawan jama'a ${m}$ da karkacewar ma'auni ${s}$, kuma a ce matsakaicin samfurin shi ne $\overline{X}$, nemo ƙimar $P({ev})$. Ga canjin bazuwar $Z$ da ke bin rabon al'ada na yau da kullum: $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Rubuta zuwa gurbin goma na huɗu)
hints: Matsakaicin samfurin $\overline{X}$ yana bin rabon al'ada $N\left(m,\ \left(\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\right)^{2}\right)$.
Nemo karkacewar ma'auni da za a yi amfani da ita wajen daidaita ma'auni kamar haka: $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$
pst_sampleMeanNormal.explanation: $\overline{X}$ yana bin rabon al'ada $N({m},\ {h}^{2})$ ($\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$). Idan aka daidaita ta amfani da $Z=\frac{\overline{X}-{m}}{{h}}$, za a samu ${zs}$, saboda haka $P({ev})=P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_sampleSd.prompt: Idan aka zaɓi samfurin mutane ${n}$ ba bisa ƙa'ida ta musamman ba daga yawan jama'a mai matsakaici ${m}$ da bambanci ${v}$, kuma a ce matsakaicin samfurin shi ne $\overline{X}$, nemo ƙimar $E(\overline{X}^{2})$. (Rubuta a matsayin decimal)
hints: Matsakaicin matsakaicin samfurin shi ne $E(\overline{X})=m$, bambancinsa kuma $V(\overline{X})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{{n}}$.
$E(\overline{X}^{2})=V(\overline{X})+\{E(\overline{X})\}^{2}$.

pst_stratified.prompt: An raba mazauna wani yanki zuwa rukuni A, B, C masu yawan mutane ${na}$, ${nb}$, ${nc}$ bi da bi. An zaɓi samfurin ta hanyar rarrabawa gwargwadon yawan mutane a kowane rukuni, kuma an zaɓi mutane ${sa}$ daga rukuni A. Mutane nawa ne aka zaɓa daga rukuni C? (Rubuta lambar kawai)
hints: Idan an raba gwargwado, rabon da aka zaɓa daga kowane rukuni (yawan samfurin ÷ yawan rukuni) iri ɗaya ne.
Da farko nemo rabon rukuni A.
pst_stratified.explanation: Rabon da aka zaɓa daga rukuni A shi ne $\frac{{sa}}{{na}}$. Da yake wannan rabon iri ɗaya ne ga dukkan rukuni, adadin da aka zaɓa daga C shi ne ${nc}\times\frac{{sa}}{{na}}={ans}$.

pst_totalProb.prompt: An jefa ƙwallon caca mai daidaito sau ɗaya. Idan lambar da ta faɗo ba ta fi ${t}$ ba, a ɗauki ƙwallo ɗaya daga akwati A; idan ba haka ba, a ɗauka daga akwati B. Akwati A yana da fararen ƙwallo ${w1}$ da baƙaƙe ${b1}$, akwatin B kuma farare ${w2}$ da baƙaƙe ${b2}$. Nemo yiwuwar ƙwallon da aka ɗauka ta zama fari. (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Za a iya raba hanyoyin samun farin ƙwallo zuwa 'farin ƙwallo daga A' ko 'farin ƙwallo daga B'.
Nemo kowace ta amfani da (yiwuwar zaɓar akwatin)×(yiwuwar samun farin ƙwallo daga akwatin).
pst_totalProb.explanation: Farin ƙwallo daga A: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}={tA}$; farin ƙwallo daga B: $\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={tB}$ (a nan $\frac{{t6c}}{6}$ ita ce yiwuwar zaɓar B). Tara yiwuwar biyun: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}+\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={fr}$.

pst_urnChain.prompt: A cikin jaka akwai fararen ƙwallo ${w}$ da baƙaƙe ${bk}$. Ana zare ƙwallo ɗaya bayan ɗaya ba tare da mayar da waɗanda aka zare ba. Nemo yiwuwar fara samun fararen ƙwallo a jere sau ${r}$ sannan a zare baƙar ƙwallo a karo na ${r1}$. (Rubuta a matsayin kaso mafi sauƙi. Idan lamba cikakkiya ce, rubuta ta haka. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Ƙa'idar ninka yiwuwar: yawan ƙwallon da ya rage yana canzawa a kowane mataki.
Yiwuwar samun farin ƙwallo a karon farko ita ce $\frac{{w}}{{nn}}$.
pst_urnChain.explanation: Idan aka ninka yiwuwar kowane mataki (bisa sharadin abin da ya gabata), za a samu ${prod}={fe}$.

pst_varTable.prompt: Idan rarraba yuwuwar canjin $X$ shi ne $P(X={x1})=\frac{{a1}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x2})=\frac{{a2}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x3})=\frac{{a3}}{{d}}$, nemo ƙimar bambancin ma'auni $V(X)$. (Rubuta a matsayin kasr mafi sauƙi. Idan cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta lambar. Misali: 3/4)
hints: Da farko nemo $E(X)$ da $E(X^{2})$.

stat_ciMean.prompt: An zaɓi samfurin bazuwar mai mutane {cnt} daga al'umma mai bin rarraba al'ada. Matsakaicin samfurin shi ne $\bar{x}={xbar}$, karkacewar ma'aunin al'umma kuma $\sigma={sig}$. Yankin amincewa na matsakaicin al'umma da matakin amincewa ${cl}\%$ shi ne $\bar{x}-z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$, kuma ƙimar $z$ ita ce ${z}$. Menene iyakar sama na wannan yankin amincewa? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo kuskuren ma'auni $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$. Tunda $n$ murabba'i ne, rabon zai zama cikakkiyar lamba.
Iyakar kuskure ita ce $z\times$(kuskuren ma'auni), kuma iyakar sama ita ce matsakaicin $\bar{x}$ a haɗe da wannan ƙima.
stat_ciMean.explanation: Kuskuren ma'auni shi ne $\frac{{sig}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, iyakar kuskure ita ce ${z}\times{se}={moe}$; don haka iyakar sama ita ce ${xbar}+{moe}={ans}$.

stat_ciProp.prompt: An zaɓi mutane {cnt} ba tare da son rai ba domin binciken wani tsari; mutane {ag} sun goyi bayansa. Idan rabon samfurin shi ne $\hat{p}$, yankin amincewa na rabon al'umma da matakin amincewa ${cl}\%$ shi ne $\hat{p}-z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}\le p\le\hat{p}+z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$, kuma ƙimar $z$ ita ce ${z}$. Nemo iyakar sama na wannan yankin a matsayin lamba cikin kaso (%). (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo rabon samfurin $\hat{p}=\dfrac{{ag}}{{cnt}}$.
$\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ yana ba da cikakken rabo mai sauƙi. Zai fi sauƙi a lissafta bayan mayar da shi zuwa kaso.
stat_ciProp.explanation: Tunda $\hat{p}={ph}\%$ da $\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{{cnt}}}={sdp}\%$, iyakar kuskure ita ce ${z}\times{sdp}={moe}$(%), kuma iyakar sama ita ce ${ph}+{moe}={ans}$(%).

stat_linReverse.prompt: An ƙirƙiri sabon canji $y$ daga canjin $x$ ($y={eq}$). Matsakaicin $y$ shi ne ${my}$, karkacewar ma'auni kuma ${sy}$. Menene karkacewar ma'auni na canjin $x$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan $y=ax+b$, karkacewar ma'auni tana ninkuwa da $|a|$.
Akai-akai $b$ da ake ƙarawa da matsakaici ba su da alaƙa da karkacewar ma'auni. Raba karkacewar ma'auni ta $y$ da $|a|$.
stat_linReverse.explanation: Cikakkiyar ƙimar mai haɗin x ita ce ${aa}$, saboda haka karkacewar ma'auni ta $y$ ita ce ${aa}$ sau ta $x$. Don haka karkacewar ma'auni ta $x$ ita ce ${sy}\div{aa}={ans}$.

stat_linTransform.prompt: Matsakaicin canjin $x$ shi ne ${m}$, bambancin ma'auni kuma ${vx}$. Idan sabon canjin $y$ shi ne $y={eq}$, menene bambancin ma'aunin $y$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Idan $y=ax+b$, bambancin ma'auni yana ninkuwa da $a^2$.
Akai-akai $b$ da ake ƙarawa ba ya sauya yaɗuwar bayanai, saboda haka ba ya shafar bambancin ma'auni.
stat_linTransform.explanation: A $y={eq}$, mai haɗin $x$ shi ne ${ap}$; saboda haka bambancin ma'auni shi ne ${vx}\times{ap}^{2}={vx}\times{a2}={ans}$ (akai-akai da matsakaici ba sa shafar bambancin ma'auni).

stat_quartileIqr.prompt: Bayan an jera bayanai {data} daga ƙarami zuwa babba, a kira matsakaicin ƙimar rabin ƙasa $Q_1$, sannan matsakaicin ƙimar rabin sama $Q_3$, bisa ga matsakaicin bayanan gaba ɗaya. (Idan adadin bayanai mara ma'aurata ne, kada a saka matsakaicin gaba ɗaya cikin ko wanne rabin bayanai.) Menene kewayon tsakanin ƙimar kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu $Q_3-Q_1$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko sake rubuta bayanai daga ƙarami zuwa babba.
Raba bayanan zuwa rabin ƙasa da rabin sama bisa ga matsakaicin duka, sannan nemo matsakaicin kowane rabi.
stat_quartileIqr.explanation: Tsari daga ƙarami zuwa babba: {sorted}. Tunda $Q_1={q1}$ da $Q_3={q3}$, ana samun $Q_3-Q_1={ans}$.

stat_rejectN.prompt: Ana gwada hasashe: $H_0: m={mu0}$, $H_1: m>{mu0}$. A ɗauka karkacewar ma'aunin al'umma ita ce $\sigma={sig}$, matsakaicin samfurin kuma $\bar{x}={xbar}$. Idan ƙididdigar gwaji $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ta fi ${crit}$, a ƙi hasashen asali. Idan matsakaicin samfurin iri ɗaya ne, menene ƙaramin girman samfurin $n$ da zai sa a ƙi hasashen asali? (Lamba ta halitta, rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Mayar da rashin daidaito mai zuwa zuwa furuci mai ɗauke da $\sqrt{n}$: $Z>{crit}$.
Ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu zuwa murabba'i domin nemo kewayon $n$, sannan nemo ƙaramin lamba ta halitta da ta cika sharadin. Idan ya yi daidai da ƙimar iyaka, ba a ƙin hasashen ba.
stat_rejectN.explanation: Daga $Z=\dfrac{{xbar}-{mu0}}{{sig}}\sqrt{n}>{crit}$ ana samun $\sqrt{n}>{rt}$, wato $n>{lim}$ (ƙimar da aka nuna har zuwa gurbin goma na biyu). Ƙaramin lamba ta halitta da ta cika wannan ita ce ${ans}$.

stat_sdFreq.prompt: Jadawalin rarraba yawan bayyanuwa yana nuna ƙimomin canji $x$ su ne {xs}, yawan bayyanuwarsu a jere kuma {fs}. Idan aka ɗauki wannan bayanin a matsayin al'ummar gaba ɗaya (mai ƙididdigewa na bambancin ma'auni shi ne jimillar yawan bayyanuwa), menene karkacewar ma'auni? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo jimillar yawan bayyanuwa $N$ da matsakaici $m=\dfrac{\sum f x}{N}$.
Bambancin ma'auni $=\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}-m^2$, karkacewar ma'auni kuma tushen murabba'i mai kyau na wannan ƙima ce.
stat_sdFreq.explanation: Tunda $N={tot}$, matsakaici $m={mean}$, kuma $\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}={msq}$, bambancin ma'auni shi ne ${var}$, karkacewar ma'auni kuma ${ans}$.

stat_stratified.prompt: Za a yi zaɓen samfurin bisa rukunin ɗalibai daga azuzuwan shekaru uku, masu ɗalibai {n1}, {n2}, da {n3} bi da bi; jimillar samfurin ita ce {ns}. Idan aka raba samfurin bisa ga kaso na ɗaliban kowanne aji (rukuni) daga cikin jimillar ɗalibai, ɗalibai nawa za a zaɓa daga aji na {i}? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko nemo jimillar ɗalibai $N$.
Adadin da za a zaɓa daga aji na {i} shi ne (jimillar samfurin da za a zaɓa)$\times\dfrac{{ni}}{N}$.
stat_stratified.explanation: Jimillar ɗalibai ita ce ${pop}$, don haka ${ns}\times\dfrac{{ni}}{{pop}}={ans}$ ɗalibi.

stat_tCiLower.prompt: An zaɓi samfurin bazuwar mai mutane {cnt} daga al'umma mai bin rarraba al'ada. Matsakaicin samfurin shi ne $\bar{x}={xbar}$, karkacewar ma'aunin samfurin kuma $s={sd}$. Tunda ba a san karkacewar ma'aunin al'umma ba, a yi amfani da rarrabar $t$; a jadawalin rarrabar $t$ mai matakin 'yanci ${df}$, $P(T\le {t0})=0.975$. Menene iyakar ƙasa ta yankin amincewa na matsakaicin al'umma $m$ da matakin amincewa $95\%$, wato $\bar{x}-t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ($t_0={t0}$)? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Matakin 'yanci shi ne $n-1$, kuskuren ma'auni kuma $\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ne.
Iyakar ƙasa ita ce $\bar{x}-t_0\times$(kuskuren ma'auni).
stat_tCiLower.explanation: Kuskuren ma'auni shi ne $\frac{{sd}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, iyakar kuskure ita ce ${t0}\times{se}={moe}$; saboda haka iyakar ƙasa ita ce ${xbar}-{moe}={ans}$.

stat_zStat.prompt: An bayyana cewa matsakaicin rayuwar samfurin wani kaya shi ne ${mu0}$ sa'o'i. An zaɓi samfurin bazuwar mai kaya {cnt} da aka ƙera ta hanyar aiki sabuwa; matsakaicin rayuwar kayan samfurin shi ne $\bar{x}={xbar}$ sa'o'i. Idan rayuwar kaya tana bin rarraba al'ada, kuma karkacewar ma'aunin al'umma $\sigma={sig}$ sa'o'i ba ta sauya ba, menene ƙididdigar gwaji $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ga hasashen asali $H_0: m={mu0}$? (Rubuta lambobi kawai)
hints: Da farko lissafta $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Raba bambancin matsakaicin samfurin da ${mu0}$ da wannan ƙima. Sakamakon na iya zama mara kyau.
